tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (da)༄༅/ /sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i smin grol yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud yig dge legs gaṅgā'i klung chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ
(da)༄༅/ /sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i smin grol yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud yig dge legs gaṅgā'i klung chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i smin grol yan lag dang bcas pa'i brgyud yig dge legs gaṅgā'i klung chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dus ma byas dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan chos kyi sku// sku dang ye shes rgya mtsho'i snying po kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs// zung 'jug ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pas srid pa'i mtha' yang pham mdzad pa// sku gsum dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bdag skyongs shig /gang la dad pas bsnyen cing sgrub byed la// dngos grub mchog gi skal ba bde blag tu// sbyin mdzad rgyud sde bzhi las legs bstan pa'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gting mtha' mi mngon tshogs zung rgya mtsho'i klong*// btso ma gser rir mtshan dpe dpal 'bar zhing*// nyi gzhon bye bas 'khyud 'dra lhang nge ba// srid zhi'i rgyan gcig shākya'i tog la 'dud// srid pa'i gdung ba mtha' dag gzhil ba'i sman// thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i dpal yon can// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'gog bden de thob rgyu// lam bden lung gi chos bcas spyi bor bsnyen// shin tu zhi ba dam pa'i brtul zhugs dang*// rig grol yon tan rgya mtsho 'khyil pa'i thugs// gcig tu gzhan don lhur len byang sems dang*// nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs la'ang phyag bgyi'o// grub pa yongs kyi spyi mes sa ra ha// rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags mchog klu thogs gnyis// gsang chen bstan pa'i srol 'byed bi rū'i zhabs// mkhas grub khyu mchog chen po rnams la 'dud// zab rgyas rgyud sde'i ston pa sgeg rdor che// lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung tsan+d+ra'i mtshan// rgyud dang man ngag gsal byed dze tā ri// 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa rnams la 'dud// rgyal sras lam bzang snang mdzad jo bo rje// grub gnyis chos kyi skyes 'dren ba ri'i zhabs// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bka' babs sa skya pa// brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i ded dpon grags rgyal mtshan// bka' gdams nor bu'i mdzod gdal nam mkha' grags// gsung rab kun la 'jigs bral bo dong pa// smra ba'i dbang phyug che rnams phyag gi yul// nges don lam gyi shing rta bka' brgyud pa// grub pa'i gseng lam 'byed mkhas khyung po'i zhabs// man ngag rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur pha dam pa// rig sngags 'chang rnams gtsug rgyan mchog la 'dud// bod yul rgyud sde'i sgron me kun mkhyen bu// mdo rgyud phrin las mkha' khyab tsong kha pa// grub pa'i man ngag mchog thob rje btsun che// zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod rnams spyi bor mchod// snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa ngor chen rje// lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyin byed ngag gi dbang*// rdo rje 'chang dngos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan te// bka' drin mnyam med rnams la gus pas 'dud// rgyud dang grub pa'i man ngag legs 'brel zhing*// skal bzang skye bos don gnyis bsgrub pa'i gzhi// gang las brgyud pa'i phreng ba yid 'ong bas// blo ldan mos pa'i mgul pa mdzes par byed// zung 'jug mchog dngos yan lag rab 'byams las// sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod pa kun 'jo ba'i// brgyud pa'i snang tshul dge legs bye ba'i gter// gaṅgā'i klung chen phab la deng 'jug cig

/de la 'dir rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rgyud sde rin po che rtsod pa med pa rnams las legs par bstan cing tshad mar gyur pa'i paṇa grub rnams kyis thugs nyams su gzhes shing gtan la phab/ gangs can gyi ljongs su lo tsā skyes chen rnams kyis bsgyur bshad 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas snang bar mdzad la/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras gtso bor gyur pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa ches mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyi bka' srol dri ma med pa las byon pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa'i skor bka' yod la lhad ma zhugs pa'i rgyun ji snyed bzhugs pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa sgrub thabs rin po che kun las btus pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i chos sde 'di nyid kyi smin grol rgyab brten dang bcas pa gang las brgyud pa'i yi ge rnam par dag pa ji ltar rnyed par bri bar bya'o// de yang thog mar dge ba'i lha gsum las/ tshe dpag med dkar po grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi rjes gnang thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha ltar nos nas/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dang*/ brgyud 'debs 'chi med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ rgyun khyer/ bsnyen pa byed tshul rjes gnang gi gsal byed dang bcas pa 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len mkhas dbang byams pa phrin las yon tan gyis mdzad pa dag gi lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dkon mchog lhun grub yan rjes gnang gi gsham du gsal/ de nas nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsan pa ste 'og ma rnams la'ang de bzhin shes par bya'o// yang na/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs yan gsan yig gzhan ltar la/ de nas byams pa bsod nams dpal ldan/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ yab rje kun dga' blo gros man 'dra/ rjes gnang gi gsal byed som nyi'i mun sel zhu chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i lung ni de nyid kyi gsung 'bum brgyud pa ltar te 'og tu shes// ༈ /sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo 'od zer drug sbrags kyi skor la'ang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod rung bya ba rjes gnang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dngos gzhi dmigs khrid/ de dag gi rgyab rten lung gi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ tshar chen rin po che'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i rjes gnang la snyan brgyud zhal shes kyis brgyan te legs par thob pa'i rtsa ba'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen yan brgyud 'debs dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che/ zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta sogs kyi gsan yig rnams las shes sla/ de nas mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na mkhyen brtse las/ bslab gsum pa/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan gsum gyis gsan/ yab sras bzhi ga las dbang rab/ de las bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ de gnyis ka las zhwa lu mkhan chen gyis gsan pa man 'dra/ yang na kun blo nas/ na len+d+ra'i gzim 'og mchog sprul byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ smra dbang phrin las yon tan/ 'jam mgon bla ma byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na kun blo nas/ zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/

lnga rig pa kun dga' bkra shis/ yab rje kun dga' rin chen/ de sras 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de las so// yang na 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ rnam 'dren ngag gi dbang po/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// gnyis pa ni/ tshar chen rin po che'i nyams len snying po bsdus pa dang*/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dmigs rim skyabs yul zhing khams ma sbyar ba la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung sgros kyis brgyan pa mus mkhan rin chen chos ldan gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi steng nas nyams khrid rgyas par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zhwa lu mkhan chen yan rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang po rtsa ba'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ de nas/ 'dar grang chen mkhan po rin chen 'jam dpal/ brag rtsa ba blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ rje btsun bstan pa'i nyi ma/ yab rje kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ 'dren mchog ngag gi dbang po/ mtshungs med rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// yang tshar chen yab sras kyi yig cha'i steng nas dmigs khrid mdor bsdus su rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ rdo rje 'chang rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong rnams las thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang kun blo yan khrid kyi brgyud pa bshad ma thag pa ltar dang*/ de man so sor thob pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// gsum pa la/ sgrol dkar bka' babs tha dad pa thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i yig cha dang*/ 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yig cha'i skor gnyis las/ dang po la/ lo rgyus nas/ ce spyang sngon mo'i lam srung gi gsal byed bar gyi brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen nas/ mkhyen brtse/ bslab gsum pa/ dbang rab/ bka' 'gyur ba/

zhwa lu mkhan chen/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ kun blo/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*/ rdo rje byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po gnyis/ gnyis ka las so// yang na nam mkha' 'chi med nas/ mkhas dbang bla ma kun dga' don grub/ rje 'jam dpal bzang po gnyis/ de las so// yang na/ kun dga' don grub nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// gnyis pa la/ brgyud 'debs dang*/ nyams len snying po bsdus pa tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge/ zab khrid kyi dmigs rim zin bris/ sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don tshe dang bsod nams nyi ma bdun 'bar rnams mkhyen brtses mdzad pa/ rgyun khyer dbang rab kyis mdzad pa rnams las snga ma bzhi'i brgyud pa ni rtsa ba'i yig cha dang 'dra/ sbyin sreg dang rgyun khyer gnyis gnas gsar ba nas/ brag rtsa blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ 'jam mgon kun blo man 'dra/ rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa'i zin bris dang*/ gnas gsar bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma'i lung rgyun slar btsal/ tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa nag 'gros bklags chog tu bkod pa 'jam mgon kun blo'i gsung*/ kun blo nas bstan 'dzin phrin las/ phrin las yon tan/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na kun blo nas/ chos nyid ye shes sogs khrid kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge bde ldan mgon po zhal lung*/ de'i 'chad thabs skal bzang rna ba'i dga' ston/ bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i gsal byed nyer mkho'i yi ge srid zhi'i dge legs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig rnams mdzad pa po las so//

༈ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī'i lugs kyi rjes gnang thugs sras lo tsā ba/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ 'jam mgon kun blo rnams kyi yig cha'i sting nas so sor nod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ de wī swa ra swasti/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dzñā na bha dra mu nīn+d+ra/ lo chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' chos rgyal/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ ded dpon mkhyen brtse rab brtan/ gnyis ka las/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ kun blo/ dbyangs can grub pa bstan 'dzin phrin las/ phrin las yon tan/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na/ dpal ldan chos skyong yan gzhan du gsal/ de nas dbon rin chen mchog grub/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang*/ kun blo las nam mkha' 'chi med kyis gsan par bzhed pa'ang snang*/ yang na/ nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ shar chen kun bkras/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ zhwa lu mkhan chen/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che ngag dbang blo bzang brgya mtsho/ thugs sras 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ stag lung pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po/ gung thang pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ brag sgom zhabs drung rin po che ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// de'i rgyab rten lung gi skor la/ dbyangs can dkar mo'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs dang bcas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung rgyun bzhin thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ sku zhang nam mkha' chos rgyal/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra/

'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ byang gling pa rin chen rgyal po/ chos rje don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu mkhan chen/ rgyal dbang lnga pa/ gong dkar ba mang thos rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ dpal mang mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de las ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas dang*/ lha btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gnyis/ gnyis ka las so// paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang*/ rjes gnang gi kha skong dang bcas pa'i lung rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las brgyud pa'ang rjes gnang dang 'dra'am snyam/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen thabs dang*/ nyams len gyi yan lag mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa ni/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen bar de'i gsan yig ltar la/ de dbon ngag dbang dge legs lhun grub/ lha bya bla ma ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ khang gsar mkhan chen ngag dbang blo gros bzang po/ lho pa bla ma kun dga' dpal ldan/ bshes gnyen ngag dbang bstan pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa shes rab dpal 'bar 'jam mgon kun blos mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod/ sgrub thabs nyung gsal snying por dril ba/ bstod pa rmongs pa'i mun 'phrog rnams gzim 'og pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa rnams rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang po dang 'dra/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag blo gros sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig 'jam dbyangs bla ma byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas nos so// ring 'tsho'i cho ga sgrub pa'i rnam par gzhag pa 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa'i don 'grel tshe dbang dga' ba 'khyil pa'i thig le/

mdzad pa po 'jam mgon bla ma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mos rje btsun ras chung rdo rje grags pa la stsal ba'i tshe sgrub thun mong ma yin pa shin tu zab pa/ tshar chen rin po che'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston gyi steng nas tshe'i byin rlabs la brten nas tshe sring ba'i smin byed rgyas par nos nas/ lung la/ 'ba' ra bas mdzad pa'i tshe khrid rin chen gter mdzod kyi skor la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus shangs sgom rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yi ger bkod pa/ tshe dbang*/ bskyed chog bstod pa gdod nas rnam dag ma/ brgyud 'debs ye shes lnga ldan ma/ khrid yig 'bring po/ bsdus pa/ sgrub thabs tshigs bcad bka' rgya ma/ zhal shes thun mong ma yin pa rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bya bral chos rje/ skyes mchog smon lam dpal/ rje blo gros chos rgyal/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ mnyam med lha rtse ba/ rgyal ba dpag bsam dbang po/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub/ mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug dge legs bzhad pa/ 'jam mgon dgyes pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo/ kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba/ dge slong 'phags pa don grub/ rgyal dbang chos rje blo bzang rnam rgyal/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na/ kun dga' lhun grub nas rim par brgyud/ khams sprul thugs kyi rdo rje/ dge slong 'phags pa don grub man 'dra/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ te phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dbang phyug mi la ras chen/ rje dwags po lha rje/ rje phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ mnyam med yang dgon chos rje/ thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan/ kun mkhyen zur phug chos rje/

rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ rtogs ldan rin chen 'phel ba/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ bsod nams mchog grub/ rin chen bstan gsal/ blo gros chos 'phel/ ngag dbang ye shes/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ kun bzang chos dbyings rdo rje/ rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de las so// yang*/ wā gin+d+ra maṅga la las thob pa'i brgyud pa tshol/ tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston mdzad pa po man byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra'am snyam/ brgyud pa'i kha skong dag 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas nyid las so// blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa'i tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs lam rim gyi smon lam dang bcas pa mdzad pa po nas dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas las so// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i grub rgyal lugs kyi dbang mchog gi steng nas lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa/ 'ba' ra ba yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas mkhas btsun bde legs rin chen/ gangs can kun dga' dpal bzang*/ dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po/ chos rje dpal mgon

ldan mgon po/ pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ yab rje bsod nams rin chen/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las gsan pa yin snyam ste slar brtag/ ༈ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub grub rgyal ma'i dbang chog 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs kyi steng nas lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni slar tshol/ ༈ /gser chos tshe dpag med sprul sku'i rjes gnang rmor chen rjes mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ dzai tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ de la rje btsun rin po che dang*/ sgom pa rgya/ rje btsun pa las chos rje pa/ sgom pa rgya dang*/ chos rje pa gnyis ka las slob dpon do ba ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ yar klung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rings pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje mkhyen brtse/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje btsun rin chen rgya mtsho/ dol paṇa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros nas/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las gsan nam snyam/ lung la/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i rjes gnang gi yi ge/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub thabs brgyud yig bcas/

'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa pad+mo'i phreng ba/ rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul bsam 'phel nor bu bcas/ bsod rtse 'phags pa gnyis kyi gsung bka' 'bum ltar la yar klung pa'i yig cha btsal/ ༈ /stag lung pa bkra shis dpal grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med sprul sku'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu 'di ma byung*/ pa/ ras chung rdo rje grags/ bur sgom nag po/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ sku zhang rin chen bsod nams dpal/ chos sku o rgyan mgon po/ ye shes bzang po/ bla ma rgyal bzang*/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung bsod nams bkra shis/ rje drung mtsho skyes rdo rjes/ kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bkra shis dpal grub/ khyab bdag grags pa legs grub/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dam chos phrin las phun tshogs/ ngag dbang phrin las bstan 'dzin/ grub mchog sgom pa ngag dbang phul ldan/ bkra shis grags pa ye shes/ bkra shis dge legs bzang po/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de las so// yang na/ rje drung grags pa legs grub nas/ bkra shis 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ rje ngag dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang phrin las bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang phrin las mchog grub/ grags pa mang thos/ ngag dbang dpal 'phel/ ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rje chos dbyings lhun grub/ stag lung pa ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar na/ rje drung mtsho skyes rdo rje yan 'dra/ de nas kun dga' bkra shis/ tā ra nā tha la'o// ༈ /grub rgyal tshe dpag med dkar po yang gsang phyag bzhi pa ras chung lugs dpal stag lung pa la bka' babs pa'i byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi brgyud pa ni/

mgon po tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rnal 'byor pa bur sgom nag po/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ dpal stag lung thang pa rin po che sogs stag lung lugs kyi tshe dpag med sprul sku'i brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ /kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'i nye brgyud tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma tshar chen rin po che'i nyams len 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len gyi yi ge'i steng nas lung legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ kun mkhyen rong ston chos rje/ thugs sras nam mkha' dpal ldan/ rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ lha btsun ngag gi dbang phyug rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ bar 'dir kun blo yod min dpyad/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ kun dga' dpal bzang*/ kun dga' 'jam dpal/ de las so// yang na/ gnas gsar ba yan spyi dang 'dra/ de nas blo gsal phun tshogs/ kun dga' mkhyen rab/ 'gyur med mchog grub/ phrin las yon tan/ bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na/ gnas gsar ba nas/ sa chen kun blo/ 'dar grong slob dpon 'jam dpal rdo rje/ kun dga' dpal bzang*/ kun dga' 'jam dpal/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'khon ston rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// ༈ /tshe sgrub zab mo rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa'i lung ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ dzai tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/

slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rdo rje 'od/ 'khon ston shar pa/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ spang khang pa/ sru lung pa/ rje brag phug pa/ ri khrod grub chen/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ kun dga' rin chen/ bsod nams dbang po/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis/ bsod nams rin chen/ kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa bstan 'dzin/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// ༈ /'chi med rang gzungs su grags pa sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub zab mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul yig rnying gi steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ dgra bcom blo gros dpal/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen/ 'brug pa rgyal dbang chos rje/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ mi pham blo gros/ kun dga' lhun grub/ thub bstan rin chen/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dge legs dpal bzang*/ chos kyi dbang phyug thub bstan dar rgyas/ pad+ma lhun grub/ chos dbyings lhun grub/ dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal/ de sras bstan pa yar 'phel/ lha btsun don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na/ ye shes grub pa yan sngar ltar la/ de nas sangs rgyas grags pa/ bla ma rdo rje rin chen/ dka' bzhi pa dpal ldan grags pa/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung gzhon nu mchog grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog brag stod lha dbang grags pa/ rje mi pham blo gros nas 'dra'o// ༈ /khrid lung gi brgyud pa/ thub pa'i dbang po/ dgra bcom pa ma ti shrī/ bal po ha du tsan+d+ra/ dar ma chos/ grags/ mnga' ri dpal chen rgyal ba grub/ slob dpon ye shes rgyal ba/ shes rab rgyal mtshan nam shes rab grags pa/ ye shes grub pa/

bsod nams mgon po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/ dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la 'di'i rtsa ba rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sa lo chen po'i gsung ltar sngags la zhu dag bcas bkod pa mdzad pa po nas gong dang 'dra/ zhu chen rin po che nas mdzad pa gdams pa'i gsal byed yid ches sum ldan 'og tu shes/ brgyud 'debs ring 'tsho'i dpal ster 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa/ de nyid las so// ༈ /mgon po 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i dag snang sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa'i steng nas dbang lung legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ spyan ras gzigs/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ brgyud srol kun 'dus chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ don grub chos rgyal/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi nyi ma/ pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ dpal stag lung thang pa rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de las so// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po thang stong rgyal po'i nye brgyud tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster dpal sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi dbang chog rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/

grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rje rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las so// thang rgyal tshe dbang phyag len rgyas par gnang ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams yan spyi ltar la/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ grub dbang sangs rgyas bstan pa/ chen po byams pa chos rgyal/ lce btsun bstan 'dzin phrin las/ khyab bdag ye shes dpal 'byor/ rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de las so// yang na/ lnga pa rin po che zhwa lu mkhan chen/ rin chen 'jam dpal/ 'jam dpal mkhyen brtse/ byams pa chos rgyal man 'dra/ yang na/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ kha rag chos rje bod 'brug pa blo gsal phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin phrin las man 'dra'o// ༈ /yang*/ tshe dbang thang rgyal ma'i brgyud pa ni/ kun blo nas/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ dbang sdud snying po/ a ṇi drung*/ gsum ga las rje bla ma phrin las rab rgyas/ de las so// yang na nam mkha' 'chi med las/ mkhan chen mched gnyis/ gnyis ka las phrin rab/ yang na/ dbang sdud snying po las/ khri chen dang*/ kun dga' rin chen gnyis/ gnyis ka las phrin las rab rgyas/ yang na byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las/ byams pa 'jam dpal grags pa/ bla ma phrin las rab rgyas/ yang na byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ rje grub thob chen po'i gsung rtsa ba/ nye brgyud 'chi med dpal ster sgrub thabs/

dbang gi tho/ dbang chog 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya bdud kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa bcas/ nam mkha' 'chi med yan gong ltar la/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams dpal bzang*/ de las so// ༈ /rig 'dzin chos rje gling pa'am 'dzam gling rdo rje'i dag snang thang rgyal tshe sgrub shin tu nye brgyud lo brgya mar grags pa'i tshe dbang de nyid kyi yig steng nas lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ tshe dpag med/ dpal chen rta mgrin pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ gter ston chos rje gling pa/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje/ rig 'dzin smon lam rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang bstan 'phel/ bstan 'dzin mkhyen rab mthu stobs/ de las so// ༈ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dze tā ris legs par bkral ba'i rjes su gnang ba ngor cher dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ gsang 'dzin phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon dzai tā ri'am dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bsod nams dpal ba/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog blo gros/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ kun dga' dpal 'byor/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/

rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rtog pa'i ṭī ka rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i gsung la grags pas gsal byed gnang ba/ de'i bsdus don/ sgrub thabs stong mchod rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ gzungs ring*/ bstod pa 'chi med dpal sbyin ma ngor chen gyis mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ kha skong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ chos skor gyi rnam gzhag rab tu gsal ba/ bsnyen thabs bcas dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od snang sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni so so'i bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa sogs ltar te 'og tu shes// ༈ /nges brjod bla ma'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i 'chi med rdo rje'i lha mo'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang*/ man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor la/ rje btsun grags pa'i gzhung*/ ngor chen gyi 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams ngag dngos grub kyi rgyal po/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgom bzlas la brten nas 'chi med kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i gdams ngag sgrub thabs rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs te 'di dag gi lung brgyud so so'i bka' 'bum dang*/ gzhung gi brgyud pa ltar ro// skra sen sreg pa'i cho ga bde legs nyi ma zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa ni bka' 'bum brgyud pa ltar// ༈ /dbon ston skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i bzang spyod 'chi slu'i gzhung rtsa ba'i brgyud pa btsal/ ༈ /bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi'i cho ga kha che ye shes rdo rjes spyod rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi mdzad pa'i dkyil chog phrin las lhun grub kyi steng nas dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ grub brnyes 'chi med zhabs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/ grags 'byor shes rab/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dkar shākya grags pa/ de dpon kun dga' dpal/ dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po/ byang chub seng ge/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ rje lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rigs kun khyab bdag byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang ngag dbang legs grub/ yang na/ nam mkha' 'chi med nas/ gyang ra bla ma grags pa rab rgyas/ ngag dbang bzang po/ rje bla ma ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// ༈ /dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti'am mtshan gzhan sgeg pa'i rdo rjer grags pas 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub pa'i rgyud la brten nas legs par bkral ba'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i chos skor la/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma ti'i zhabs/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ bsod nams shes rab/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon po/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/

rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bkol ba ni bka' 'gyur rgyud 'bum gyi brgyud pa ltar/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ bskyed rim dang mthun par bstod pa/ lo rgyus/ rjes gnang gi yi ge paṇa chen phyag bzhes khro los mdzad pa/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs las kha tshar bzhi bcas rgya ston gyis sbyar ba rnams kyi brgyud pa 'og gser pod brgyud pa ltar/ sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa bsod snyoms pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i lung brgyud ni/ bsod snyoms pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dag snang rol pa/ mkhyen rab phrin las dbang po/ gzim 'og gong ma bstan 'dzin phrin las/ phrin las yon tan/ bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen pa'i lag len rnam gsal dang*/ brgyud 'debs zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/

bsnyen sgrub kha skong gi sbyin sreg ye shes 'od snang*/ las tshogs 'dod don lhun grub bcas sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa rnams so so'i bka' 'bum brgyud pa ltar ro// ༈ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas 'phags pa bzhad pa'i rol gar kun gzigs si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i lung*/ mdzad pa po nas/ karma pa bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa sā ga ra/ de las so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa zhes 'jam dbyangs mjing yon ma'i bstod pa'i lung*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī nas/ rje dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i bar gzhan du gsal/ de nas kaṃ tshang chos spyod kyi brgyud pa ltar/ mkhan po karma mkhyen brtse/ chos kyi dbang phyug karma nyi ma/ karma phrin las/ rgyal dbang ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed/ dbon sprul dbang gi rdo rje/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ kun gzigs yon tan rgya mtsho/ de las so// ༈ /rje btsun dam pa rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor la/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nyin byed dang rjes gnang gi yi ge bklags pas don grub kyi steng nas rjes gnang legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge/ lha mo dbyangs can ma/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas/ kha che gu hā dzñā na/ glan sgom yab sras/ 'od zer shākya/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ skyi ston kīrti dhā dza/ dol bu shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/

pradzñā dh+wa dza/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ ye shes bzang po/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na lha mchog seng ge yan gong ltar la/ de nas dkon mchog lhun grub/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ brang ti paṇa chen nas nam mkha' bsam 'grub bar gong dang 'dra/ de nas/ ngag dbang shes rab/ rin chen grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i gsung gi sgrub thabs rje ka ma la shī las mdzad pa nas/ dbang sdud 'khor lo 'bri tshul gyi gsal byed bar yig rnying gi lung 'og gser pod brgyud yig las 'byung ba ltar dang*/ sgrub rjes yig lung rjes gnang dang 'dra'am snyam/ smra seng sgrub thabs yig rnying*/ rjes gnang bklag pas don grub/ bogs 'don sgrub skor nyin byed snang ba/ brgyud 'debs blo gros rgyas byed rnams sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs nor bu'i phreng ba yongs 'dzin dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag ngag 'don dang bcas pa ye shes mchog gi nyi ma 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa rnams las dpal grub gsung rnams rjes gnang dang 'dra la/ gzhan gnyis so so'i mdun nas so// ༈ /ngag gi dbang phyug smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs snyan pa'i rol mor 'khrol ba gzhon nu rnam par rol pa kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi gsung ltar 'jam mgon thams cad gzigs pa yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa rje nyid nas so// 'jam dbyangs smra seng sgrub thabs mkhas grub karma chags med kyis mdzad pa'i lung btsal// ༈ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi skor dpal sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i rjes gnang thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ grub chen dze tā ri/ 'dir mya ngan med dpal/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po rol pa'i rdo rje/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ brtse chen kun dga' snying po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dpal chen rgwa lo/ de sras rong pa sher seng*/ grags pa seng ge/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ bsod nams lhun grub/ ngag dbang brtan rdor/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ bkra shis dpal ldan/ kun dga' rin chen/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas mkhas grub do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang pa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bsod nams dbang phyug brag lung pa rin chen dpal/ chos kyi grags pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen man 'dra/ sa lo 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyi yig steng nas rjes gnang lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ngor chen nas dkon mchog lhun grub bar 'dra/ de nas dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ byams pa smon lam grags pa/ de las so// lung la/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs kyi gsal byed/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mchod brjod sa paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs blo 'phel gser gyi phreng mdzes dang*/

rjes gnang gcig shes kun khyab sa lo kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs gegs sel dang bcas pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa rnams las sa lo'i gsung ma gtogs pa'i gzhan so so'i bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /byams pa'i rnam 'phrul g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma'i dag snang 'jam dbyangs dang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sbags te sgrub pa'i byin rlabs mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ chos rje sa paṇa/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/ 'bras mo ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang chos grags/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar bstod pa chos rgyal ma yar klung pas mdzad pa/ mjug tu skye ba skye ba sogs/ rnam thar sgom tshul g.yag pa sangs rgyas dpal bas mdzad pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs bya tshul ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa/ sa 'jam sbags te sgrub pa'i nyams len kun bsod gsung bzhin kun dga' tshul khrims kyis bris pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i char 'bebs 'jam mgon kun blos mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ rtsa ba'i lung brgyud btsal/ rje sa paṇa/ bla mchod gong ma tog ti shrī grags pa 'od zer/ kun dga' smon lam/ dkon mchog grags pa/ g.yag chos kyi bla ma/ rong ston no// zhes 'byung ba brtag yig cha gzhan dag gi lung brgyud slar btsal//

༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta gser gdugs can nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po shes rab 'khor lo'i rjes gnang rmor chen yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ paṇa chen gser gdugs can/ zla 'byung sbas pa/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ dri ma med pa'i dpal/ rnam par bshad pa'i lha/ shākya dpal/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bsod nams rin chen/ dbang phyug chos rgyal/ chos grags dpal bzang*/ khro phu rin chen 'bum/ bsod nams bzang po/ seng ge dpal ba/ rin chen bzang po/ chos grub seng ge/ rat+na bha dra/ 'gyur med bde chen/ dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ kun dga' bsod nams/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// lung la/ 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gsal bar bkod pa ma nor gsal sgron rmor chen rin po ches mdzad pa ste gong dang 'dra'am// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon rdo rje mtshon cha la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis zhal gzigs pa'i tshe bstod pa gang blo ma'am dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod sgrub kyi rig gtad rmor chen rin po che'i yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs slob dpon rdo rje mtshon cha/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ khyung rin chen grags pa/ rgya dmar ba byang chub grags pa/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ dan 'bag pa dar ma seng ge/ gnyal zhig pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ zangs ri pa dar ma tshul khrims/ gra thang pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/

thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma bkra shis rin chen/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun ma bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ bstod pa gang blo ma phan yon dang bcas pa lo chen 'gyur/ rjes gnang gi tho yig tshar chen gsung*/ rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog rmor chen gyis mdzad pa ste slar btsal// ༈ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal sgrub thabs brgya rtsa las byung ba'i rjes gnang rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs dpal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lhun grub dpal ldan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ bsod nams rin chen/ kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas phyung ba'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs ba ri'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs dang*/

de'i sa bcad rje sa chen gyi gsung*/ sgrub thabs rin po che'i them skas zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa// ༈ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'don thabs rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa rnams las sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ltar dang*/ gzhan so so'i gsung 'bum ltar ro// ༈ /bram ze phur bu'i lugs kyi dbyangs can ma dkar mo dpal bsam yas pa ngag gi dbang po'i bka' srol las byung ba'i rjes gnang rje 'gyur med rdo rje'i sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo bum bzang gi steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni 'dod bum ltar te logs su shes/ lung la/ sgrub thabs ngag gi 'od zer bram ze phur bus mdzad pa sum pa lo tsā'i 'gyur/ las sbyor gyi rtsa ba drang srong mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa/ phur bus mdzad pa'i bstod pa grub pa ngag gi 'od zer/ sgrub thabs 'od kyi drwa ba kun mkhyen dri med pas mdzad pa la nang gses sgrub thabs/ gegs sel/ las sbyor dam tshig dang bcas pa/ bstod pa rab dga'i dbyangs/ de'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga snying por dril ba gnyis rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes mdzad pa las/ rgya gzhung rtsa ba'i brgyud pa btsal/ dri med 'od zer gyi gsung rnams de nyid kyi gsung thor bu'i lung brgyud ltar dang*/ 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung rnams gong rjes gnang dang 'dra// ༈ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa ring brgyud bram ze phur bu'i lugs kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa tshigs bcad ma'i lung gi brgyud pa dang*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas byed dbyangs can grub pa rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni slar btsal// ༈ /bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dbyangs can dga' ba nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha'i steng nas lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

lha mo dbyangs can ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī lā ka ra/ tsan+d+ra shrī/ go taṃ shrī/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags rgyal/ bo dong paṇa chen dbyangs can dga' ba/ stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ glang thang spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rje ngag gi dbang po/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// nye brgyud kyi lha mo dbyangs can ma/ paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa man 'dra'am snyam/ lung la/ sgrub thabs rtsa ba 'bum khri lnga stong bzla bar bya'o'i mtha' can/ zab mo'i gdams pa'i gegs sel/ gegs sel khyad par can/ sgrub thabs gegs sel spogs chog dang bcas pa/ ril bu sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang*/ dbyangs can gyi bstod pa/ yang bstod pa dbyangs can mgul rgyan/ rgyan gyi phreng ba/ byin rlabs kyi snang ba bcas paṇa chen dbyangs can dga' ba nyid kyi gsung ste rjes gnang dang 'dra// ༈ /dbyangs can ma'i sgom bzlas tam+bu ra'i dbyangs snyan kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i lung*/ mdzad pa po nas/ karma bdud 'dul rdo rje/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa sa mu dra/ de las so// ༈ /kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bik+ṣa pa ra ma nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang shin tu zab pa rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa la bka' babs gsum dang ldan pa las/ dang po sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/

lha mo dbyangs can ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta bik+ṣa pa ra ma/ bde gshegs srung ba/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya ka 'od byed 'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shī la/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba mchog

phyag bris su ma byung dbyangs/ nam mkha' bsod nams/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dwags po karma phrin las/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bod mkhar chos rje mai tri/ gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur dpal 'byor phrin las rab rgyas/ lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen dge ba'i dbang po/ ngag dbang sbyin pa/ blo gros dbang phyug blo gsal phun tshogs/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ bstan pa'i sgron me/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// gnyis pa rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya ka rngog lo blo ldan shes rab/ 'bri shes rab 'bar/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge gtsang nag pa mi'i seng ge/ lha sa'i bla ma rngog khu dbon gnyis/ rgyal tsha lung mang po man 'dra/ gsum pa mar do lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ku sā li pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rgyal po rā dza kā ya/ de'i yig mkhan paṇ+ḍi ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ bal po dha ma tā ma/ de gnyis ka la lo tsā ba mar po do pa chos kyi dbang phyug gze pa blo ldan/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ sras dharma kīrti/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen man 'dra'o// yang na/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i yig cha'i steng nas lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gzhan sngar ltar la/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ rje bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/

dbal mang dkon mchog phyag bris su med/ rgyal mtshan/ rje bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// lung la/ rje dbon blo gsal dbang pos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs/ phrin las yon tan gyis kha skong mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor 'bul/ bstod pa/ rjes gnang bcas yig rnying*/ nyams len bya tshul dang*/ rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me rmor chen gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub bya tshul blo gros nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta dang*/ rjes gnang bya tshul yid kyi mun sel dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos mdzad pa ste/ 'di'i gsung gong dang 'dra la/ gzhan btsal// ༈ /bo dong lugs kyi dbyangs can dmar mo gsang sgrub lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa 'jigs bral dgyes pa'i lam srol rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa gong dbyangs can dkar mo dang 'dra'am snyam// ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon po/ 'od byed 'byung gnas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shī la/ 'dul 'dzin byang chub sems dpa'/ chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo rings kun spangs chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ mi g.yo ba/

a bha yā ka ra/ a nan+tā ka ra gup+ta/ slob dpon lhan skyes/ dā na shī la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge/ bcom ldan ral gri/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ bla ma dar ma bzang po/ bsod nams shes rab/ shes rab mgon po/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ yon tan dpal ba/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ rin chen mchog grub/ rin chen tshul khrims/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man 'dra/ yang na yon tan khri nas/ gzhon nu grags pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ sangs rgyas dpal ba/ rong ston man 'dra'o// lung la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ shes rab blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs bcud kyi snying po bkod pa/ zhal gdams gsum/ rjes gnang*/ lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya nyams len gnad dang bcas pa/ bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan rnams mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa rnams gser pod brgyud par gsal/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa de nyid kyi bka' 'bum ltar ro// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon chen po kaṅka dat+ta'i bka' srol las byung ba'i rdo rje phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed gyi byin rlabs sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ slob dpon kaṅka dat+ta/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa/ su tsa rista ste legs spyod/ rin chen srung ba/ ma na ka shrī/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ gu lung pa mdo sde rgyal mtshan snang*/ dpal/ shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ kun dga' mchog ldan/

mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na lung bcas/ khri chen pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug yan tshol/ de nas/ bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ rje bla ma ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// yang na/ dpang lo nas/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen man 'dra/ lung la/ shes rab kyi snang ba sgrub pa'i cho ga slob dpon kaṅka dat+tas mdzad pa lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ phag dkar shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa/ bstod tshig shes bya rab gsal sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa rnams gong gsal ltar/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi rjes gnang la sa lugs mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha dang*/ skyer sgang lugs gtso bor gyur pa brgyud pa'i khyad par gnad 'dus 'jam mgon kun blo'i yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ jo bo rje mar me mdzad/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba shes rab 'bar/ ba yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ des mnga' ris shes rab rgyal mtshan/ lce sgom shes rab rdo rje gnyis/ gnyis kas dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/ gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ shangs ston rin chen rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims 'bum/ gnyan ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha' rnal 'byor/

mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po// yang na/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros nas/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na/ bstan 'dzin phrin las nas/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ de las so// yang sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā/ rje sa chen/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs dpal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje sems dpa' chen po man 'dra/ nye brgyud ltar na/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po nyid kyis mus chen sems dpa' chen po la dngos su gnang ba ste brgyud srol thams cad 'di nyid la 'dus so// lung la/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa ba ri lo tsā'i 'gyur/ phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ de'i cho ga 'phags pa mnyes byed sa lugs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa/ smre sngags kyi bstod pa byin rlabs can slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman go bde jo lugs sa lugs skyer sgang lugs bcas gcig 'dus 'jam mgon kun blos mdzad pa la gsal byed cung zad rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa/

sbyin sreg phrin las rab rgyas dang*/ skyer sgang lugs kyi yi ge drug pa'i las tshogs nyer mkho btus pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa bcas so so'i bka' 'bum dang*/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs ba ri brgya rtsa ltar dang*/ bstod pa'i brgyud pa 'og tu shes// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyi yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen gong ma lnga/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ kun dga' legs pa/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ zhal dkar ba ngag dbang shes rab/ rin chen grags pa/ dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// lung la/ jo bo thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul rje sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ rjes gnang thugs rje'i chu rgyun zhu chen gyis mdzad pa/ nyams len mdo khams shar phyogs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rnams bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la thugs rje chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i snying po yi ge drug pa'i nyams len gyi sgom lung gzhung rtsa ba'i yig rnying la phyag len gyis brgyan pa'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rdo rings pa kun spangs chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ grub mchog ngag dbang nyi ma/ bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ blo bzang bstan 'phel/ bstan 'dzin brgyad pa mkhyen rab mthu stobs/ de las so// lung la/ gzhung rtsa ba rje grol mchog gsung gong ltar dang*/ de'i bsgaum lung 'bogs tshul gzhan phan mkha' khyab dang*/ sgom bzlas kyi ngag 'don mdo sngags yongs bcud 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi mdzad pa de nyid las/ rje grub thob chen po dge slong pad+ma dkar por skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pa'i rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can kyang gong dang 'dra'am snyam/ thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs bcu gcig zhal gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu/ paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes bzang po/ bal po pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub chen nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jig mkhan chen rtsi 'dul ba thugs rje byang chub/ mkhan chen ldog lhod pa'am bde ba can pa/ byang sems chu bzang pa dbang phyug byang chub/ 'bar/ rin po che shes rab 'bum pa/ rgyal sras dngul chu thogs med bzang po dpal/ rje bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ kun dga' legs pa/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bsod nams bzang dpal ldan/ po/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/

sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ gnyis ka las mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las so// yang na/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub nas/ ngag dbang shes rab/ rin chen grags pa/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na zhu chen yan de'i gsan yig ltar la/ ye paṇa ngag dbang rab rgyas/ bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ chos rje dge legs rgya mtsho/ de las so// lung la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa lo chen rin bzang 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen thabs dri med phreng ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa ste so so'i gsung 'bum ltar dang*/ dpal mo'i rgya gzhung gzhan du shes/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs bcu gcig zhal la bde gshegs rigs bzhis bskor ba lha lnga'i rjes gnang sangs rgyas dpal bzang yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thugs rje chen po/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ zla ba gzhon nu/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzñā na bha dra/ bal po pe nya ba/ byang sems zla rgyal/ nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ rtse 'dul thugs rje byang chub/ mkhan chen bde ba can pa/ chu bzang pa dbang phyug 'bar/ shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ shākya don grub/ kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rmor pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros/ 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/

mang thos don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs rigs bzhis bskor ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga gzhan phan zla snang rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa/ ༈ /de dang rjes su 'brel ba dge slong ma dpal mo'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs smyung gnas dang bcas pa'i cho ga sdig sgrib rnam sbyong*/ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs 'dren pa'i shing rta bcas zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa rje bla mas bklags chog tu zhal skong gnang

rjes gnang gi rtsa ba'i brgyud pa 'di kho na'o/ ba/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgyal sras thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal ngag 'don dang*/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tho// ༈ /theg chen gso sbyong rang gis len pa'i cho ga bklags chog bcas/ gzhan gnyis so so'i bka' 'bum ltar dang*/ gso sbyong rnam rgyal stong mchod ltar/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs mkha' 'gro lnga bskor gyi bum pa'i dbang*/ sngags kyi dbang*/ phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba dang bcas pa skyid shod sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las kyi gsung zin bris steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu/ jo bo a ti sha/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ bal po pe nya/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos kyi grags pa/ bshes gnyen grags pa tshul khrims/ bshes gnyen klu sgrub mtshan can/ bka' bzhi pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shes rab brtson 'grus/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ rje rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen grub/ bla ma rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gnas rnying pa kun dga' bde legs/ paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rta tshag pa blo bzang e waṃ/ sras khang sngags rams pa bzang po rnam rgyal/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur kun mkhyen dpal 'byor phrin las rab rgyas/ kun gzigs lnga pa rin po che blo bzang rgya mtsho/ pha bong kha pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ klong rdol gsan yig las/ grub brnyes 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ snang*/ sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtsho/ phur bu lcog ngag dbang byams pa/ bde 'byor dpon slob ngag dbang don grub/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal sras skal bzang thub bstan/ bkra shis lhun po bshes gnyen ye shes bkra shis/ shar rtse rdo rje 'chang blo bzang yon tan/ mkhas grub chen po dam tshig rdo rje/

chu bzang ba skal bzang mkhas grub/ bshes gnyen bka' 'gyur pa chen po grags pa klu sgrub/ mchog sprul rin po che ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho thugs rje yongs grags dpal de las so// yang na/ lnga pa yan sngar smos pa ltar la/ de nas sgrub khang pa dge legs rgya mtsho/ rje ngag dbang byams pa/ byes zur ngag dbang don grub/ brag ri rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho mtha' yas/ spang lung pa ngag dbang chos 'dzin/ ser rtse'i dge bshes skal bzang thogs med dam skal bzang mkhas grub/ snang*/ lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs mkha' 'gro lnga bskor gyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga gzhan phan zla zer rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa// ༈ /slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas bkral zhing ba ri lo tsā nas brgyud pa'i don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i rjes gnang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ shī lā ka ra/ bai ro tsa na/ e rang pa ti/ rigs ngan rnal 'byor ma/ don yod rdo rje/ dharma pā la/ bsod snyoms pa chen po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ gtsang tsong po/ pa zhor ba/ la ru pa/ bla ma grags chen pa dpal/ pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ 'dir bu ston snang*/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ rje ting 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung nas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ chos nyid ye shes/ ye shes rgyal mchog bya gshong slob zur blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'khon ston rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ rmor chen nas/

dpal ldan chos skyong*/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ bsod nams dpal bzang*/ chos nyid ye shes man 'dra/ lung la/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa'i cho ga bya rgyud ltar sgrub lugs rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod/ lha lnga'i bstod pa dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa/ srung 'khor bri tshul/ bri thabs dngos/ don zhags lha lnga'i sgrub thabs thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang go bde bklags chog ngag chos kyis mdzad pa bcas/ gzhan bka' 'bum ltar dang*/ ngag chos gsung rjes gnang dang 'dra// ༈ /slob dpon a ba dhū tī pa la ye shes mkha' 'gros dngos su gdams pa dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can mdo lugs mdze gsos kyi che ba jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ gser gling pa a ba dhū tī/ jo bo rje a ti sha/ dge bshes rong pa mgar rin brgyud du med/ dge/ dge bshes mdzang gyad phu ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla chen bsod blo/ theg chen chos rje/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ rje drung ye shes rgya mtsho/ grub chen kun bzang dbang po/ kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho/ de las so// rin 'byung lung brgyud/ tshe dbang nor bu nas/ sprul sku kun dga' rnam rgyal/ lo chen tshe dbang kun khyab/ karma nges don bstan 'dzin/ karma 'od gsal 'gyur med/

kun gzigs yon tan rgya mtsho/ de las so// yang 'di la/ phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo man chad bka' gdams lha bzhi ltar ded kyang chog yang ba ri lugs ltar na/ rje btsun sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa chen/ grags pa nas 'dra'o// lung la/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gzungs zhes bya ba'i cho ga rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur rgyud 'bum ltar dang*/ gzungs lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rgyas par bshad pa rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa bka' 'bum ltar/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rin 'byung yig rnying bsdebs pa'i bklags chog rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa bcas// ༈ /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos bkral ba'i phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang zhu chen rin po che'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze sadz+dza na/ jo bo dzi ta de ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston/ dpyal bsod nams rin chen/ 'jid phu pad+ma bkra shis/ rtag pa jo bzang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug bsod nams seng ge/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub/ rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ de las rdo rings pa dang*/ sgo rum pa gnyis/ gnyis kas tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ de gnyis kas mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ dam chos bzang po/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ des rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho dang*/ 'phags pa lha ye shes bstan pa'i mgon po gnyis/

gnyis kas rje rin chen don grub/ bstan 'dzin phrin las bzang po/ bla ma sbyin pa chos 'phel/ rin chen lhun grub/ ngag dbang bzang po/ ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas las te slar brtag lung la/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa zangs dkar lo tsā'i 'gyur/ gtor ma/ rdzas sngags sman gyi 'khrul 'khor/ bskrad pa/ bsnun pa/ sbyin sreg bcas rje bla ma'i mchan can mdzad pa po dang sgyur byed gong dang 'dra/ khrus chog mdzad byang med pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga mkhas pa'i zhal lung zhu chen gyis mdzad pa bcas/ gzhan btsal/ zhu chen yig cha bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi yi dam sgrub skor e waṃ gyi yig steng nas phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi rjes gnang zur bka'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi yongs 'dzin blo bzang las gsan pa de nyid kyi gsan yig na gsal zhing*/ zhi ba lha'i gsan yig ltar na/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can/ grub thob sha ba ri pa/ grub thob dza pa ri pa/ de ba puṇ+ḍa ma ti/ mgar lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ gshin ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dmar shes rab rdo rje/ dmar thub pa shes rab/ dmar brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dmar shākya grub pa/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang*/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang blo gros/ mal ston tshul khrims rin chen/ sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang*/ sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ rig 'dzin 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mkhar rdo bzod pa rgya mtsho/ rje ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ mtshungs med ngag dbang legs grub/

yongs 'dzin dge legs rgya mtsho/ zhi bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ rje byams pa blo gros/ chab mdo gling smad slob zur 'phags pa mchog dga'/ ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na/ dmar shākya grub pa nas/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ chos rje rin chen legs pa/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan/ zhwa lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rgyud pa shes rab bzang po/ mkhas grub nyi ma bkra shis/ mkhas grub bde legs nyi ma/ sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o/ lung la/ dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ rtsa sngags sam phreng sngags su grags pa 'grol bcas gong dang 'dra/ rjes gnang gi cho ga rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa bcas// ༈ /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mjal zhing mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug snye mdo bla chen shākya dpal ba nas brgyud pa phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed sems dpa' sum brtsegs me dbang bzhi dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje'i yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ bla chen shākya dpal/ bla chen chos dpal ba/ chos rje bod 'brug pa gnyis kas/ byams pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ chos rje lha dbang blo gros/ chos rje grags pa nus mthu/ mkhan chen bsod nams dbang po/ rje shākya seng ge/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen rin chen 'jam dpal/ rin chen 'jam dpal mkhyen brtse/ bla ma 'jam dpal bzang po/ byang gling pa 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ byang gling pa smon lam bsam gtan/ chos rje ye shes dpal 'byor/ mchog sprul rin po che blo gsal bstan skyong*/ rje bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// yang na 'jam dpal bzang po nas/ lce btsun bstan 'dzin phrin las/

chos rje ye shes dpal 'byor man 'dra/ lung la/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa byams pa rin chen dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo'i 'dod gsol bcas gong dang 'dra'am snyam zhing*/ kun blo'i me dbang*/ kun blo/ gong ma/ gu ṇa yan 'dra zhes snang ba slar dpyad// ༈ /phyag rdor u tsar+ya drag sngags kyis che ba zhes gsungs pa'i rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas lung bcas la legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ zla ba grags dpe gcig la med/ pa/ tsan+d+ra gau mī/ chos kyi rgyal po'am dharma pha nor ram/ la/ bla ma zangs gling pa/ khams pa a seng*/ zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ ru smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston pa/ dkon mchog blo gros/ chos kyi grags pa/ e pa 'khon ston/ mchog ldan pa/ rgyal ba 'od zer/ slob dpon smra ba'i seng ge/ byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo kun dga' legs 'byung*/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ sa chen kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ kun dga' rin chen/ rdo rje rin chen/ rje bla ma bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// yang na/ khams pa a seng nas/ jo sras gnyal pa rin chen 'od/ bla chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ jo sras me 'bar/ bla ma don zhags pa/ bla ma lha rje/ slob dpon chos grags man 'dra'o// yang na/ ngor chen nas/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/

lung la/ sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas pa/ rjes gnang bya tshul bcas dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /stag lung pa bkra shis dpal grub kyi yig cha'i steng nas ras chung lugs kyi gtum po khra thogs kyi rjes gnang stag lung phyogs nas brgyud pa dang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi yig steng nas ras chung lugs kyi gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes gnang grub chen las kyi rdo rje nas dge phyogs la brgyud pa gnyis ras chung pa'i bar 'dra ba lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan las gsan pa'i tshul gzhan du shes/ lung la/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i yi ge rdo rje'i me khrid rje bla ma'i gsung 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi zhal skong gnang ba// ༈ /lho brag phyag rdor snyan brgyud kyi skor las/ rta phyag khyung ste gnyen po'i lha gsum gcig tu dril ba'i skor las phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes gnang rta tshag rje drung blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa/ gnyal gung snang chos rje mdzes pa dpal bzang po/ blo gros mchog ldan mdzes pa/ seng ge dpal ldan mdzes pa/ nam mkha' dpal ldan mdzes pa/ nam mkha' chos bzang mdzes pa/ nam mkha' 'od mdzes bzang po/ nam mkha' lhun grub dpal mdzes/ nam mkha' mdzes pa dpal/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bsod nams 'od mdzes/ dpal 'byor don yod mdzes pa/ shes rab grags mdzes/ nyi zla 'od mdzes/ dpal ldan mgon po mdzes pa'i rdo rje/ mkhas grub mgon po mdzes pa'i dbang phyug grub dbang 'phags pa bstan dar/ brag g.yab chu bar bla ma dge 'dun bkra shis/ klong rdol grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang*/ lcags ra sprul sku ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang*/

dga' ldan khri chen blo bzang bkra shis/ chu bzang dge bshes skal bzang mkhas grub/ rdo rje 'chang ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho/ de las so// lung la/ drag po gsum bsgril gyi dmigs pa las kyi rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa ni gong dang 'dra la/ sgrub thabs rdo rje pha lam rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho/ lcags ra sprul sku ngag dbang phrin las dpal bzang*/ klong rdol grub chen ngag dbang blo bzang*/ mang thos khyab bdag rdo rje/ bzhi sde dpon slob shes rab rgya mtsho/ bde yangs dge bshes ye shes rgya mtsho/ grub mchog blo bzang shes rab dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho/ de las so// ༈ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum rje btsun sgrol ma dkar po yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skor la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa la bka' babs dgu dang ldan pa las/ dang po jo bo thugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje a ti sha/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen/ zhang sum thog pa/ zhang ka tshal ba/ bla ma lha/ slob dpon rin chen bzang po/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dka' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos rin dpal ba/ chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ thugs rje can rin chen bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ de dbon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/
