mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ de la byams pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis/ gnyis ka las sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ bla ma dam pa nas/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na pa/ kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri pa rin chen rgyal mchog rdzong dkar ba shes rab rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros man 'dra/ yang na/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal nas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub man 'dra'o// bka' babs gnyis pa sa lugs ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dzai tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ gsum pa gnyan lugs ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ grub chen ma ti/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen man 'dra/ bzhi pa paṇa chen lugs ni/ sgrol ma/ kha che paṇa chen/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa man 'dra/ lnga pa nags rin lugs ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ de dbon kun dga' grol mchog chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin man 'dra/ drug pa a bha ya'i lugs ni/

sgrol ma/ a bha ya/ shu bhaṃ ka ra/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ gau taṃ shrī/ kīrti tsan+d+ra/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ sher seng*/ bag ston/ shes rab seng ge/ rin chen 'phel/ ye shes 'phel/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma byang sems/ rgyam pa yon tan 'od/ shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ skud lung pa sangs rgyas dpal/ rje 'phags pa rin chen/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal man 'dra/ bdun pa dpyal lugs ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ niṣ+ka laṃ ka dpyal chos bzang pad+ma can/ a mo gha/ gzhon nu dpal/ thar lo/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ brgyad pa rngog lugs ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mar pa/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ mdo sde/ kun dga'/ gzi brjid grags pa/ rin chen bzang po/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ byang chub dpal/ byams pa gling pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal man 'dra/ dgu pa sgar lugs ni/ sgrol ma/ karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa man 'dra'o// de dang lhan cig rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dang*/ bstod pa/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i lhan thabs/ bkra shis lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs rnams kyi lung yang thob bo// zhes snang*/ lung la/ tshe sbyin sgrol ma'i mngon rtogs las dang po pas nyams su blang bde kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i gsung zin bris dang*/ rjes gnang shin tu zab pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs bum mchog rjes gnang dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i zur 'debs sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ ka bstod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dkon lhun dang*/ 'dod don gsol 'debs glo bo mkhan chen/ brgyud 'debs dngos grub 'dod 'jo bkra shis lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rje bla ma'i kha skong can/

bsnyen pa bya tshul yi ge'i zla 'od gsar pa/ rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs rje bla ma'i kha skong can tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod don kun 'grub/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho bcas sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa bcas kyi gong gsal las gzhan so so'i bka' 'bum ltar dang 'phro btsal// ༈ /mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i be'u bum la/ lo rgyus/ sgrub skor/ rjes gnang*/ las tshogs dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni slar btsal// ༈ /mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho nas brgyud pa'i sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjes gnang khyad par can rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yig cha'i steng nas lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ se ra chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen bde legs nyi ma/ sgam sde pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ kun gzigs lnga pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs phrin las lhun grub/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ rje bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ brag dgon zhabs drung rin po che dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// lung la/ yid bzhin 'khor lo nye brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ bstod pa tshe dang ye shes spel ba rin po che'i phreng ba paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis mdzad pa bcas/ 'di'i lung klong rdol gsan yig ltar na/ mdzad pa po nas/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ ka chen chos dpal ba/ tshogs gsog pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho/

sprul sku dge legs rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams nyi ma/ slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ khri chen sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ ka chen ye shes yar 'phel/ zhang zhung pa ye shes mtha' yas/ dge slong blo bzang bsam gtan/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang tshul khrims/ sngags chen rdo rje 'dzin pa/ ka chen nyi ma tshul khrims/ dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// ༈ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i thig le rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa/ brgyud pa bka' babs dgu'i nang gi de dang 'dra'am snyam la/ rin 'byung ltar na/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ kha che paṇa chen/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa/ bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye rgyan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ shar chen shes rab rgya mtsho/ rwa ston pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu/ phrin las shing rta man 'dra// ༈ /'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas bstan cing ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i lha mo shra ma ṇa'i rmi lam brtag pa'i man ngag dwags po paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ de'i sgo nas rmi lam brtag sgrub bya tshul dus gsum blang dor rab gsal 'jam mgon kun blos mdzad pa bcas lung khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ kun dga' seng ge/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gar thig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rdo rje/

grags pa rdo rje/ grags pa don grub/ ri khrod grub chen/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ dge legs bzang po/ rin chen chos rgyal/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba/ kun dga' blo gros/ chos nyid ye shes/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// ༈ /slob dpon zla ba'i bshes gnyen nas brgyud pa'i rmi lam lung ston sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba slob dpon zla ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa khro phu lo tsā'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs jo nang rin 'byung las byung ba/ sgom lung dang man ngag gi gsal byed nyung ngu zla ba'i me long rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ mkhan po bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ spyang lung pa chen po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ byang sems shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' snying po/ kun dga' chos bsam/ bla ma ras rkyang pa/ drung rams pa grags pa/ slob dpon blo gros rnam rgyal khu dbon/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyad phrin las shing rta man gong gos sngon can dang 'dra/ lung yang tshe dbang nor bu nas sprul sku kun dga' rnam rgyal man 'dra// ༈ /bud+dha tsu ru ka'i skye ba brtag pa'i gdams ngag gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa dri bral nor bu'i me long rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa/ de la nang gses dpa' bo gcig grub rgyud kyi dum bu/ grags pa'i rgyud 'grel/ snar thang pa'i mngon rtogs brgya rtsa las byung ba dang*/ stag lung pa'i man ngag las byung ba/ lag len gsal byed bcas so so'i phyogs nas gsan par nges//

༈ /jo bo tai lo pas nā ro pa la brgyud de dpal sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs 'od pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsun chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ rje drung ye shes rgya mtsho/ grub chen kun dga' dbang po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta man 'dra/ lung brgyud kyang gong ltar ro// yang na/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ mal gyi lo tsā ba/ rje sa chen man 'dra/ lung gzhan rje btsun ma'i sgom bzlas/ dug zhi ba/ srid spel ba/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rnams yig rnying*/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung nas byung ba/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bstod sgrub shel gyi pi waṃ zhu chen rin po ches mdzad pa las yig rnying gong dang 'dra la/ gzhan gnyis gzhung dang bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje'i yig steng nas lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ mchad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ rams lha lding ma ba/ sangs rgyas dbon/ slob dpon yon tan dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/

rgyal sras thogs med/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ glang thang chos rje shes rab rdo rje/ gnubs dpal rgyal bzang po/ nam mkha' bzang po/ chos rje blo gros 'byung gnas/ rje btsun dkon mchog blo gros/ 'bum rams rgyal ba blo gros/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ skyo mda' ba 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen/ de dbon dge legs lhun grub/ bla ma ngag dbang chos 'byor/ bla ma dpal ldan phrin las/ de las so// ༈ /mnyam med jo bo chen po'i bka' srol las byon pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig rgyas pa'i rjes gnang mchog legs rdo rje dang ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig steng nas rim par nos pa la/ dang po rtsa ba seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ljang mo/ gnyis pa nad gdon bgegs rigs zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ gsum pa tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba'i sgrol ma ser mo/ bzhi pa tshe 'phel ba'i sgrol ma ser mo/ lnga pa bud med dbang du byed pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ drug pa 'byung po 'dul ba'i sgrol ma dmar nag bdun pa gzhan gyi rig sngags zlog pa'i sgrol ma nag mo/ brgyad pa dgra bo gsod pa'i sgrol ma dmar nag dgu pa 'jigs pa thams cad srung ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ bcu pa bdud dang bar du gcod pa thams cad 'dul ba'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ bcu gcig la dbul ba sel ba'i sgrol ma dmar ser/ bcu gnyis pa bkra shis pa'i sgrol ma ser mo/ bcu gsum pa bgegs dang bar chad srung ba'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ bcu bzhi pa bgegs la bsnun pa'i sgrol ma nag mo/ bco lnga pa sdig pa zhi bar byed pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ bcu drug pa shes rab 'phel ba'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ bcu bdun pa bdud dang bar chad zhi ba'i sgrol ma dmar ser/ bco brgyad pa klu'i dug zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ bcu dgu pa rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/

nyi shu pa rims nad sel ba'i sgrol ma dmar ser/ nyer gcig pa phrin las thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo bcas kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ dpal ldan a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ mchad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ ze'u grags pa shes rab/ ze'u grags pa brtson 'grus sku mched/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/ smon lam rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba lhun grub/ spro lung pa/ blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ thar rtse byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ rje btsun ma'i bstod sgrub nyams su len tshul rtsa ba/ bstod pa dang las tshogs nyer gcig sbyar nas jo bo la gnang zhing lung bstan pa/ rtsa ba seng ldeng nags sgrol lha sngags bstod pa rnams yig rnying ste gong dang 'dra// ༈ /sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga sa lugs bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bklags chog mdzad pa rje bla mas zhu dag gnang ba/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog gsal ba'i sgron me dang*/ brgyud 'debs bcas rmor chen rin po ches mdzad pa bcas kyi lung brgyud ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ dpal ldan a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa/ dgon pa ba/ zhang ston ka ma ba/ lum pa ba/ chu mig pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ dkon mchog grags pa/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi grags pa gzhon nu/

mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ shākya don grub/ kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po/ dpal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// yang na/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun don grub rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ rje bla ma ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// ༈ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi sgrol ma ljang gu rje sa skya paṇa chen dang gnubs lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ rā hu la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ bi khyā ta de ba/ bud+dha shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba nas/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po bar gong rmi lam sgrol ma dang 'dra/ de nas rje rin chen rgya mtsho man sgrol dkar gyi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// nye brgyud ni rje btsun sgrol mas kha che paṇa chen la dngos su gnang*/ de nas 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa la brgyud/ ring brgyud gzhan thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen las brgyud pa yod mod kyang ma bzhugs snyam/ lung la/ sgrub thabs 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ bstod sgrub/ bum chog bum pa dang*/ sāts+tsha la brten pa'i las tshogs/ rdzogs rim bcas paṇa chen gsung zab mo rnams gong dang 'dra// ༈ /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas skul ba'i sgra dbyangs mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa de nyid kyi bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje nas rdo rje gdan pa la brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i dpal kye rdo rje lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs zab mo sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ dga' rab rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ lung phu ba/ sems cher ba gzhon nu grub/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ nyan po pa dpal ldan rin chen/ ma ṇi ba legs rgyal/ 'phags mchog grags pa bsod nams/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho man gong dang 'dra/ lung la/ he badz+ra dang tsakra sam+ba ra'i man ngag sa māp+ta mi thi'i mtha' can/ bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag dha byang chub sems dpa'i gsung*/ dpa' gcig mngon rtogs bcas gong ma'i bka' 'bum las byung ba de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar// ༈ /mkhas grub dus zhabs pa chen po las brgyud pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs chos rje sa paṇa khu dbon gyi gsung dang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ grub chen rā hu la shrī nas/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i bar gong shāka shrī'i sgrol ma dang 'dra/ de nas rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ snying po mtha' yas/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu/ bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta man 'dra/ lung la/ dus 'khor lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dus zhabs pas mdzad pa gnubs lo tsā ba'i 'gyur khro phu brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ltar/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs gong dang 'dra// ༈ /slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs chos rje sa paṇa khu dbon gyi gsung rab dang sgrub thabs rin byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong kye rdor lhan skyes dang 'dra/ lung la/ sgrub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ byin rlabs chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa bka' 'bum ltar//

༈ /bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa slob dpon bhu ri pas mdzad pa lo chen 'gyur btsal// ༈ /paṇa grub dbang po nā ro pa nas brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i gser chos rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs dang thar paṇa byin rlabs cho ga'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen nā ro ta pa/ bal po pham mthing pa/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' phrag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul

brgyud yig gcig la ma byung yang chad 'dra/ khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*/ grub chen bud+dha shrī gnyis/ gnyis kas/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ lha mchog seng ge/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ bud+dha siṃ ha/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ bsod nams lhun grub/ kun dga' bkra shis/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ dam chos bsam 'grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bkra shis lhun grub/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las so// yang na/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med man 'dra'o// lung la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs jo bo nā ro ta pas mdzad pa 'bro lo shes rab grags kyi 'gyur rje bla ma'i mchan can/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ bstod pa dang*/ brgyud 'debs ngor chen gyis mdzad pa thar paṇa dang rje bla ma'i zhal skong can/ byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad par zhus dag dang kha 'phang dkyus su bcug pa/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa bcas// ༈ /grub dbang rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis bkral ba'i in+d+ra mkha' spyod ma rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor sgrub thabs rin 'byung du/ rnal 'byor ma/ in+d+ra bhū ti nas/ bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tso bar dpyal lugs phag mo skor gsum dang 'dra gsung*/

ma/ grub chen lwa ba pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mi ka ra/ bram ze bir+wa pa/ grub thob sha ba ri pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri gup+ta/ slob dpon badz+ra pā ṇi/ bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tsi/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ dpal sa skya gong ma rnam lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ des gung ru shes rab bzang po dang*/ rin chen mkhyen rab mchog grub gnyis/ gnyis kas kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ bco brgyad pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ de gnyis kas mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun ma 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ sa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ rdo rje rin chen nas/ sde dge bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ dpon slob rin po che ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// yang na brag phug pa nas/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po/ nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ gcen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gcung bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo rings pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mngon dga' chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ mang thos phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub man 'dra'o// lung la dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i gzhung rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa lo tsā ba pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ rje bla mas mchan rnying la brten te gsal bar btab pa//

༈ /sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga go bde ba grags/ cho ga mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa// ༈ /grub chen mai tri pas bkral ba'i mai tri mkha' spyod dam rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i byin rlabs spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje phag rin 'byung du med/ mo/ dpa' bo spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ dpal sha ba ri pa/ grub chen mai tri pa/ rgya gar badz+ra pā ṇi/ grub chen ka ma la badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na/ sum pa lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ lo paṇa gnyis ka las rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal man in+d+ra mkha' spyod dang 'dra/ lung la/ rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung rje btsun rin po che'i mchan can sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ bstod pa bcas spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam gyis mdzad pa// ༈ /phag mo gzhung drug la brten grub pa'i slob dpon bal po bha len+d+ra ru tsi nas brgyud dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga' rdo rje la bka' babs pa'i dpyal lugs phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs yig rnying gi dgongs pa ltar sdeb gcig tu bskur ba legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje phag mo/ lcam legs lak+ṣ+mī/ smin ka ra/ bram ze bir+wa pa/ a ba dhū tī pa/ ldong ngar ba ting 'dzin rdo rje/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal bas byin/ bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas byin/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ bal po bha len+d+ra ru tsi/ dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga' rdo rje/ zar ston a tsar+ya/ gtsang yang gtsang yag rdo rje/ dag rdo rje/ dbus pa shes rab rdo rje/

lce mdo sde seng ge/ gru shākya 'bum/ lce blo ldan seng ge/ lce btsun bsod nams dpal/ sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dga' gdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rin chen mkhyen rab mchog grub/ rdo rings pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun ma 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ bla ma thogs med chos 'phel/ yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ lce mdo sde seng ge nas/ lce blo ldan grags pa/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje'am dad pa rgyal po/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer/ ma gcig jo 'bum/ se mo che ba/ bla ma 'jam gsar ba/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ rgyal ba ye shes/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge/ rdo rings kun spangs chen po nas 'dra'o// yang na/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje nas/ mar pa bsod nams rdo rje/ gtsang shes rab rdo rje/ mar ston seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lce mdo seng ge nas 'dra/ yang na dpyal lo nas/ zar a tsar+ya/ gnyis kas zhang 'od de/ dbus pa gzi 'od/ dbus pa shes rab rdo rje/ lce mdo seng ge/ de nas 'dra/ yang na dpyal lo nas/ mar pa bsod nams rdo rje/ khams pa zhang ston/ bla ma spug ston/ lha steng pa 'byung gnas seng ge/ lce mdo sde seng ge man 'dra/ yang na/ dpyal lo nas/

zar a tsar+ya/ bla ma snar ston/ grags pa tshul khrims/ kun dga' rdo rje/ tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ bu ston rin chen grub/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan nas sgrub thabs rin 'byung brgyud pa 'di dang gong 'og kun tu mi 'dra ba byung*/ 'dra'o// lung la/ sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi tho rje btsun grags pa'i gsung*/ mkha' spyod skor gsum dang*/ phag mo skor gsum gyi yig cha'i lung mkha' spyod be'u bum brgyud pa ltar te gzhan du shes// ༈ /grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis bkral zhing paṇa chen bud+dha shrī nas brgyud khro phu lo tsā ba la bka' babs pa'i khros ma dmar mo gtso 'khor gsum ma'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ blo gros bzang po/ bi ma la shrī/ ni ska laṅka shrī/ bud+dha shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba man gong shākya shrī'i lugs kyi sgrol ma dang 'dra/ lung la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag mo khros ma'i sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa khro lo'i 'gyur khro phu brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ltar dang*/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs de nyid kyi brgyud pa bzhin// ༈ /grub chen dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo'i byin rlabs stag lung bkra shis dpal grub kyi yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ bir+wa pa/ bram ze ār+ya de ba/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ dam pa kun dga'/ rje mang mkhar ba/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ dpal stag lung thang pa man btsal zhing*/ smin gling lo chen gyi yig cha ltar nos pa'i brgyud pa ni zhi byed byin rlabs spyi'i skabs dang 'dra// ༈ /grub chen kuk+ku ri pa'i bka' srol zhi ba sbas pa yab sras la brgyud mkhas grub chen po kun dga' snying po la bka' babs pa'i ma hā mā yā gtso rkyang gi byin rlabs sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro ma/ kuk+ku ri pa/ dharmā pa/ byā da li pa/ a si ta gha na/ rā ti gup+ta/ shān+ti gup+ta/ grub chen bud+dha nā tha/ rje btsun chen po kun dga' snying po/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho sogs gong kha paṇa sgrol ma dang 'dra/ lung la/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs/ dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor bde chen myur sgrub rje btsun gyis mdzad pa gnyis de nyid kyi gsung 'bum brgyud pa ltar// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes bkral ba'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ rā hu la shrī sogs gong shāka shrī'i sgrol ljang dang 'dra/ lung la/ gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa khro lo'i 'gyur/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs te gong khros ma dmar mo dang 'dra// ༈ /rgya mtsho nas byung ba'i gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang brgyud pa ni de nyid kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra// ༈ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa nas mkhas grub bar ma chad pa las brgyud pa'i bcom ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab dang 'brel bar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni slar btsal/ lung la/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags nas brgyud pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa phyag gnyis pa rjes gnang rwa lugs ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa rwa lugs dbang chen dang 'dra'am dpyad/ ni/ gong ma tsho la/ de nas mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ bsod nams dbang phyug dpal ldan don grub/

bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal/ de las so// yang na/ kun dga' blo gros/ zhal dkar ba ngag dbang shes rab/ bkra shis chos 'phel/ sangs rgyas shes rab/ bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho man 'dra/ lung la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rwa lo'i 'gyur/ mngon rtogs grub pa'i zhal lung rmor chen gyis mdzad pa rwa bod brgyud pa ltar te gzhan du shes// ༈ /grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i thugs dam thun mong ma yin pa thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal bso'i rjes gnang rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ til+li pa/ rnyog med dpal/ mi tra dzo gi/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bsod nams dbang po/ sems dpa' bsod nams seng ge/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab mchog grub/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ rje kun dga' grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho man gong dang 'dra/ yang na/ rdo rings pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug man tsho la/ lung la/ thugs rje chen po kha sar+pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ de'i man ngag dang bcas pa rje mi tri'i gdams pa/ thugs rje chen po'i rgyun gyi yi dam/ snying gi mun sel gyi gdams ngag rnams gnubs lo tsā bas bkod pa rnams khro phu brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ltar// ༈ /dpal karma kaṃ tshang gi zab chos thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i gtor dbang 'jam mgon bla ma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ te pu pa dri med bshes gnyen/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma zangs ri ras pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pak+ṣi/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ mkhas grub grags pa seng ge/ rtogs ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rje btsun rat+na bha dra/ grub mchog chos dpal ye shes/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ go shrī dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ gar dbang chos kyi grags pa/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub chen/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug lung rig smra ba'i nyi ma/ 'gro mgon karma chags med/ dul mo karma dar rgyas/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rgyal dbang bdud 'dul rdo rje/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ dpal karma pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rje/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho/ de gnyis ka las so// lung la/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i sgrub thabs byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos mdzad pa glan dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa gsal byed kyi dkyus bsdebs bklags grub/ gtor dbang bklags chog tu bkod pa zab gsang dgongs 'dus/ lha lnga gzhung rkyang lugs su nyams su len pa'i zin bris pad+ma'i lcug ma/ rgyun khyer 'khor lo gsum pa pad+ma'i snying po/ gnas lung khyer pa der bsdus pa thugs rje'i 'khrul zhags/ sreg blugs kyi cho ga mdor bsdus kun la phan pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga snying po bsdus pa rnam dag dgongs gsal rnams 'jam mgon thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa ste de nyid kyi zhal snga nas so//

༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo mar rngog jo lugs gsum ka'i bka' babs bka' brgyud kaṃ tshang gi lugs kyi rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol ltar rje thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yig cha zla ba 'dod 'jo'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ bla ma gser gling pa/ dpal ldan a ti sha/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar/ 'dir bya yul ba btsud 'dug dge bshes sge pa/ rje dwags po lha rje/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ ras chen sangs rgyas grags pa/ sbom brag pa bsod nams rdo rje/ grub chen karma pak+ṣi/ o rgyan pa rin chen dpal/ rje rang byung rdo rje/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ chos kyi grags

rol pa'i rdo rje/ pa/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sog dbon rig pa'i ral gri/ rje mthong ba don ldan/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ des dkon mchog 'bangs/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ si tu chos kyi go cha/ yongs 'dzin rnam rgyal grags pa/ bzhi gas karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug chos sgo ba lung rigs nyi ma/ karma chags med/ dul mo dar rgyas phun tshogs/ chos kyi don grub/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bdud 'dul rdo rje/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho/ de las so// yang na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri rin chen grags pa/ gle nag pa/ dge bshes sgre pa/ yang na jo bo rje/ rnal 'byor pa/ byang chub rin chen/ snyug rum pa/ dge bshes sgre pa'o// khrid kyi brgyud pa'i khyad par/ karma chags med/ pad+ma kun dga'/ phrin las dbang 'byung*/ shes rab grags pa/ bstan 'dzin don grub/ theg mchog bstan 'phel/ 'jam mgon bla ma/ de las so// lung la/ chos rje rin po che'i thugs dam sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa zhes grub chen karma pa la sgrol dkar ring brgyud dang nye brgyud kyi bka' thams cad babs pa'i rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gzhung 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung mchan can la nang gses/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ rgyas pa/ phan yon srung zlog tshe sgrub dang*/ srung 'khor srid gso lo rgyus dang*/ bum chog rtags tshad bstan pa'o// zhes las kha tshar brgyad bcas gong dang 'dra la/ mngon rtogs tshe sgrub dang bcas pa tā ra nā tha'i gsung*/ sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'gyur med rdo rjes mdzad pa gnyis so so'i gsung 'bum ltar/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rgyun khyer bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis mdzad pa gong dbyangs can ma dang brgyud pa 'dra//

༈ /'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'chi med grub ster/ rjes su gnang ba dang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gsal bar byed pa'i yi ge zla ba 'dod 'jo/ ril sgrub kyi lag len/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgom bzlas rdo rje'i ya lad/ sgrol dkar smon lam bsam 'grub lha'i ljon shing rnams dang*/ dge ba can ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid dpal ldan mar me mdzad kyi lugs gtsang la ma 'dres pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog bcas 'jam pa'i dbyangs yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa rnams ni 'jam mgon bla ma nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags nas rje btsun sa skya pa la brgyud de byung ba gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub rjes 'jam mgon kun blos bklags chog tu bkod pa'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad dpal/ dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ben+da pa chen po/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gnyis kas sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ grags pa tshul khrims/ shes rab rdo rje/ grags rin 'byung du rgyal ba pa bzang po/ byang chub seng ge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ kun dga' lung rig sbyin pa grags pa/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' dpal 'byor/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/

de las so// yang na/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gong dkar ba phrin las rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros man 'dra/ yang na/ kun blo nas/ mi nyag ri khud sprul sku kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po ngag dbang legs grub/ de gnyis ka las so// yang na nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las so// ༈ /kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas rnal 'byor bla med dang rjes su mthun par bkral ba'i sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang rmor chen yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub nyi ma sbas pa/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dzai tā ri/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lo blo gros grags/ rje sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ mchims chos seng*/ blo brtan/ 'jam gsar ba/ chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon dpal mchog don grub/ don grub rgyal mgon/ rgyal ba mgon/ bla ma bkras rin pa/ ngor chen/ rin chen bkra shis/ paṇa chen shāka mchog rgyal tshab kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs 'od pa/ rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsunam̐ tā ra nā tha/ kun rtags can gsum dpyad/ dga' bstan pa'i 'dzin rgyalam̐ mtshan dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang kun dam̐ga' lhun grub/ gru ban bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ sa chen kun blo/ thub bstan mkhan po dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mnga' ris/ drung bla ma phun tshogs bzang po/ rgya tshan khreb dgon bla ma bsod nams chos 'phel/

bla ma dam pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ chos rje dge legs rgya mtsho/ de las so// yang*/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar na/ rje tā ra nā tha nas/ kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' lhun grub bar gong dang 'dra/ de nas ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu man 'dra'o// lung la/ nyi sbas sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa blo gsal nyer mkho rje bla mas mdzad pa gong dang 'dra la/ sgrol ma spyi'i sgrub thabs/ so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang rnams rje btsun grags pa'i gsung bka' 'bum bzhin// ༈ /bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa rgya brtson seng gi 'gyur bstan 'gyur brgyud pa ltar te btsal// ༈ /rje btsun sgrol ma btson 'don ma'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga man ngag dang bcas pa la/ nyi sbas kyi gzhung las bcu dgu pa'i las tshogs khri mun las thar ba'i sgrub thabs khol phyung rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan sa bcad dang bstun te rjes bris pa/ gsal byed rje btsun grags pa'i gsung gi dum bu/ cho ga bklags pas grub par bkod pa byin rlabs thugs rje'i gdugs dkar rje bla mas mdzad pa bcas te brgyud pa nyi sbas gzhung dang 'dra// ༈ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad pa las byung ba'i sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i rjes gnang 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i zhabs kyi yig cha zla ba 'dod 'jo kha bsgyur ba'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ tsan+d+ra go mī/ nyi ma sbas pa/ zla ba'i snying po/ dzai tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dad byed go cha/ lha'i srung ba/ dā na shrī/ mañdzu shrī/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ dbang phyug rin chen/ chos kyi don grub bam chos 'grub/ blo gros brtan pa/ nam mkha' grags pa/ 'phags pa rin chen/ chos rje mkhan chen pa/ chos rje byang pa/

chos rje mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags pa 'byung gnas/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan rin chen/ dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ de wi ri pa/ smon lam bzang po/ rin chen dpal bzang*/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje/ si tu chos kyi go cha/ karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje man gong dkar lugs sgrol dkar dang 'dra/ lung la/ 'phags ma sgrol ma bkra shis don grub ma'i sgrub thabs bkra shis char 'bebs rje bla ma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon a bha yā ka ra'i bka' srol sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las byung ba'i thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni de nyid kyi spyi'i brgyud pa ltar/ lung*/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa rje bla ma'i gsung 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtshos zhal bskangs pa// ༈ /jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ lung*/ mchims chen nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ sngags 'chang chen mo'i rjes gnang gi zin bris bcas kyi brgyud pa btsal// ༈ /de dang rjes 'brel thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug la phyag mchod gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga thub bstan rgyas pa'i dpal yon kun 'byung rje ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas brgyud dpal ldan sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i rten 'brel srung ba'i byin rlabs rje sa chen gyi gsung ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/

bir+wa pa/ shar phyogs nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs a ba dhū tī/ paṇa chen ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se mkhar chu ba/ zhang ston chos 'bar/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ grags pa/ dkar shākya grags/ lung pa kun bzang dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje mkhyen rab chos rje/ shākya don grub/ kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de gnyis ka las so// lung la/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs ner ban rak+ṣi tas tho gar yul nas rnyed pa/ rten 'brel srung ba rje sa chen gyi gsung gnyis gong dang 'dra la/ thems yig 'phags pas mdzad pa bka' 'bum ltar ram btsal/ byin rlabs bya tshul man ngag dang bcas pa phan bde'i char sprin rje bla mas mdzad pa bcas// ༈ /dpal snar thang pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams las brgyud pa'i man ngag nor bu bstan pa spyi dbang bya thabs chos spyod bcu nyams su len tshul dang bcas pa bstan pa'i tshal 'byed si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yig steng nas lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*/ dpal ldan gro mo che pa bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ snar thang pa sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ zho ra ba 'khor lo seng ge/ la ru ba bsod nams seng ge/ mkhan chen 'od zer seng ge/ mus spad pa dpal ldan seng ge/ gnyags dpon bsod nams seng ge/

ban sgar ba 'jam dpal bzang po/ karma chos grags rgya mtsho/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal/ ma ṇi kun dga' rnam rgyal/ si tu chos kyi go cha/ bla ma karma bzang po/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ zhwa dmar pa chos kyi dbang phyug karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje/ zhwa dmar ye shes snying po/ karma pa byang chub rdo rje/ zhwa dmar chos kyi don grub/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje/ si tu rdo rje 'chang pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ de las so// yang na si tu chos kyi go cha/ karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbangaphyug chos sgo ba lung rig nyi ma/ grub thob karma chags med/ dul mo dar rgyas phun tshogs/ zhwa dmar chos kyi don grub nas 'dra'o// yang na/ si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ gong ra lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ drung rams pa karma tshogs gnyis/ karma bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ bla ma karma kun mkhyen/ si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas nas 'dra'o// ༈ /mdo sde zab mo 'don pa'i gdams ngag 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa la/ kha ton dang glegs bam klog pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa chos chung brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ltar/ sdud pa sogs sher mdo 'don thabs rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ sher snying 'don pa'i man ngag bar chad kun sel dge slong sgra tshad pas mdzad pa btsal/ de'i lhan thabs zab don snying po sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don thabs sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa rnams bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /gangs can ljongs kyi thub dbang gnyis pa mkhan chen bo dhi sa twas bkral ba'i bde gshegs sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma/ shākya'i tog 'jam dpal dbyangs/ mkhan chen bo dhi satwa/

chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ mu ne btsan rin 'byung du/ po/ sad na legs 'jing yon/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ mnga' bdag 'od srungs/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ mnga' bdag bkra shis lde/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od/ mnga' bdag lha lde/ mnga' bdag 'od lde/ mnga' bdag rtse lde/ mnga' ri dgra bcom/ zhu lhan pa shes rab grags pa/ ra sa chu lhas pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan gro mo che pa bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas bsgom/ sangs rgyas skyabs/ snying po rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' smon lam/ spang khang pa grags pa dpal/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ 'khus 'gos/ lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan ye shes/ gar thig pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ grags pa seng ge/ rong po blo bzang*/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ lum pa kun dga' chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ gnyis ka las so// yang na/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ gnyis ka las/ karma pā da/ de las so// yang na/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong yan de'i gsan yig ltar la/ de nas rin chen mchog grub/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can/ ngag dbang brtan pa/ rje ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// lung la/ sangs rgyas sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang bya tshul bklags chog don grub bsam 'phel nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad par rje bla mas gsal byed gnang ba/ bde gshegs bdun la gsol ba gdab tshul khyer bde dharma bha dras mdzad pa dang*/

༈ /sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa'i cho ga'i snying po nyams su len tshul 'di phyi'i re smon kun dka' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa btsal// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i cho ga thar pa'i shing rta 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ mdzad pa po nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /jo bo rje lha gcig nas brgyud bka' gdams pa'i man ngag snar thang brgya rtsa las byung ba'i mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang zhu chen pa'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ slob dpon ye shes snying po/ ye shes zhi ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku sā le che ba/ chung ba dge ba can/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra'am/ nye brgyud ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra/ rnal 'byor pa byang chub rin chen/ spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ mus sman pa/ phyar chen pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'grus/ mchims blo bzang grags/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpang ston grub pa shes rab/ khu ston bsod nams mchog grub/ dpal 'bar dpal ldan don grub/ rtse thang las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thel brag lcog thams cad mkhyen pa/ thon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ shangs ri bo dge 'phel pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur dpal 'byor phrin las rab rgyas/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rab 'byams chos rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang skal bzang*/ 'dren pa rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ skyo mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes/

sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ bla ma dpal ldan phrin las/ de las so// yang na/ bsod nams dbang phyug nas/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen/ kun dga' shes rab/ kun dga' lhun grub/ rin chen grags pa/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bla ma dpal ldan phrin las/ de las so// yang na/ jo bo rje/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ phya pa chos kyi seng ge/ gtsang nags pa thugs rje seng ge/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man 'dra'o// lung la/ mi 'khrugs pa'i mngon rtogs bla ma zhang ston pa'i zhal nas byon pa ltar bkod pa gong ltar/ jo lugs mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga sdig sgrib kun sbyong rje bla mas mdzad pa// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi thugs dam sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po lha lnga'i rjes gnang rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub kyi yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ jo bo rje dī paṃ ka ra/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen maṅga la bha dra/ 'jam dbyangs sngon mo/ kun spangs chos rje/ byang sems bsod nams rin chen/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mkhas grub kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/

byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ 'brom ston nas/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ gtum ston pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags pa man 'dra'o// lung la/ klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo chen rin bzang 'gyur/ sgrub thabs rtsa ba bcom ldan ral gris mdzad pa/ bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs kun mkhyen rong ston gyis mdzad pa rnams gser pod ltar/ sgrub thabs ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul go bde don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me rmor chen gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen thabs bris sku'i dmigs bsal dang bcas pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ klu gtor bsdus pa bcas gong rjes gnang dang 'dra'am snyam// ༈ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi thugs dam lha bzhir grags pa'i rjes gnang mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i rim pa la/ dang po bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtso bo thub pa rdo rje gdan pa gtso 'khor gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na/ lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ mkhan po zul phu ba/ slob dpon dkon mchog seng ge/ de gnyis ka las mkhas btsun tshul khrims rin chen/ de nas bla ma dar ma bzang po/ chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan don grub/ gtsang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bya btang bo dhi satwa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags pa/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/

gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lcags thang rab byams pa bsod nams dpal ldan/ mang thos klu+u sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa chen kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ kun gzigs lnga pa rin po che ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos 'dzin/ brag g.yab sprul sku blo bzang brtan pa/ bya btang chos rdo rje/ zhang zhung pa dge slong ye shes mtha' yas/ kun mkhyen dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po/ rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ jo bo a ti sha/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ shes rab 'bar/ wa yu ba shes rab tshul khrims/ lce sgom shes rab rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/ gnyen ston chos kyi shes rab/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ grub thob a seng*/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal ba/ rdo rje dpal ba/ chos dpal shes rab/ grags pa 'byung gnas/ lo pa tshul dar/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang man 'dra/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra man thub pa'i rjes gnang dang 'dra/ gshegs rigs kyi khro bo mi g.yo ba sngon po gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ khro rgyal mi g.yo ba/ jo bo a ti sha /dpal ldan dgon pa ba/ sne'u zur pa/ rtogs ldan bzang mo ba/ dge 'dun sgang pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ bcu bzhi pa tshul khrims mgon po/ tshes bcu pa chos kyi rdo rje/ rgyal steng gser khang pa rin chen 'phel/ lo pa tshul dar/

spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang man 'dra'o// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams dang*/ rje grol mchog gi yig cha gung spros te rgyas par lan gnyis su thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams yan gsan yig snga ma rnams su shes/ de nas/ sa chen bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ kun gzigs blo bzang rgya mtsho/ sngags chen dge 'dun don grub/ skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ rje blo bzang chos 'dzin/ brag g.yabs sprul sku phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ rwa bsgrengs slob dpon blo bzang don grub/ klong rdol ngag dbang blo bzang*/ rgyal sras skal bzang thub bstan/ blo bzang dge legs bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ des bdag la rjes gnang dang bcas pa lan gnyis su bka' drin stsal ba'o// zhes byung*/ lung la/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa rje bla mas gsal byed bcug pa/ khrid kyi yi ge mdo sngags lam gyi bcud 'dus la nang gses su/ thub pa'i dbang po'i lta khrid/ spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi khrid/ sgrol ma rjes dran lnga'i khrid/ mi g.yo ba chos drug gi khrid bcas 'jam mgon bla ma yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa ni rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma ri khrod pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/

gu ge paṇa chen/ glo bo mkhan chen/ rje kun dga' grol mchog rje rdo rings pa chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho man 'dra/ 'di'i spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed bzhi pa/ rje kun snying nas/ kun dga' chos bsam nas brgyud pa gong dang 'dra'o// lung la/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam chos drug phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i brjed byang yig

ba ri'i gsung ngam/ rnying*/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs la/ 'od zer can ma/ mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed bzhi pa/ thub pa me ru shi ṣa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgom bzlas te le'u tshan drug gong rjes gnang dang 'dra// ༈ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa nas ba ri lo tsā ba brgyud rje sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i lha mo 'od zer can ma gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang nam mkha' legs pa'i yig cha ltar lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla brgyud grags chen bcu gcig tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ bsod nams brtan pa/ rje bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ rat+na shī la/ sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ nam mkha' dpal ldan/ snying rje bzang po/ bsam gtan bzang po/ ting 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ gnas gsar pa nam mkha' legs pa/ snang ste nor ram/ ngag dbang rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ byams pa smon lam grags pa/ de las so// lung la/ 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa la/ 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad/ sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs shin tu zab pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi 'jigs pa srung ba dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi tho nam mkha' legs pas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs gzungs mdo dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa srung skud byed thabs bcas/

sbyin sreg gyi cho ga 'od zer mtha' yas kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa bcas las/ blo gsal zhabs kyi gsung de nyid kyi mdun nas dang*/ gzhan rjes gnang dang 'dra'am dpyad// ༈ /slob dpon dze tā ri nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i khro rgyal mi g.yo ba sngon po'i rjes gnang rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla brgyud grags chen bcu gcig zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ she'u lo tsā ba/ bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'gyur med mchog grub/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ rje bla ma ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na kun dga' blo gros nas/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rje bla ma ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// yang na/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong nas rin chen mchog grub man sman bla dang 'dra/ yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs yan zhu gsan du gsal/ de nas bsod nams dpal ldan/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i lo rgyus sgrub skor rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ gtam rgyud mngon rtogs las tshogs dang bcas pa rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ 'khor lo'i gzhung paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi rdo rje dang*/

lo tsā ba nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rgyud nas byung ba'i bstod pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa ste gong rjes gnang dang 'dra'am snyam la/ gzhan gnyis bka' 'bum ltar 'dren kyang chog/ ༈ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa'i dpal ldan shangs pa'i zab chos gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi byin rlabs legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ni gu ma/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/ gnyan ston brtson 'grus seng ge/ sangs rgyas ston pa chos kyi brtson 'grus/ gtsang ma shangs ston rin chen 'bum/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ mnyam med byams pa dpal/ blo gros dpal/ kun dga' dpal bzang*/ chos rgyal dpal/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ rdo rings kun spangs chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bsod nams chos 'phel/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ bsod nams dpal bzang*/ chos nyid ye shes/ ye shes rgyal mchog yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi zab chos gsang sgrub skor gsum la/ bde mchog sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub thabs nai gu mas mdzad pa mchan can/ phyag rdor gsang sgrub/ rnam 'joms gsang sgrub khrus chu'i gdams pa dang*/ dngos gnyis sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung*/ byin rlabs bya tshul mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad par zhwa lu rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan skyong gis gsal byed mdzad pa ni/ rje de nyid las mnos shing gzhan dag gi lung 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen gyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang zhwa lu blo gsal bstan skyong gi yig cha ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo/ gsang bdag zla ba bzang po/ lha'i dbang po/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ dus zhabs pa/ na len+d+ra pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug grub thob nam mkha' 'od zer/ ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum/ se mo che nam mkha' 'od/ 'jam gsar ba shes rab 'od zer/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ dol bo shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po/ byang pa lo tsā ba dkon mchog bzang po/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ a wa dhū tī pa chen po/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ mkhyen rab ting 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ kun dga' rnam rgyal/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' legs pa 'byung gnas/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang bsod nams phun tshogs/ zhwa lu rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de gnyis ka las so// lung la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus rgyud las phyung ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'grel chen dri med 'od nas bstan pa'i sgrub thabs bu ston gsung mchan can/ sgrub rjes las tshogs dang bcas pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa bcas rje 'di nyid las so// ༈ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las/ sna tshogs yum dkar mo dang*/ 'dab chags mgon po rdo rje khyung khra gnyis kyi rjes gnang yang gong rdo shugs dang 'dra/

lung la/ bsdus rgyud dang*/ 'grel chen nas bstan pa'i sna tshogs yum sgrub thabs bu ston rin po che'i mchan can/ sna tshogs yum gyi 'brum srung bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang dang sgom bzlas srung ba dang bcas rwa ston chos grags dpal bzang gis mdzad pa bcas kun blo rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ byams pa smon lam grags pa/ de las so// sgrub skor rjes gnang dang bcas pa phan bde'i mchog sbyin blo gsal zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang*// ༈ /dus 'khor khyung khra'i sgrub thabs bsdus rgyud las phyung ba bu ston mchan can/ sgrub thabs las tshogs bcas kun mkhyen dol bu pas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang brtan g.yo'i dug 'joms zhwa lu blo gsal zhabs kyis mdzad pa bcas rje 'di nyid las so// ༈ /dpal kye rdo rje'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum las/ dang po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang mkhan chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas thun mong ma yin par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ ye shes mkha' 'gro dri med gzi brjid/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos kyi seng ge/ 'jam gsar ba shes rab 'od zer/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge/ bud+dha siṃ ha/ brang ti paṇa chen/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ hor nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/

thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnal 'byor rdo rje gur gyi rgyud le'u gnyis pa las phyung ba rje btsun grags pa'i gsung ltar bris pa'i sa bcad can/ mngon rtogs mdor bsdus grags pa'i gur rgyan las phyung ba/ sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa sgrub thabs rgya rtsa las byung ba/ sgrub thabs nyams su blang bde dang rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa mchan can/ sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa rnam gsal nyi ma zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ bstod pa gzim 'og rin po ches mdzad pa gur nas gsungs pa'i yig brgya bcas/ ༈ /gsang bdag 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgo nas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya tshul dngos grub nor bu 'dren pa'i gru chen gzim 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis mdzad pa/ rje bla mas gsal byed bcas pa dag par bgyis pa ste gzim 'og pa'i gsung bstan 'dzin snyan grags las/ gzhan rnams bka' 'bum ltar dang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa las byung ba de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar ro// ༈ /gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum gyi gnyis pa sher phyin dkar mo'i rjes gnang thar rtse paṇa chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ pu hrang gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon gyis chu ba/ sa chen dkar po rnam gsum/ mchims chos kyi seng ge/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs blo/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rdo rje/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug man slar btsal/ lung la/

rdo rje gur gyi le'u brgyad pa nas bstan pa'i sher phyin dkar mo'i rnal 'byor khol phyung rje bla ma'i mchan can/ gur rgyan las byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gzhung*/ phyag rgya chen po rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag bsam mi khyab pa'i man ngag lugs gcig sa skya pa'i gces btus las byung ba/ sher phyin ma'i sgrub thabs ye shes snang ba dang*/ bstod pa ngor chen gyis mdzad pa de nyid kyi gsung 'bum ltar/ gzhan rgyud 'bum dang*/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum ltar ram logs su btsal// ༈ /sher phyin yi ge gcig ma'i gzhung gsal byed dang bcas pa la/ yi ge gcig ma'i man ngag dpal sa skya pa'i man ngag gces btus las byung ba/ yang de'i man ngag sa skya pa nas brgyud pa/ de'i man ngag stag lung pa'i sgrub thabs sna tshogs las byung ba/ khro phu'i man ngag brgya rtsa las byung ba rnams yig rnying ste 'di khro phu brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ltar dang*/ gzhan btsal// ༈ /gur gyi las rgyas pa'i lha gsum gyi phyi ma sor 'brang dkar mo'i rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ thar paṇa tho yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bhi pa/ ngo mtshar rdo rje/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ dza ya shrī/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ bla chen 'brog mi/ se ston/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje btsun gong ma rnam lnga/ nam mkha' dpal ldan/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug dkon mchog 'phel/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ bsod nams lhun grub/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ kun dga' blo gros/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// yang na lung bcas ngor chen yan sngar ltar la/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug

dge slong chos skyong grags/ rje mus srad pa kun legs/ sgo rum pa/ mkhyen brtse/ bsod nams chos 'phel/ ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse ba kun dga' 'am ā nan+da/ rat+na bar+dha/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun blo/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun bkras/ kun rin/ karma pra bar+dha/ de las so// lung la/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa las byung ba sor 'brang ma'i rnal 'byor mchan can/ gur rgyan las byung ba'i man ngag sgrub thabs ngor chen gyis mdzad pa/ yang sgrub thabs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rnams las rgyud 'bum dang*/ gzhan bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i sgom bzlas yan lag dang bcas pa byin rlabs zla zhun gyi chu bo'i steng nas sgom bzlas yig lung bcas/ mdzad pa po rje bla ma 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub kyi zhal snga nas mnos so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa la/ rje btsun grags pa'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong las ltung ba las ldang ba'i thabs khol du phyung ba/ sgrub thabs sdig sgrib kun 'joms 'jam mgon kun blos mdzad pa'i sgom bzlas kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mdzad pa po nas/ rje btsun ma 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od gsal rdo rje'i me long ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa rje de nyid kyi zhal snga nas lung nos so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sogs la smre bshags kyis gsol ba gdab pa thugs dam gnad nas skul ba'i gdung dbyangs rje bla ma ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang de nyid las so// ༈ /slob dpon pūr+ṇa badz+ra las rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos gsan pa'i 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sgom lung legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bud+dha swā mi/ su dzā ta/ sā dhu dzñā na/ saṃ pra kīr+t+ti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be dā ban+dhu/ bī ra mi tra/ pūr+ṇa badz+ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha/ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ de las kun bzang dbang pos gsan cing*/ yang na/ rgyal tshab ye rgyam nas/ blo gros rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu man rin 'byung nas byung ba snga ma rnams dang 'dra/ lung la/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung nas byung ba'i sgrub thabs/ jo bo'i ltung bshags cho ga chos chung brgya rtsa las byung ba gnyis de nyid kyi ltar/ brgyud 'debs in+d+ra nī la'i phreng ba/ bzlas lung sgrub thabs ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phags pa'i lam gyi shing rta/ nye sras brgyad bstod las byung ba nam snying bstod pa nor bu'i sprin char rnams 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i lung*/ mdzad pa po nyid kyi zhal snga nas mnos so// ༈ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal bir+wa pa nas slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho la brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i rje btsun gza' thams cad kyi yum rig pa chen mo'i rjes gnang ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje'i yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal bir+wa pa/ mkhan chen bodhi satwa/ 'khon klu dbang srung ba/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ 'khon shes rab yon tan/ 'khon tshul khrims rgyal po/ 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong*/ 'khon bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon gtsug tor shes rab/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen gong ma rnam lnga/ 'khon gzhon nu dpal grags/ 'phags pa'i 'od/ gzhon nu bsod nams/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/

lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ rje btsun gza' thams cad kyi yum rje btsun rig pa chen mo'i skor la/ sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi tho mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bstod pa ngag dbang bstan rdor gyis mdzad pa/ mchod chog nad gdon mun pa sel ba'i ma zlum zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa rnams rin 'byung gzhung dang*/ bka' 'bum so so ltar la/ mchog legs rdo rje'i gsung rjes gnang dang 'dra/ bstod pa'i brgyud pa btsal// ༈ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī nas brgyud dpal sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ seng ge sgra/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mī/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ paṇa chen nā ro pa/ pham mthing sku mched/ us+tha la dha pa badz+ra/ mañdza gling pa thugs rje chen po/ mal lo blo gros grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ gnyan phul byung ba gtsug tor rgyal po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes rin chen/ bla ma kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen blo gros rin chen/

sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gnyis kas thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros sam/ nam mkha' dpal bzang nas/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ kun dga' legs pa/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i bskor la/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs kyi dka' 'grel sa bcad dang bcas pa rje sa chen gsung*/ sgrub thabs dang gdon 'grol gyi cho ga yig brgya/ bsdus don/ las sbyor sogs mngon rtogs nye bar gsal ba rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ bsnyen thabs dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa rnams ni ba ri brgya rtsa dang*/ so so'i gsung 'bum ltar// ༈ /seng ge sgra'i gdon dgrol gyi cho ga rin chen phreng mdzes nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa dpon slob ngag dbang blo gros pas mdzad pa btsal/ brgyud 'debs sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ bum gter gzhug pa'i man ngag gsal byed dang bcas pa klu bum sgrub thabs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i lhan thabs sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa rnams bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i ngag srung 'grol gyi gdams pa klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhi'i nang tshan yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zhu dag byas pa/

sgrub thabs tshar chen rin po che blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ yang sgrub thabs rmor chen gyis mdzad pa rnams gser pod ltar// ༈ /thugs rje chen po'i mig 'byed mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter byon la/ gter gzhung dngos/ zhal shes lag len/ de nyid kyi skabs don gsum gsal byed brgyud 'debs bcas byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs kha skong bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa rje bla ma'i zhal skong can bcas kyi gdams pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ nyang sgrub pa po nyi ma 'od zer/ shākya bzang po/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rje/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ ngag gi dbang po/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog dpal 'byor/ pad+ma phrin las/ de nas/ blo bzang don grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje nas ba ri lo tsā ba la brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa rje btsun ri khrod ma ser mo'i rjes gnang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla brgyud grags chen bcu gcig shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ rin chen ye shes/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bsam gtan lhun grub/ lo tsā ba dpal ldan byang chub/ 'bri gung lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sa chen kun dga'

phyag bris su bsod nams lhun grub byung*/ bsod nams/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gnyis ka las yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ khri chen rin po che kun dga' bkra shis/ gnyis ka las byams pa smon lam grags pa/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ chos nyid ye shes/ zhi dgon pa bsod nams dbang phyug smon lam grags pa/ de las so// lung la/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa rjes gnang dang 'dra/ rje btsun ri khrod ma'i cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa sdig sgrib nad gnod zhi ba'i byin rlabs chu rgyun/ zur 'debs byin rlabs chu rgyun spel ba'i gangs ri/ bum chog khyer bde nad yams mthar byed bcas dpal sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ de nyid nas/ nam mkha' 'chi brtag med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal/ de las so// ༈ /paṇa grub dbang po rdo rje gdan pa nas snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba la brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las bstan pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa de spyi'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ lung la/ sna tshogs pa'i las rab tu 'byung ba 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor la/ dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u bzhi'i bdag nyid can mchan rnying kha bskangs pa'i mchan 'grel rje bla mas mdzad pa/ rgyud kyi ṭī ka rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas byung ba/ dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/
