sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa bcas/ gong ma'i gsung bka' 'bum ltar la gzhan rang gzhung ltar ro// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon dzā+e tā ri nas bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba la brgyud rje sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i rdo rje rnam 'joms lha gcig bum gcig gi rjes gnang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub dang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma rin chen dpal ba/ byang chub gzhon nu/ byang chub seng ge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ dam chos bsam 'grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ ngag dbang chos skyong bzang po/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ kun dga' ye shes/ ngag dbang brtan pa/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// lung la/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang bum chog gi cho ga dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms gzungs/ bla brgyud gsol 'debs sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa rje bla ma'i zhal skong bcas/ rjes gnang mtha' rten bcas bya tshul thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sreg blugs kyi cho ga'i khyad par rnam 'byed ha nu man+tha zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ bum chog la nyer mkho'i lhan thabs rje ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa bcas te 'di mdzad pa po las dang*/

gzhan so so'i gsung 'bum ltar// ༈ /rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la nye bar mkho ba'i gtor ma cha gsum cho ga ngor chen gyis bsgrigs pa/ rgyal chen sde bzhi'i gtor 'bul nyung bsdus dkon mchog lhun grub gsung las phyung ba gnyis kyang bka' 'bum bzhin// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bkral ba'i khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa dud ka'i rjes gnang sa lugs rmor chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni re zhig ma rnyed la/ lung la/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa la sgrub thabs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i man ngag kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ mngon rtogs rjes gnang khrus chog dang bcas pa'i yi ge mthong ba don ldan rmor chen gyis mdzad pa/ grib mdos bkru byab srung gsum dang bcas pa bya tshul zhwa lu bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa/ grib glud gtong thabs rmor chen gyis mdzad pa brgyud pa'i tho rdo rje rin chen las zhes snang ba rjes lung tshad ma'am dpyad/ bcas// ༈ /rje ba ri ba nas brgyud pa'i kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung lo rgyus dang bcas pa dpal sa skya pa rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa gsal byed kyi mchan lung bcas 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub kyis gsar spel gnang ba rje nyid kyi drung nas dang*/ 'jam mgon sa lo chen po'i zur 'debs kyi lung btsal// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi rjes gnang mthar rtse paṇa chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ jo bo a ti sha/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ bya 'dul 'dzin brtson 'grus 'bar/ mkhan po chos kyi byang chub/ bla ma tshul khrims rin chen/ dar ma bzang po/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rgyal mtshan don grub/ gtsang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/

bya btang bo dhi satwa/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen grags/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// lung la/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang khrus chog gi tho bcas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa/ las tshogs jo bo nas brgyud pa yig rnying*/ grib glud rdzong chog 'gal rkyen mun sel khro bo'i gzi 'od yab rje kun blos mdzad pa bcas gong rjes gnang dang 'dra'am snyam// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la khro bo 'chol pa nyid kyis dngos su stsal ba chag lo gsum pa rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la bka' babs pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa gtsang byed tshangs pa'i zla shel chag los mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khro bo sme brtsegs/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ dge bshes lag sor ba/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ zul phu'i mkhan chen chos dbang*/ mkhan chen chos byang*/ mkhan chen chos kyi shes rab/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ gnyal gung snang ba/ bcom ldan lho mdzes pa/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ chos rje ye shes dpal bzang po/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ yang na/ lo mchog pa/ mnyam med grags rgyal ba/ bla ma shākya pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ grub dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo/ de man chad kyi brgyud pa tshol/ sme brtsegs kyi gdams ngag e waṃ chos ldan gyi phyag len myang grub ma btsal/ sngags don cung zad bshad pa rje btsun kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa bcas 'di bka' 'bum brgyud pa ltar//

༈ /gru spang rtse pa rdo rje seng ge la mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyis stsal ba'i khro mo sme brtsegs ma'i rjes gnang kun blo'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang bdag phyag rdor/ ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong can/ gru spang rtse pa rdo rje seng ge/ chos rje brag nag pa/ byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dang*/ bde phug pa dge legs rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal bsod nams/ de sras chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug byams pa skal bzang gnyis nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po gnyis/ gnyis kas rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ bla ma ngag dbang ye shes/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs blo gsal/ de las so/ lung la/ bum chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa 'jam mgon kun blos mdzad pa'i lung*/ mdzad pa po nas/ lha khang mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang*/ bshes gnyen kun dga' bsam gtan/ bla ma dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal/ de las so/ grib sel man ngag blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa rje nyid las so// ༈ /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhi ba'i zhabs kyi gdams pa jo bo las brgyud pa khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rjes gnang ba ri brgya rtsa'i chings sbyar ba'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen grags pa/ san+da pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ dge bshes kha'u pa/ de gnyis ka las rje btsun sa skya pa chen po man brgya rtsa spyi dang 'dra'am snyam/

lung la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i man ngag zab mo kirti grags rgyal/ dh+wa dzas mdzad pa/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs bcas so so'i bka' 'bum dang gzhung ltar// ༈ /paṇa grub dbang po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa nas dpal chen rgwa lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rjes gnang kar lugs gcig shes kun grol ltar rje gu ṇa sā ga ra las thob pa ni/ 'di'i brgyud pa spyi la gsal ba ltar te gzhan du shes/ lung la/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa grub pa'i zil dngar rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan 'jam dbyangs nag po'i rjes gnang rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ zhang mdo sde pa/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma mnyam med pa/ shākya pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ rje btsun 'chi med dpyad/ bstan pa'i nyi ma/ ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// yang na/

glo bo mkhan chen nas/ lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sa skya bu ston/ theg chen rin po che/ glang thang spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams lha dbang*/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra/ yang na/ brag phug pa nas/ ye shes dpal/ blo bzang dkar mo/ dkon mchog thugs rje/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ slob dpon chos mchog bla chen yon tan rgya mtsho/ rje tshe dbang bkra shis/ mtshungs med rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen man 'dra'o// lung la/ gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs rtsa ba brgyud pa bcas/ rjes gnang brgyud pa bcas/ sgrub thabs paṇa chen grags rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ nyams len zab mo tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rmor chen gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang sgom lung gi yi ge le tshan dang bcas pa'i lung brgyud bcas de nyid du gsal ba ltar// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i srung ba lha lnga'i rjes gnang snar thang brgya rtsa'i chings kyis bcings te legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar te gzhan du shes/ lung la/ srung ba'i lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bstan pa rgya gzhung btsal// ༈ /paṇa grub dbang po ni ri ti pa'i rjes su 'brang ba 'phags pa byams pa'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar ram gzhan du btsal/ lung la/ ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ dpal mi pham mgon po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ni ri ti pas mdzad pa khro lo'i 'gyur/

byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ rje btsun byams pa la bstod pa gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs gong ltar dang*/ gzungs bka' 'gyur bzhin la gzhan 'og smon lam mchod phreng sogs khro lo'i 'gyur dang gsung rnams slar btsal// ༈ /paṇa chen zla ba gzhon nu nas bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrī brgyud khro phu lo tsā bas gsan pa'i dbyangs can dkar mo phyag bzhi ma'i rjes gnang gong ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ lung la/ dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa khro lo'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs bsdus don khro los mdzad pa bcas khro phu brgya rtsa ltar/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa zla ba gzhon nu'i 'khri shing rje bla mas mdzad pa// ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje nas ba ri lo tsā ba brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rjes gnang brang ti paṇa chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa yig lung bcas slar btsal// ༈ /rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i khyad chos phyag rdor nyi ma mdung gang ma'i rjes gnang bo dong grub chen pad+ma gar dbang gi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ drang srong rā hu la/ g.ya' bzang chos rje/ kham sgom nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bla ma don yod dpal/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ theg chen kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma chos grags pa/ rje rin chen bkra shis/ bshes gnyen rin chen bzang po/ gangs can kun dga' dpal/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ kun mkhyen byams pa chos nyi/ bo dong pa pad+ma gar dbang*/ 'jam dbyangs phrin las grags pa/ phrin las rnam rgyal/ phrin las rgya mtsho/ rdo rje snying po/ 'jigs med grub pa/ 'jam dbyangs gar dbang*/ gar dbang rin chen bzang po/ 'gro 'dul rig 'dzin chen po/

skal bzang 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal/ des sbyor ra phrin las lhun grub dang*/ mkhas grub rig 'dzin rnam rgyal gnyis/ gnyis kas rdo rje phag mo chos dbyings bde chen mtsho mo// de las so// yang na/ bo dong pad+ma gar dbang nas/ lcog gra ba grags pa 'od zer/ rab 'byams chos rje/ gnyis kas bla ma rin chen/ gar dbang 'dus chen rab rgyas/ brtul zhugs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ gar dbang rin chen bzang po man 'dra'o// lung la/ rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa la drang srong gis dngos su phul ba'i steng gdon srung ba'i man ngag nyi ma mdung gang mar grags pa la rong skor le tshan gnyis/ g.ya' bzang yang dgon skor/ sham bu cal gyi skor/ g.ya' bzang gzim chung ma'i skor te so sor lo rgyus/ sgom bzlas/ 'khor lo/ nad rtags/ nad zhi byed/ sman gyis gso ba/ dug 'byin rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa nas/ gangs can pa kun dga' dpal man gong dang 'dra/ de nas/ rin chen chos legs 'phel/ o rgyan dpal 'byor/ g.ya' bzang pa bshes gnyen phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen 'gyur med don ldan/ mkhan chen o ḍi yā na/ khri chen phrin las rnam rgyal/ rje btsun rin po che 'gyur med phrin las chos sgron/ de las so// de las 'dir bkod pa'i rong skor le tshan gnyis/ bsnyen yig zhal gdams smar khrid du bkod pa gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub kyis mdzad pa 'di ltar dang*/ mngon rtogs dang*/ rjes gnang pad+ma gar dbang gi gsung dag gong rjes gnang dang 'dra'o// ༈ /ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mos rje btsun ras chung rdo rje grags pa la bar chad sel ba'i lhar stsal pa dpal rta mgrin dmar po dpa' bo gcig pa'i byin rlabs rjes gnang tshar chen rin po che'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rta mgrin/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/

rje btsun ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rje btsun mi la/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ rje phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ grub chen rin chen 'phel/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab mchog grub/ rdo rings kun spangs pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bla ma gzhon nu blo gros/ mkhan chen dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan chos skyong*/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ rje bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// lung la/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga bcas tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa gong dang 'dra// ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gzigs khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po zla rgyal lugs kyi rjes gnang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ zhang byang rin/ dpal rgyal ba grub/ chos rje 'dzin pa/ chos rje spang sgang pa/ sgrub pa po rin chen brtson 'grus/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge/ sa bzangs 'phags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ kha phyar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ rje btsun lha mchog seng ge/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal

phyag bris su paṇa chen nas/ mchog legs rdo rje/ gsungs pa brtag bzang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ rje bla ma bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ dpal sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa byang sems zla rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang yig rnying*/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi lag len dang bcas pa thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa bcas gong dang 'dra'am snyam// ༈ /gu ru zhi ba'i sgrub skor bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i phrin las gtor dbang dang bcas pa'i lung gi brgyud pa logs su 'byung ba ltar dang*/ byams pa bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i o rgyan rin po che la brten pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga grub gnyis 'dod 'jo'i bsam 'phel dang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i bstod pa/ pad+ma 'od du skye ba'i smon tshig bcas de nyid nas/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ gzim 'og rin po che bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /nyang gter gu ru drag po me'i spu gri'i rjes gnang zhu chen rin po che'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ mnga' bdag sras chung*/ gu ru chos rin/ chos nyid rang grol/ sangs rgyas lhun dbang*/ kun dga' bkra shis/ rgyal sras chos rje/ sngags 'chang legs pa dpal/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ kun dga' rin chen/

bsod nams dbang po/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i drag sgrub gsal ba'i me long de nyid kyi gsung thor bu'i brgyud pa ltar dang*/ zhu chen rin po che'i sgrub rjes brgyud 'debs bcas bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi nang tshan gser chos mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang rmor chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ dus zhabs pa che chung gnyis/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin chen/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ khyung khra'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi ya gyal gcig pu gdung brgyud kyi phyag dpe la zhal bshus pa/

bstod pa rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa/ bzlas lung bcas sa skya pa chen po nas brgyud pa'i man ngag phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa gser pod ltar/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rmor chen gyis mdzad pa gtor ma'i bka' bsgo rje bla mas sbyar ba bcas gong dang 'dra// ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo grub chen nā ro ta pas bkral ba'i man ngag rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs shing bla ma rdzong pa rim brgyud rdo rje khyung khra man ngag lugs kyi rjes gnang 'phags pa'i gsung zur 'debs dang bcas pa'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ nā ro ta pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang*/ rdzong chung ma kun dga' blo gros/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po/ rig 'dzin chos kyi blo gros/ rig 'dzin chos dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ 'bum chen kun dpal 'byor/ rje sangs rgyas bkra shis/ byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang*/ zhwa lu bsod nams mchog grub/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ gra thang mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ 'di gzhung du ma byung yang chad dam/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ grub dbang rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ rje shes rab 'od zer/ 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ nam mkha' legs pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams phun tshogs/ de las so// 'di la brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig kyang byung*/ lung la/ dus 'khor khyung khra man ngag lugs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/

sa skya'i khyung pod dkar chag dang des zin pa'i las tshogs 'khor lo'i dpe'u ris dang bcas pa gser pod ltar/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rje bla mas mdzad pa// ༈ /rgya gar gyi bla ma ā tsar+ya dmar pos rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la dngos su gnang ba gser chos khyung nag gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung po 'ur 'ded kyi rjes gnang sangs rgyas phun tshogs yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon shes rab gsang ba'am ā tsar+ya dmar po/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rong mi grags pa dpal/ rong mi bud+dha shrī/ rong mi dar ma grags/ rong mi sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rong mi bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags pa/ grags pa dpal mgon/ jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ bla ma dpal ldan grags pa/ mus chen 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgyal rgya mtsho/ mtshan/ mus chen bsod nams lhun chos 'phel/ grub/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen chos mdzad/ rje bla ma ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// yang na/ rmor chen gyi yig steng nas lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho nas/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mchog legs rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ chos rje bod 'brug pa blo gsal phun tshogs/ byams pa kun dga' mkhyen rab sangs rgyas/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// lung la/ nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung po 'ur 'ded kyi man ngag shar sbu chu ba dpal ldan grags pas bkod pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gsal ba'i sgron me/

gtor ma'i gsal byed dang bcas pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ brgyud 'debs ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa bcas gong dang 'dra// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i lugs kyi khyung nag me yi spu gri 'bar ba'i rjes gnang blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ pad+ma badz+ra/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ rgyal po dharma pā la/ bla ma zangs gling pa/ kham pa dbu se/ jo sras gnyal pa/ dar ma snying po/ gnyal ston rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal mgon po/ tshul khrims bzang po/ bu ston rin chen grub/ khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang*/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grub mchog chos kyi rdo rje/ dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ skyid shod ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ sprul sku blo bzang sbyin pa/ rje don yod mkhas grub/ dwags po blo bzang sbyin pa/ zhi bzang 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan/ klong rdol ngag dbang blo bzang*/ blo bzang bstan pa/ rta tshag ye shes bstan pa'i mgon po/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ khyung nag gdams pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa/ bkru byab srung gsum paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes gsung las btus pa/ rjes gnang blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa/ srung 'khor za yig yig rnying dang gu ge yongs 'dzin gyi gsung las btus pa bcas gong dang 'dra 'am snyam// ༈ /rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng gi gdams pa ye shes kyi khyung dmar po'i rjes gnang khyung nag la lha sngags kha bsgyur te thob pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ lung la/ ye shes bya khyung dmar po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung*/

rjes gnang gi tho dang bcas pa btsal// ༈ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa nas ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa brgyud pa dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i rjes gnang nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla brgyud grags chen bcu gcig zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag tshul bzang po/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ blo gros bzang po/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ drin chen kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las so// yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ rje bsod nams dpal ldan/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' 'chi med do// lung la/ byad ma 'bum rngugs kyi 'khor lo zhes lo rgyus/ las tshogs nyer lnga/ phyir zlog pa'i thabs rgyas bsdus/ drag mo la brten nas bzlog pa ste bla ma sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag sgrub thabs thal rdeb bcas/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs nyung bsdus dang bstod pa mkhyen brtses mdzad pa rnams gser pod ltar/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge nyung ngu rnam gsal sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang bzlas dmigs zhu chen mchod chog las byung ba/ sreg blugs kyi cho ga ye shes me lce/ bla brgyud byin rlabs char 'bebs/ sgrub thabs nyung 'dus bdud las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra bcas tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa rnams bka' 'bum rnams ltar ro//

༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma gong dkar lugs kyi rjes gnang las tshogs mngon rtogs shin tu zab pa'i skor la/ rjes gnang yig rnying gi steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ lung la/ rjes gnang*/ lo rgyus/ las tshogs bcu gcig srog sngags sham bcas/ zlog pa/ phyir zlog gnad yig mchan can/ mkha' 'gro ma'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa nyams su len thabs/ bstod pa/ bcas btsal// ༈ /ba ri lugs kyi seng gdong sngon mo gtso 'khor gsum can gyi rjes gnang paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i mngon rtogs la se ra rje btsun pa'i yig cha dang zhal shes bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo sbyar ba/ lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong can/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ sa chen gong ma lnga/ rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ rje dge 'dun grub pa/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ gtsang dge 'phel thub bstan rnam rgyal/ dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ gu ru sangs rgyas bkra shis/ bsam 'grub sgang pa blo bzang ngag dbang*/ klu 'bum ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ bla ma ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ brag g.yabs blo bzang bstan pa/ gdong kom phun tshogs rgya mtsho'am chos kyi rdo rje/ zhang zhung pa ye shes mtha' yas/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ rje blo bzang snyan grags/ dbal mang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ seng gdong sngon mo gtso 'khor gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa rdo rje'i sprin char rje bla mas mdzad pa// ༈ /bo dong pa grub chen sangs rgyas mgon po'i nye brgyud seng gdong rigs lnga'i rjes gnang yig rnying steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni slar btsal/

lung la/ seng gdong rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa phrin las rnam rol rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa// ༈ /ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la ye shes kyi ḍā ki nīs dngos su gnang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can dmar mo'i rjes su gnang ba paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang btsal/ lung la/ paṇa chen nags rin lugs seng gdong ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan rje bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa// ༈ /rje ba ri lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i man ngag gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ lung la/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gzungs bklag thabs dang bcas pa la/ sgom bzlas dang gzungs bklag thabs 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang tho bcas rin 'byung nas byung ba bka' 'bum dang gzhung ltar/ gdugs dkar 'don thabs thar lo'i lam srung ma blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa de nyid las/ zlog sgyur bya tshul lho brag grub chen gyis mdzad pa/ bstod pa sh+lo ka bcas btsal// ༈ /byad 'grol bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung btsal// ༈ /ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra nas paṇ+ḍi ta shu bhaṃ ka ra gup+ta la brgyud pa phyir zlog gi gdams pa zab mo khro bo gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang zhu chen rin po che'i yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sā la'i dbang po/ sangs rgyas shākya seng ge/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra gup+ta/ de la kha che paṇa chen bud+dha shrī dzñā na dang*/ grub chen ā nan+ta gup+ta gnyis kyis zhus/ gnyis kas chag dgra bcom/ chag chos rje dpal/ mkhan chen dbang phyug shes rab/
chag dbon bstan 'dzin dpal bzang*/ 'on 'jag min

'jag mo'i/ mkhas pa grub chen maṅga la shrī/ rje btsun dpal chen bzang po/ chos rje ye shes dpal bzang*/ des rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor dang*/ rdo rje gdan pa chos skyong bzang po gnyis/ gsum gas chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bla ma rin chen rgyal mchog chos rdzong pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sgom bzlas kyi man ngag sreg byed me'i 'khor lo/ bstod cing phrin las 'chol ba'i rab tu byed pa ste chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa gnyis gong dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang byad 'grol dang bcas pa'i lag len rnam gsal me long tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /gnod pa phyir zlog pa la mchog tu bsngags pa bha ya nā sa ni'i gdams ngag rdo rje gdan pa nas ba ri lo tsā ba brgyud rje sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i gzhung rtsa ba sa chen gsung sa paṇa mchan can/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum zur 'debs dang bcas pa mnga' ris tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi zur 'debs phyag len mchan can/ thab dpe bcas kyi lung rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal las gsan te brgyud pa btsal// ༈ /slob dpon rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa la rje btsun ma nyid kyis dngos su gnang ba'i gdams pa dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas thun mong ma yin par legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/

rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags/ dpal sa skya pa gong ma rnam bzhi/ 'u yug pa kun dga' bsod nams/ nyi 'og pa kun dga' smon lam/ bla ma yon tan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge/ des sangs rgyas seng ge dang*/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis/ gnyis kas thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ mkhyen rab ting 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros man 'dra'o// lung la/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong ma yin pa nyams su len tshul/ rjes gnang bcas dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rnams gong dang 'dra// ༈ /slob dpon ḍom+bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems rdo rje snying po/ ḍā ki nī su pra kī/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka

tsar+ṇa pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya gong ma rnam bzhi/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bla ma mnyam med pa/ mkhas grub gzungs kyi dpal ba/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dbon bsod nams rgyal mchog brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thu chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje btsun phrin las zhabs/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ yangs can mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/ lha khang mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub lha lnga'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga gsal ba'i sgron me ngag chos kyis mdzad pa gong dang 'dra// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos tshogs bdag dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas ngor lugs thun mong min pa'i lugs su legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ sha ba ri pa/ haṃ du dkar po/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ sa chen kun snying*/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen/ skyob pa rin chen dpal/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug dkon mchog 'phel ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/

rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ dkon mchog 'phel ba nas/ lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' rin chen/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shes rab rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun blo nas 'dra'o// lung la/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa gyi jo zla 'od 'gyur/ sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang gi cho ga 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bcas gong dang 'dra// ༈ /slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa la sogs pa nas brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i gser chos khro bo kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje'i gsal byed sbyar ba'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje chos/ ḍā ki bde ba rgyas byed/ dze tā ri/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ bde gshegs srung ba/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ rje sa paṇa/ bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang grags pa/ byang chub seng ge/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab mchog grub/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/

kun blo/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ ngor chen nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge man gong tshogs bdag dang 'dra/ lung la/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bcas gong dang 'dra// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos gnyan lo tsā ba'i dbang gi lha gsum zhes ku ru kul+le dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo ti nu ma gsum gyi rjes gnang ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ grags pa dpal/ bla ma 'phags pa/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rin chen dpal/ seng ge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thu chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje karma phrin las/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sa chen kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ rje btsun grags pa nas/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ brag thog pa man 'dra/ yang na des rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen man 'dra ste spyi'i brgyud pa dang*/

sger brgyud/ ti nu ma ni/ ku ru kul+le/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa/ gong ma lnga/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug man 'dra/ nor rgyun ma'ang de bzhin/ yang na gsum ga dmar po skor gsum ku ru kul+le dang 'dra bar mdzad do// lung la/ dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can gyi chos skor la/ gnyan lo'i u pa de sha sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa sa māsti ma thi/ rjes gnang*/ lo rgyus/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ zhal shes/ rjes gnang*/ ti nu ma'i skor la/ gdams ngag sa skya pa la brgyud pa thun min/ lung blang ba/ rjes gnang mchan can/ dbang gi lha gsum gyi rjes gnang bklags chog gsal ba'i sgron me ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa rje bla mas shin tu gsal bar bsdebs pa/ lha mo ti nu ma'i bstod pa yid 'phrog dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gnas gsar ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa bcas gong dang 'dra'am snyam// ༈ /slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje'i bka' srol ba ri lo tsā ba nas rje btsun sa skya pa la brgyud pa'i man ngag dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i rjes gnang ngag dbang legs grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri rin chen grags/ sa chen gong ma bzhi/ shākya 'od zer/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ seng ge dpal/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ klu pa bsod nams dar rgyas/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ grags pa 'byung gnas/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos mdzad/ kun dga' rnam rgyal/

nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims rab rgyas/ kun dga' bzang po/ thub bstan mkhan chen tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ ngor dpon slob ngag dbang legs grub snyan brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i man ngag dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa la/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i gsang sgrub slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ sngags kyi dag yig gtor ma/ lung len thabs/ sbyin sreg gi man ngag 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i man ngag bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang tho bcas/ bstod pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub las kyi man ngag bung ba myos pa'i 'gram chang*/ brgyud 'debs srid zhi'i dge legs char 'bebs bcas ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa rnams kyang gong dang 'dra'am snyam la/ dmar po skor gsum sogs 'di skor zhib par de'i be'u bum gyi lung brgyud las btsal// ༈ /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi phyag rdor dang rnam sras ser chen sbrags te sgrub pa'i rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ slob dpon kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje'am briṃ ga rasti/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston rdo rje rtse mo/ spur ston bsod nams rin chen/ 'jid phu pad+ma bkra shis/ stag pa jo bzang*/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug rin chen bsod nams seng ge/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/

bu ston rin chen grub/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ de dbon mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de 'di la brgyud pa'i khyad par mang du snang pa 'di dang 'brel min dpyad/ las so// lung la/ phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs dang rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ phyag rdor rnam sras sbrags sgrub kyi rjes gnang bcas dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ mchod 'bul bu ston rin po che'i bstod chen las byung ba bcas be'u bum ltar ram gong dang 'dra// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis dngos su gnang ba'i dzaṃ bha la dkar po 'brug zhon lha lnga'i nor sgrub rin chen spungs pa rgya brtson seng dang nag tsho lo tsā nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang kun dga' blo gros kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dpal ldan a ti sha /rgya brtson 'grus seng ge/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ skyi ston smon lam tshul khrims/ spyan snga bsod nams chos 'phel/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge/ srib ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lha phug pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ sangs rgyas 'od zer/

blo gros bzang po/ shākya bzang po/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ jo bo lugs kyi dzaṃ bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs sogs cha tshang ba la/ dzaṃ bha la dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ lo rgyus/ rjes gnang*/ bstod pa jo bos mdzad pa/ sgom bzlas rjes gnang bcas she'u lo tsā bas mdzad pa rnams gser pod ltar/ rjes gnang khams gsum dbang sdud sa chen kun blos mdzad pa/ phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i rdzing bu/ nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa 'dod rgu 'dren pa'i shing rta/ gsang ba gwa'u la brten nas sgrub pa rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i za ma tog bcas zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa rnams gong rjes gnang dang 'dra zhing*/ phyi ma bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu drug pa nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin gnod gnas ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sku gsung thugs mtha' rten dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang zab mo chu sbyin bcas yig rnying gi dgongs don 'khrul med ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal

bu ston yan lo chen lugs kyi dbang brgyud ltar la/ de nas khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ tsong kha chen po zhes byung*/ ba blo bzang grags pa yan gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang brgyud ltar la/ rje shes rab seng ge/ 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel ba/ rgyud chen bkra shis 'phags/ paṇa chen/ bsam grub rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags/ rgyud chen rdo rje bzang po/ rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ dol gsung rab gling pa blo bzang rin chen/ pho khang bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang chos 'dzin/ gdong kong mchog sprul rin po che phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ zhang zhung ba grub dbang ye shes mtha' yas/ yongs 'dzin dkyil khang pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ rgyal sras rin po che skal bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ stag phu sprul sku blo bzang chos kyi dbang phyug ra bla sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa'i dngos grub/ stag phu yongs 'dzin ye shes rgya mtsho/ chu bzang pa ye shes skal bzang mkhas grub/ the bo sprul sku rin po che ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ de las so// sgrub thabs rin 'byung nas byung ba ni de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar te bka' srol gcig 'dus so// lung la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dzaṃ bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud le'u bcu drug pa las gsungs pa'i sgrub thabs rgyud kyi dum bu/ de'i 'grel pa mchan bcas sgron gsal las byung ba/ sgrub thabs dge 'dun grub pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs rje bla mas mdzad pa rnams las rgyud kyi dum bu 'grel pa dang bcas pa ni gsang 'dus rgyud bshad kyi brgyud pa ltar dang*/ sgrub thabs gong dang 'dra'am snyam ste slar brtag/

༈ /paṇa grub chen po rdo rje gdan pa nas brgyud ba ri ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa las byung ba'i 'phags pa dzam+bha la ser po'i rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa spyi'i brgyud pa dang 'dra la/ yang na/ dkon mchog lhun grub yig steng nas dzaṃ ser nag gi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ dzai tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs dpal/ dpal tshul/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ rgyal tshab/ yongs 'dzin/ lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ sgrub khang pa/ dpal mchog sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun blo/ 'gyur med mchog grub/ phrin las yon tan/ bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ dpal gnod gnas kyi mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ de'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bcas gzhung dang*/ bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i gser chos dzam+bha la dmar po srog sgrub rmor chen yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ gnyis spangs pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ yar sgom se bo/ des dbon do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po chos ngag gi kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/

bsod nams dar/ rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ kun bzang rol pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen rin po che/ gnas gsar ba chen po/ 'jam mgon kun blo/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ dzaṃ dmar srog sgrub kyi gdams pa rje sa chen gyi man ngag yar klung pas mdzad pa mchan can/ rjes gnang gi tho gong dkar bas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang go bde bklags chog rmor chen gyis mdzad pa rnams las gong ma gnyis gser pod dang*/ phyi ma gong dang 'dra/ gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i dzam+bha la sum bsgril gyi man ngag kyang gong dang 'dra'am snyam ste brtag/ ༈ /grwa pa mngon shes dbang phyug 'bar gyi gter byon dzam+bha la dmar po gsung sgrub kyi rjes gnang dpal sa skya sngags 'chang chen po'i yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grwa pa mngon shes can/ grwa pa thugs rje 'bum/ shū la tsan+d+ra/ so ston tshul rgyal ba/ mkhan po nyi ma/ slob dpon don bzang*/ dbu ma pa grub brtson/ bka' bcu bkra shis bzang po/ bla ma blo gros bzang po/ rje btsun seng ge/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man btsal/ lung la/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la dmar po gsung gi sgrub pa'i skor la/ dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ dbang bskur bcas/ de'i gsal byed/ sgab 'dre mnan thabs gter gzhung*/ de'i zhal gdams/ sris rkun kha chings sre thod ma'i bca' thabs bcas gzhung yig rnying*/ rjes gnang bya tshul sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa brgyud pa bcas/ rgyun khyer dngos grub char 'bebs rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las kyis mdzad pa rnams te slar btsal// ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las bstan pa'i dzam+bha la ljang gu'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

gong rdo rje shugs kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra/ lung la/ bsdus rgyud ye shes le'u las byung ba'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad gsum/ de'i 'grel pa dri med 'od las byung ba/ rin 'byung nas byung ba'i sgrub thabs rnams kyang gong ltar// ༈ /paṇa chen shākya shrī nas khro phu lo tsā ba la brgyud pa dzam+bha la nag po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sarba dzña kṛṣ+ṇa ste slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa nag po/ des rjes su bzung ba'i rgyal po'i 'dun na 'don ka na ka shrī ste gser dpal/ byang chub sems dpa' gser gdugs can nam slob dpon nor sbyin/ paṇ+ḍi ta dbul po zangs gzhong can/ tshong dpon samyak+saṃ pa ka ste yang dag mdzes/ rin 'byung du ma ya sūr+ya/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba chen po/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal ba/ bsod nams stobs/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal grags pa/ rgyal phyag pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ 'jims chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang*/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' lhun grub/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu man 'dra/ yang na khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra bar byas kyang rung ngo*// lung la/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs kyi dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa la/ 'phags pa dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs shākya shrīs mdzad pa gnubs lo tsā'i 'gyur/ bstod pa tshig bzhi/ gnad drug lo rgyus/ rmugs 'dzin 'chol pa nag po'i sgrub thabs sbas pa bum 'khyil slob dpon nor sbyin gyis mdzad pa khro lo'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs bsdus don byams pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/

sprul pa'i phrin las gdul bya gzhan rgyud dang mthun pa'i rnam thar bstan pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum rin chen bdun ngos 'dzin/ grong khyer shing thags can gyi lo rgyus/ dbang phyug snying po'i gter bum nas/ hā'i phrin las kyis bkra shis gsol ba'i bar gyi las tshogs rnams skyogs lo'i mchan can/ bstod pa tshigs bcad dgu pa zhes thun mong gi dang*/ phrin las nyi shu'i sgo nas khyad par gyi bstod pa nor 'dzin dpal gyis mdzad pa khro lo'i 'gyur/ yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas bstod pa lo tsā ba rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ man ngag gi sgo nas bstod pa tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa/ thugs rje 'dod 'jo'i ba mo lha byang sems kyis mdzad pa rnams slar btsal/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bla mas bklags chog tu bkod bcas// ༈ /sgrub thabs rgya rtsa'i dzaṃ nag rjes gnang gong du song ltar la/ lung la/ u tsaṣ+ma dzam+bha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs dga' ba sbyin gyis mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ de'i man ngag bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gsung*/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rnams dzaṃ ser ltar// ༈ /paṇa grub dbang po rdo rje gdan pas legs par bkral zhing rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo'i rjes gnang thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ mkhas grub gzungs kyi dpal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ lha mchog seng ge/ bud+dha siṃ ha/ drang ti paṇa chen/

nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ byams pa smon lam grags pa/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so/ yang na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa spyi'i brgyud pa ltar dang*/ brgyud pa gzhan nor rgyun ma/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra/ shu dza ti/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ gau taṃ shrī/ kīrti paṇ+ḍi ta/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ bka' bcu gzhon seng*/ mgon po 'bum/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ go rams pa/ dkon mchog 'phel/ lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ hor nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhyen rab bstan pa'i dbang byung ba brtag phyug mkhyen rab 'gyur med mchog grub/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ mang thos ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// lung la/ lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa la/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs don yod rdo rje dang ba ri'i 'gyur/ gzungs kyi man ngag kīr+t+ti tsan+d+ra dang yar klung lo tsā'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa thar paṇa gsung rnams gong ltar// ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dza mā ri nas brgyud 'dzim lo tsā ba dang khro lo chen byams pa'i dpal gyis thugs gtsigs su mdzad pa'i 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo'i rjes gnang rin 'byung ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grub thob gcig la/ paṇ+ḍi ta ya mā ris zhus/ de la paṇ+ḍi ta aṃ bha tsār+ya/ de la shākya srung ba/ 'dzim lo tsā ba/ khams pa rdor rgyal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/

'di gnyis dkyus su med pa/ kun ldan ras pa/ khro phu lo chen byams pa'i dpal man chad gong gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ lung la/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza mā ri'i lugs kyi 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa la/ khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa las byung ba'i gzhung rtsa ba/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs so so'i gzhung ltar/ rig gtad gsal byed rje nyid kyis mdzad pa// ༈ /'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las bstan pa'i gnod sbyin dzam+bha la yab yum gyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa la/ rgyud le'u gnyis pa las phyung ba'i sgrub thabs/ de'i 'grel pa rje btsun grags pa'i gsung*/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las byung ba'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo sgrub tshul dpe'u ris bcas/ rgyud dang 'grel pa gong gzhan dag dang 'dra zhing*/ 'khor lo sgrub tshul btsal// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la brgyud pa'i tshogs bdag dkar po gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang she'u lo tsā ba'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo chen po/ dpal ldan dgon pa ba/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ sprul sku bya yul ba/ gtsang pa rin po che/ pha sangs rgyas sgom pa ba/ zem rin po che/ khams lung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa gsar ma/ rin po che bcu bzhi pa/ rin po che tshes bcu pa/ spyan snga grags she ba/ lo pa tshul dar/ rin chen bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rgyal sras ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/

de las so// lung la/ 'phags pa tshogs bdag dkar po jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba she'u lo tsā bas mdzad pa gong dang 'dra// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams la brgyud pa'i jo lugs tshogs bdag dkar po chags pa rdo rje gtso 'khor bzhi'i rjes gnang ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti/ rgyal po grags pa/ byang chub 'byung gnas/ rin chen 'od zer/ yang dag sbyin pa/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ jo bo rje/ grub thob shol po ba/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ sangs rgyas ston tshul/ khyung tshang ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon grags tshul/ snar thang mkhan po nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ bla ma bka' bcu pa/ gung pa bkra shis bzang po/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras/ rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi phyag bzhes gsal ba'i sgron me ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa brgyud yig bcas rjes gnang dang 'dra// ༈ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bkral zhing paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pas ba ri lo tsā ba la gnang ba nor lha dbyu gu mched gsum gyi gdams pa rjes gnang brgyud pa zur gsal ltar la/

lung*/ dpal sa skya pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can nor lha dbyu gu mched gsum gyi man ngag gi skor la/ sha za mo kun 'khyil gyi rtog pa las phyung ba'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ kun 'khyil ma'i don bsdus pa'i 'grel pa rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa ba ri dang pa tshab 'gyur/ bsnyen pa'i man ngag sgrub pa'i man ngag ba ri ba'i thugs dam/ 'dul 'dzin ser po la gnang ba'i gdams pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub lag bcangs thun mong ma yin pa le'u tshan/ bstod pa 'dod gsol dmigs pa bcas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab don dbyu gu ma spun gsum gyi man ngag zab la myur ba/ bris sku'i rab gnas/ yig chung*/ mkha' 'gro'i lag sgul/ dbang sdud bca' gzhi/ byi ba la brten nas sgrub pa/ yang mkha' 'gro lag 'gul/ rten bca' ba/ gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa rnams yig rnying*/ sgrub thabs ngag 'don gsal bar bkod pa sid+dhi pha la'i bang mdzod mkhyen rab byams pas mdzad pa/ rgyun bzlas rmor chen gsung*/ sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub dang*/ tsakra la brten nas dbang sdud zab mo'i lag len gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu sa lo kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa bcas gser pod ltar// ༈ /slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis bkral zhing lo chen rin chen bzang po nas brgyud rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon lcam dral lha gsum gyi rjes gnang mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrar+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo blo gros grags pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sa chen nas 'di yan dam pa kun dga' grags ma gtogs gdung brgyud kho nar byon pas zhal ngo nang brgyud ces grags/ rdo rings pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug phyi ma gnyis las mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dang*/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis/ gnyis ka las khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ de nas zhwa lu mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ 'khon ston kun dga' rin chen/ de sras rin chen/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ngor lugs ltar na/ 'phags pa rin po che zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje bsod nams dbang phyug rje btsun rdo rings pa man 'dra/ yang bla ma dam pa'i yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo pa chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ byang chub dbang rgyal/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims bkra shis/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ byams pa bstan pa rgya mtsho/ blo gros dbang phyug chos dbang rgya mtsho/ kun dga' chos 'phel/ dkon mchog sbyin pa/ gangs dkar mkhan chen bstan 'dzin tshul khrims/ de las so// lung la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa las byung ba'i sgrub thabs 'brog mi'i 'gyur la yar klungs pas zhus gtugs bgyis pa/

sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa lo chen rin chen bzang 'gyur sa chen gyi mchan bcas/ lcam dral lha gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa rnams mgon pod kyi brgyud pa ltar te gzhan du shes// ༈ /rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bya tshul blo yi mun sel shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i steng nas rjes gnang lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrar+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub shākya kun dga'/ 'dren mchog kun dga' legs pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de dbon rin chen mchog grub/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// gzhan dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi yig cha'i steng nas lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yan lha gsum dang 'dra/ de nas 'khon rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ de dbon kun dga' rin chen/

de sras grags pa blo gros/ de sras kun dga' blo gros bsod nams/ de sras bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ de sras bsod nams rin chen/ de sras kun dga' blo gros/ de sras dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de sras kun dga' rin chen/ de sras 'khon ston rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ dpal ldan chos skyong nas/ de sras kun dga' bkra shis/ de sras 'jam mgon bkra shis rin chen/ de las so// tshar pa nas brgyud pa thun mong thun min rjes gnang rnams 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub las nos pa gzhan du shes so// ༈ /thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yi ge'i steng nas ngor e waṃ pa'i lugs kyi zhal bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang yig cha'i lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de las/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*/ grub chen bud+dha shrī gnyis/ gnyis ka las ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ de nas/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge/ ngor dbon sangs rgyas seng ge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ de dbon nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de dbon rin chen mchog grub/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas nas/ rgyal rtse ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man 'dra/ yang na/ rin chen mchog grub nas/ chos rje rin chen lhun grub/ bla ma ngag dbang brtan pa/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// gzhan yang brgyud pa'i khyad par mang du yod pa gsan yig snga ma rnams las shes so// lung la/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i rgya gzhung*/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mchan bshad du grags pa bcas tshar chen yan gsan yig snga ma rnams su shes la/ de nas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ zhwa lu bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhas btsun dkon mchog grags pa/ rje kun dga' rab rgyas/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// paṇa chen rjes gnang gong dang 'dra ba'am bka' 'bum ltar// ༈ /dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgo nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag zla ba'i bdud rtsi shar bla ma kun dga' dpal ldan gyi yig steng nas rjes gnang lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ grub chen dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rnam gnyis/ bsod snyoms pa/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang ston/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ tshar chen rin po che/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga mi pham/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar ba/ sa chen kun blo/

kun dga' bkra shis/ kun dga' rin chen/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' dpal ldan/ gnyis ka las so// ༈ /dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang slob dpon a bha ya nas brgyud dpal stag lung pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni slar btsal// ༈ /rdo rje 'chang thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig steng nas 'khor mang gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems blo gros/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ slob dpon dpa' bo/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ khams pa a seng*/ gnyis kas phag gru rdo rje rgyal po/ 'bri gung skyob pa rin chen dpal/ skyi shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyi shod pa grags pa seng ge/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ 'bri gung lo tsā ba nor bu dpal/ sa bzang gzhon nu blo gros/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ sa chen grags pa blo gros/ ngor pa sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ dam chos bsam 'grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ ye shes kyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs la phyi sgrub nang sgrub gnyis kyi gzhung slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa a bha ya dang*/ rtsa mi'i 'gyur/ gsang sgrub spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mgon po sku rag ma'i rgya gzhung rje phag gru'i sku reg nas phyung ba/ bstod pa rkang brgyad klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa ding ri chos grags 'gyur/ gtor chog rje gnang tshe sgrub bcas dkon mchog lhun grub gsung*/

'khor mang gi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bcas thar paṇa gyis mdzad pa ste/ phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs ni rgya mtsho dang*/ zur mangs snyan brgyud ltar la/ phag gru'i sku rag ma'i gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam legs smin/ klu bu thub pa mo/ rā hu la bha dra/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ rta dbyangs/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ rtsa mi/ rgwa lo/ a seng*/ 'gro mgon/ phag mo gru pa/ dpal stag lung pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mkhas pa ba/ bkra shis bla ma/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ ka drug pa chen po/ chos rgyal mtshan/ stag lung ba ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon tshul mchog rje rnam rgyal zhabs/ kun dga' zhabs/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub/ rje grags pa legs grub/ bkra shis 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ 'phags mchog ngag dbang grags pa/ ngag dbang phrin las bstan 'dzin/ dge slong grags pa bstan 'phel/ thun dpon phrin las bstan 'dzin/ thun dpon dge legs dpal 'byor/ grags pa rin chen legs grub/ 'phags mchog chos dbyings lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ rje bla ma mang thos 'jam dpal rdo rje/ de las so// yig cha gzhan dag so so'i bka' 'bum ltar ro// ༈ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub nas mnga' bdag mar pa brgyud bla ma rngog pa'i bka' srung 'dod khams dbang phyug dud pa'i sol ba can gyi rjes gnang mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ lus med ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ zhu chos sdings pa/ sha sgang pa/ gnyags ston chen po/ gnyags dge bshes mus pa/ mdo sde grags pa/ slob dpon jo ye/ gnyags gnas gsar ba/ mus gle lung jo sras ma gcig dgon chung ma/

mus chen rgyal mtshan bzang po/ gu ge shrī rin po che/ smon lam rdo rje/ bsod nams blo gros/ rgyal mtshan bzang po/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal ba/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ stong ra ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang*/ mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ mus slob dpon chos 'phel lhun grub/ mkhan chen byams pa dpal ldan bzang po/ de las so// dpe bum yongs rdzogs lung kun blo yan rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ de nas/ zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma byams pa bstan 'dzin/ rje ye shes rgyal mchog byams pa dpal ldan bzang po/ de las so// yang na/ bla ma byams pa bstan 'dzin nas/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ ri khud mchog sprul kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta lwa ba dmar po nas brgyud pa dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo rje khol gnyis las khol mo re ma ti'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bzlas lung phyag mtshan gtor ma'i bka' bsgo thun mong min pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta lwa ba dmar po/ lce 'byung gnas bzang po/ gnubs rgyal ba'i ye shes/ zhang lo shes rab bla ma/ de sras dge 'dun bzang po/ de sras zhang dpal chen 'od/ de sras zhang rdo rje rtse mo/ zhang ding ri ba nyi ma 'od/ zhang bstan bzang pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ bsam gling pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba/ 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen mgon po/ chos rje nyi ma bshes gnyen/

chos rje dkon mchog bzang po/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ bo dong 'jam dbyangs ral gri/ nam mkha' smon lam/ rje nam mkha' snying po/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge/ yang dgon pa dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes bzang

rje dam chos bsam 'grub ces snang*/ po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man btsal/ lung la/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i rjes gnang*/ de la mkho ba'i rmor chen rin po che'i gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa ste shar chen pa'i gsung gong dang 'dra 'am snyam la/ phyi ma slar btsal// ༈ /grub chen la li ta badz+ra nas brgyud pa'i las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha ltar legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa/ don yod rdo rje/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā 'di med pa mang na/ bal po bha ro phyag rdum/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng*/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong pa shes rab seng ge/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ dpal ldan seng ge/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod nams grags/ gnyan ston rdo rje grags/ jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ dam chos bsam 'grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ dbon rin chen mchog grub/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan brtag 'dzin/ de las so// lung la/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs la li ta'i rgya gzhung*/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag rgya ston gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi mtshams sbyor rje ngag dbang legs grub gsung bcas la/

gzhung rnams rwa pod brgyud pa ltar dang*/ gzhan gnyis gsung 'bum ltar ro// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma badz+ra nas brgyud pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen pad+ma badz+ra/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dzñā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ dngul chu bai ro tsa na/ khams pa rgwa lo gzhon nu dpal/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ bla chen yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seng ge bzang po/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje rdo rings pa/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba/ sa chen kun blo/ lnga rig pa kun dga' bkra shis/ byams pa shes rab 'od zer/ 'khon ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs be'u bum yongs rdzogs/ bsnyen sgrub gsal byed zhu chen rin po ches mdzad pa/ sa lugs rjes gnang kun rin gyi gsung rnams las pod gzhung gong dang 'dra/ zhu chen pa'i bka' 'bum ltar dang*/ gzhan btsal bar bya'o// ༈ /ā ts+tshar+ya nyi 'od grags pa las brgyud de byung ba gnyan lo dar ma grags kyi bka' srung dpal mgon zhal gyi bka' sdod gnod sbyin bek+tsai can lcam sring gi rjes gnang ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ma hā de wa/ nyi 'od grags pa/ zla ba nag po/ shrī dha ra kra shu/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/

sa chen kun dga' snying po/ shod bu bkra shis 'od zer/ 'dar phywa ru ba rin chen bzang po/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ jo sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ slob dpon shes rab 'tsho/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge/ chos rje rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal/ byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin chen/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bye rdzing mkhan chen dpal 'byor phrin las/ dol paṇa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ ngag dbang dpal ldan chos skyong*/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ zur 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud/ dmar mo khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i rgyud gnyis/ chos skyong lcam sring gi rjes gnang*/ gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ha la nag po dug gi spu gri gnyis tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa rnams/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ yab rje dpal ldan chos skyong*/ yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ de sras 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ des bdag la dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog bla brang du rjes gnang gnyis dang bcas stsal ba'o// zhes byung*// ༈ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la mnga' bdag mai tri pas gnang ba dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang rgyas pa bar chad kun sel ngag dbang chos grags yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/
