rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang*/ drin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ yang na tshar chen nas/ bod mkhar ba mai tri/ spyan snga ba chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ 'dren mchog sangs rgyas bstan pa/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ 'jam mgon bsod nams dpal bzang*/ mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ mtshungs med ye shes rgyal mchog yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la/ ye shes mgon po'i lo rgyus/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs sri'u gso pa'i las mtha' dang bcas pa dpal sha ba ris mdzad pa/ gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa bar chad kun sel brgyud yig bcas ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa rnams gong dang 'dra'am snyam la shangs chos byings kyi brgyud par shes// ༈ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar can ma'i bka' srung dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ dzai tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/

ba ri lo tsā ba/ skyu ra a skyabs/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ pho rog mdo sde mgon/ rgan mo lhas pa/ 'jam dbyangs gzhi thog pa/ rong pa ā ka ra/ rje dkon mchog tshul khrims/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ chos rje tshul rgyal ba/ bya bral ba bsod nams rin chen/ nyug pa chos grags dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rin chen/ chos rje don yod rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' blo gros/ mkhas grub bshes gnyen bkra shis/ dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ chen po bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rje byams pa mkhas btsun/ sku zhang blo bzang mkhas btsun/ rje 'jam dpal bzang po/ sku zhang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ rin chen byams pa chos 'phel/ bla ma rin chen lhun grub/ lha btsun don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na/ rin chen lhun grub nas/ bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub/ de las so// 'di'i brgyud pa gzhan/ sangs rgyas/ gtsug tor dkar mo/ tsan+d+ra go mī sogs yig cha'i dkyus ltar shes par bya la/ rtsa ba'i brgyud pa ni gong du bshad pa nyid do// lung la/ dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum la gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga bar chad kun sel/ rjes gnang bya tshul bcas dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa yang rjes gnang dang 'dra// ༈ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i nor lha shin tu byin rlabs che ba mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang zhu chen yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dpal sha ba ri/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ grub thob rmog lcogs pa/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/

bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ byang sems sbyin pa bzang po/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ mang mkhar pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ pu rang dpal ldan dar po/ zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis dpal ldan/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs sam/ des gsan pa ltar gyi brgyud pa dngos ni/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nas/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas bzang po/ mtsho sgo ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las so// ngag dbang chos grags yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni brgyud pa gong ma ltar la/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bkra shis/ pad+ma bdud 'dul dbang phyug kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa'i mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i skor la/ dkar chag sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gdams ngag dbang gi rgyal po mkhas grub khyung pos rmog lcogs pa la gdams pa'i snyan brgyud mchan can/ brgyud pa bcas/ bstod pa dgos 'dod 'byung ba khyung pos mdzad pa/ lo rgyus/ gtor chog mchod 'bul/ skong ba/ rjes gnang*/ las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa/ bum gter bca' thabs/

dbang sdud 'khor lo'i man ngag sbyin sreg gter bum bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo/ bstod pa chos dbyings spros bral ma rmog lcogs kun dga' 'od kyis mdzad pa/ rab gnas te yig rnying*/ sgrub thabs dngos grub rgya mtsho tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi yi ge grol mchog gsung*/ rjes gnang gi phyag len bklags chog ngag chos kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po/ sbyin sreg bklags pas don grub/ gnad nas skul ba'i tshigs bcad/ brgyud 'debs kha skong bcas/ na mo bud+dha'i gsol 'debs/ be'u bum gsar bsgrigs gnang ba'i dkar chag bcas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhu chen paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa zhu chen yan de'i gsan yig ltar la/ sgrub thabs las tshogs khyung pos mdzad pa dang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bcas kyi brgyud pa ni/ zhu chen nas/ zhu dbon dge legs lhun grub/ zhu slob kun dga' don grub/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ 'dir 'jam dbyangs blo gsal yod dam brtag de las so// de ma gtogs pa'i lung gzhan gyi brgyud pa ni zhu dbon man 'dra ba'am/ yang na/ mkhan dbon kun dga' grags pa/ bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan phrin las/ de las so// ༈ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i bka' rnams las snying zhugs thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtor chog dang*/ skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/

chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ sngags 'chang rdo rje gzhon nu/ mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang*/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grub chen chos rdo rje/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ skyid shod sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las/ khri yang steng pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ khri chen blo bzang dar rgyas/ zhal snga nas blo bzang sbyin pa/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ dpal ldan thub bstan rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa smin grol rgya mtsho/ zhabs drung rin po che 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de las so// yang na/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas/ 'khrul zhig rin chen bshes gnyen/ rab 'byams smra ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rje skyabs mchog dpal bzang*/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub man 'dra/ yang na/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan nas/ spang lung ngag dbang chos 'dzin/ se ra byes blo'i slob dpon/ mkhan chen shes rab grags pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa smin grol rgya mtsho man 'dra// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i zhal gzigs gur mgon sprin gseb ma'i rjes gnang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi yig steng nas lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ rdo rings pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ de dbon ngag dbang nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin lnga pa kun dga' bsod nams/ zhwa lu bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ bstan 'dzin drug pa blo bzang chos kyi dbang phyug

gnyis kas drung chen bsod nams mchog grub/ bstan 'dzin bdun pa ye shes lhun grub/ dge slong blo bzang yar 'phel/ bstan 'dzin brgyad pa rin po che mkhyen rab mthu stobs/ de las so// ༈ /grub chen thang rgyal gyi bka' srung mgon po bdun rdzogs kyi ya gyal bram nag bshan pa drug bskor gyi rjes gnang dbang phyug rab brtan zin bris la rjes gnang spyi chings sbyar ba'i steng nas lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ rgya gar kā ma rū pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma grong mo che pa/ rje re ta zla ba/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' 'gyur ba bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur chos dbyings rang grol/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gang dkar mngon dga' ba mang thos rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ stag phu ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ yongs 'dzin blo gros 'od zer/ mus chen chos nyid ye shes/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// ༈ /jo bo rje lha gcig nas brgyud pa'i mgon po stag zhon gyi rjes gnang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang yig cha ltar lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ grub thob bi ha ra/ rat+na kīrti/ bi ri se haṃ/ jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad/ 'ban dkon mchog blo gros/ bla ma shākya 'bar/ mkhar ston nam mkha'/ lce mdo sde seng ge/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ de sras shes rab seng ge/ gcung ye shes dngos grub/ rin chen dpal bzang*/ lce dbang phyug rdo rje/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

bsod nams chos 'phel/ gnyis kas dbang phyug rab brtan/ byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ hor nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dam chos bsam 'grub/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de dbon rin chen mchog grub/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan

brtag 'dzin/ de las so// 'di'i brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan gsar rnying lnga tshar chen rin po cher 'dus pa'i tshul gzhan du shes so// lung la/ gtor chog dang rjes gnang nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa gong ltar dang*/ skong ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa ni bka' 'bum ltar ro// ༈ /grub chen mi tra dzo gi nas khro phu lo tsā bar brgyud dpal zhwa lu pa'i srung ma mgon po bing dmar lha gnyis pa'i rjes gnang dbang rab pa'i tho yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ mi tra dzo ki/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bsod nams dbang phyug bsod nams seng ge/ rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo tsā rin chen rnam rgyal/ nam mkha' mchog grub/ nam mkha' 'bum/ zla ba'i dpal/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rin chen mchog grub dpal/ rje tshul khrims bzang mo/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug byams pa bskal bzang*/ dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'dir brgyud tshul gcig la/ ngag dbang blo gsal mchog ldan/ chos rje smon lam lhun grub/ blo bzang mkhas btsun zhes byung*/ rin chen 'jam dbyangs/ blo bzang mkhas btsun/ 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ byams pa smon lam bsam gtan/ byams pa chos gcig la 'di gnyis ma byung*/ 'phel/ byang gling ye shes dpal 'byor/ zhwa lu ye shes mkhas mchog rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de las so// lung la/ gtor chog mkhyen brtse/ skong ba blo gsal zhabs/ rjes gnang dbang rab/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo blo gsal zhabs kyis mdzad pa bcas rje de nyid las so// ༈ /tshar chen rin po che'i yig cha'i steng nas dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang bka' rgya can thun mong ma yin pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen yan rjes gnang gi yig cha ltar la/ de nas/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug

dbang phyug rab brtan/ bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gnas gsar ba/ bod 'brug pa blo gsal phun tshogs/ khri chen kun dga' mkhyen rab/ rje 'gyur med mchog grub/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// 'dir bzhugs rjes gnang thun mong ba'i brgyud pa 'di dang gcig gam dpyad/ lung la/ gtor chog rin rnam pa'i gsung dang*/ rjes gnang gi tho mkhyen rab chos rje'i gsung ltar bris pa bcas gong dang 'dra 'am brtag/ ༈ /thar rtse paṇa chen yig cha'i sngags 'chang chen mo'i yig cha yang yod/ steng nas gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ dpal o rgyan rin po che/ paṇa grub dharma pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng yon tan tshul khrims/ de la/ mal lo tsā ba dang*/ 'bram jo sras zhang dge gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ de nas/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ gra thang mkhan chen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rin chen/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ yar klung pa nam mkha' legs pa/ de las/ bla ma dam pa ngag dbang rin chen dang*/ bla ma ngag dbang chos 'byor gnyis kyis gsan/ gnyis ka las bla ma ngag dbang bzang po/ 'jam mgon ngag dbang legs grub/

de las so// yang ngor lugs ltar na bla ma dam pa nas/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo kun dga' bsod nams/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ ngor dbon sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na sa lo nas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra/ bod kyi gter brgyud ltar na/ dpal o rgyan chen po/ mkhar chen mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ lo chen rin bzang man snga ma ltar ro// 'di ni thar paṇa yig steng nas gsan pa'i tshul te/ sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung steng nas gsan pa'ang 'di dang 'dra 'am snyam la rje nyid kyis gsan yul dpal sa skya pa kun dga' rin chen yin nam snyam// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur gnyis kyi bka' srung dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gyi yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu/ pad+mā ka ra/ 'khon klu dbang srung ba/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ 'khon shes rab yon tan/ 'khon tshul khrims rgyal po/ 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong*/ 'khon ston bal po/ 'khon shākya blo gros/ 'khon shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ 'khon ston sa chen gong ma rnam lnga/ gnam kha'u pa/ 'od ldan dpal/ khu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis/ ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma shes rab 'od zer/ ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ sa chen kun dga' snying po nas/ glo bo rdo rje srin po/ glo bo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gnam kha'u pa man 'dra'o// yang na/ kun blo nas/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ sngags 'chang bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ kun blo nas/ paṇa chen kun dga' bkra shis/ yab rje kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// ༈ /dkar chag dkyus su ma 'khod pa kha skong gi bskor la/ lha mo shra ma ṇa'i rjes gnang ri bo dge ldan pa'i phyogs la yongs su grags pa thu kwan yig cha ltar ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ kun dga' bo/ nyi ma gung pa/ sha na'i gos can/ kha che thams cad mkhyen pa/ nye sbas/ rgya mtsho skyob/ dze tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ kha che man ka skyo lo tsā ba/ la stod dbang phyug rin chen/ mchims ston brtson 'grus seng ge/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje 'jam gsar ba/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin chen grub/ don grub rgyal mgon/ bkra shis rin chen/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ gu ge grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ dge legs dpal bzang*/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'jam dbyangs don grub/ blo bzang don grub/

dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ khyab bdag bde ba'i rdo rje/ zhi bzang sprul sku dge legs rgyal mtshan/ ser smad mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ khal kha dam tshig rdo rje/ shar rtse blo bzang yon tan/ zhi bzang 'phags pa don grub/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan las gsan cing*/ shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs shel dkar me long gung thang pa bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa de nyid nas/ dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// ༈ /dpal ldan srad brgyud pa'i lugs kyi ri khrod ma ser mo rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang yig rnying ltar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ ā tsār+ya yo gī shwa ri nas rim bzhin/ gru tshang gi sngags pa grub chen/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ blo bzang chos 'dzin/ blo bzang bstan pa/ gdong kom phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ mang thos dge legs rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang phrin las/ skal bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan/ ra bla blo bzang bstan pa'i don grub/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgya mtsho/ lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na/ gdong kom phun tshogs rgya mtsho nas/ snub ston bzhad pa rdo rje/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ stong skor 'jam dpal dge legs rgya mtsho/ skal bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// yang na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po/ shes rab seng ge/ 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po/ rgyud chen 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun 'phel/ rgyud chen bkra shis 'phags/ rgyud chen bsam 'grub rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen brtson 'grus 'phags/ rgyud chen rdo rje bzang po/ rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel nas 'dra'o// de brgyad la rgyud chen rnam brgyad zer/ brgyud pa 'di ltar zhi bzang gsan yig na yod cing nye brgyud yin par grags so// lung la/

srad brgyud lugs kyi ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi bsnyen pa bya tshul/ las sbyor gyi khyad par/ bum chog brgyad thod la brten pa'i rims srung*/ spyi 'joms ril bu'i sbyor ba/ srung zhing mtshams gcod pa sogs phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa nad rims kun sel bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ spyi 'joms ril bu'i sdeb sbyor zhal byung lo rgyus dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig gis 'bring mtshams kyi sngags pa zhig la gnang*/ de nas rim par rang gi rigs brgyud kho nar chig brgyud du gnang ba las phyis srad brgyud rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sngags pa de'i rigs su 'khrungs pas rang gi khu bo sngags btsun zhig las gsan/ de nas rim par/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ khri chen bsod nams dbang rgyal/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams las brgyud pa lha mo dpal chen ma'i sgom lung 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho'i yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa rin 'byung ltar na/ rnam sras ser chen brgyud pa dang phal cher mthun pa las/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho man spyi dang 'dra/ lung la/ lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgom lung man ngag dang bcas pa la/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub le'u gnyis pa nas bstan pa'i gsang sngags las tshogs bcas rgyud kyi dum bu mchan ma khol phyung*/ rin 'byung las byung ba'i sgrub thabs/ g.yang skyabs 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs karma chags med kyis mdzad pa/ zur 'debs yongs 'du'i snye ma dang*/ mjug chog nyung ngur bsdus pa 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa bcas te/

rgyud kyi dum bu dang*/ rin 'byung gzhung ltar/ gzhan rje nyid las so// ༈ /paṇa chen rdo rje gdan pa nas ba ri lo tsā ba la brgyud lha mo kun 'khyil mched gsum mam dbyu gu mched gsum gyi rjes gnang gzim 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las kyi yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ de gnyis kas ba ri lo tsā/ sa chen gong ma rnam lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa thu chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ gong dkar phrin las rnam rgyal/ blo gros dbang phyug chos dbang rgya mtsho/ phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ kun dga' rnam rgyal/ gong dkar mkhan chen bstan 'dzin tshul khrims/ de las so// yang na rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal nas/ byang chub dpal rgyal/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ tshul khrims bkra shis/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ bstan pa rgya mtsho/ blo gros dbang phyug chos dbang rgya mtsho/ kun dga' chos 'phel/ dkon mchog sbyin pa/ rje bstan 'dzin tshul khrims/ de las so// yang*/ bstan 'dzin brgyad pa mkhyen rab mthu stobs las kyang nos so// ༈ /jo bo rje lha gcig nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa gsar rnying las brgyud pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang*/ gtso bor so so'i sku bskyed bstims/ gsung bzlas lung yongs rdzogs/ thugs 'od gsal gyi ngang du 'jog pa/ lha bstim pa bcas rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ bya mchad ka ba/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/

mchims nam mkha' grags/ ze'u sku mched/ mchims blo bzang grags/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub/ gnas rnying pa kun dga' bde legs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ rje dge 'dun bkra shis/ rje mi g.yo snying po/ sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang mchog ldan/ rje ngag dbang blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ gung thang pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// ༈ /lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i yig steng nas rdo rje sems dpa' yum bcas kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal sras blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ ma taṅgi pa/ grub chen tai lo pa/ na ro pa/ sgra bsgyur mar pa/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ gad pa ki'arti/ bya rkang pa bsod nams rin chen/ thur lha ba/ thang spe ba/ gser sdings pa/ kun mkhyen chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ khyung lhas pa/ rje tsong kha pa/ rje shes rab seng ge/ rgyud chen dpal ldan bzang po/ dge 'dun 'phel/ bkra shis 'phags/ bsam 'grub rgya mtsho/ brtson 'grus 'phags/ rdo rje bzang po/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog yar 'phel bar rgyud chen dang*/ de nas lcang skya ngag dbang chos ldan/ ar rtse blo bzang chos 'dzin/ lcang skya ye shes bstan sgron/ rje ngag dbang chos grags/ rje ngag dbang phrin las/ ar rtse dge legs chos 'phel/ har chen no yon ho thog thu ye shes skal bzang*/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub/ de las so// ༈ /skyid shod pa'i yig cha'i steng nas rdor sems yab rkyang gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje shes rab seng ge/

rgyud chen sbyin pa dpal/ rje smra ba'i seng ge/ sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ rje mi g.yo snying po/ sgom sde ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ skyid shod rdo rje 'chang*/ rje blo bzang sbyin pa/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho/ byes zur ngag dbang don grub/ brag ri rdo rje 'chang*/ rwa bsgrengs ye shes bstan pa dar rgyas/ khri chen byang chub chos 'phel/ chu bzang dge bshes skal bzang mkhas grub/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de las so// ༈ /rdor sems bla med rjes gnang ni/ mdzad pa po/ hu thog thu blo gros kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ lcang lung paṇ+ḍi ta/ mchog sprul grags pa bstan 'dzin/ sde khri rin po che 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma/ zhabs drung dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ chu bzang pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ rgyud stod dge bshes rmu li ba sbyin pa mthu stobs/ bshes gnyen dam pa ye shes gong 'phel/ de las so// ༈ /skyid shod pas mdzad pa'i rdor sems rjes gnang yig lung*/ mdzad pa po/ dwags po blo bzang sbyin pa/ zhi ba lha bzang po/ se ra rtse blo bzang snyan grags/ pha bong kha pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor/ lha btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dge bshes ye shes gong 'phel/ de las so// phur bu lcogs byams pas mdzad pa'i rdor sems ril sgrub/ mdzad pa po/ dpon slob blo bzang thugs rje/ spang lung pa ngag dbang chos 'dzin/ rgyud stod mkhan chen dge 'dun dar rgyas/ khri chen blo bzang snyan grags/ dge bshes ye shes gong 'phel/ de las so// ༈ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i drang nges kyi sngags 'bru gsum btu zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa gu ge yongs 'dzin rin po che blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi yig cha'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/

slob dpon klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ rgyal rigs sprin gyi shugs can/ 'gos lo khug pa lhas btsas/ mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rngog ye shes seng ge/ rngog ār+ya de wa/ glan btsad tsha nyi ma lcam/ stag pa ba rin chen grags/ thur lha ba/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sding pa gzhon nu grub/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang po/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ rje bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas grub shes rab seng ge/ 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po/ rgyud chen dge 'dun 'phel/ bkra shis 'phags/ brtson 'grus 'phags/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ rje ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ rje ngag dbang blo bzang*/ mkhan chen blo bzang dpal ldan/ khyab bdag blo bzang yon tan/ sman rams pa blo bzang bsod nams/ rje ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang bkra shis/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ brag sgom zhabs drung ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// ༈ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu ba'i phyag len dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa bshad rgyun dang zung 'brel du byung ba mkhas grub chen po 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje'i yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen lū hi pa/ dā ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu/ ru sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/

bu ston rin chen grub/ mkhas grub khyung po lhas pa/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor dbon sangs rgyas seng ge/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ gung thang lo chen bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ gangs dkar ba mang thos rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ brag sgom zhabs drung rin po che ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying rnams btu ba'i phyag len rjes gnang dang bcas pa lha btsun rin chen rgya mtsho'i yig steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ kā ra/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng*/ rgwa lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ rong pa ye shes seng ge/ bla ma ye shes dpal ba/ chos rje don grub rin chen/ rje bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal po/ lha btsun rin chen rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ dmar ston tshul khrims rin chen/ rje dge 'dun bkra shis/ slob dpon chos grags 'od zer/ paṇa chen chos yar 'phel/ rje blo bzang chos rgyan/ sngags chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ skyi shod sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las/ paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang sbyin pa/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ de las so// yang na/ mkhas grub rin po che nas/ ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ grub chen chos rdo rje/

dben sa pa blo bzang don grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan man 'dra// ༈ /dngul ri bla ma dharma bha dras mdzad pa'i bde mchog sngags btu'i byin rlabs legs bshad gser gyi thur ma dang*/ 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang rab gsal sgron me gnyis kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mdzad pa po nas/ dbon 'jam dbyangs rdo rje/ chos mdzad dge legs mchog ldan/ dge bshes rin po che ye shes gong 'phel/ de las so// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang dngul chu bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa yan chod btsal/ de nas rim brgyud zhwa lu mchog sprul blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de las so// ༈ /'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa'i bka' 'bum nas/ bla med lhan skyes rnam pa bzhi zhes/ gsang gsum 'dus pa'i sgeg rdor lugs/ bde mchog dril bu lugs/ dgyes rdor shān+ti pa'i lugs/ dus 'khor rā hu la shrī bha dra'i lugs rnams kyi dbang*/ de rnams dang rjes 'brel rdzogs rim la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs/ bde mchog rim lnga dril bu lugs/ dgyes rdor chos drug nā ro lugs/ dus 'khor rdzogs rim kaṣ+mī ra pa sau ma nā tha'i lugs te/ de'ang sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rdzogs rim snying po don gyi phreng ba dag gi lung bcas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i brgyud pa/ bu ston rin po che nas/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra kīrti/ rje ye shes rgya mtsho/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ bla ma rin chen rgyal po/ grub chen pad+ma gar dbang*/ rje mang thos rnam rgyal/ slob dpon bsod nams chos 'phel/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug rje chos kyi grags pa'o// nā ro chos drug rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ phag gru/

'bri gung pa rat+na shrī/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ gcung rdo rje grags pa/ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams/ bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ don grub rgyal po/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ stag lung pa ngag dbang grags pa/ wam̐ rin chen chos rgyal/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen/ rje rin chen phun tshogs/ paṇa chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ rgyal dbang chos rgyal phun tshogs/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs/ rje chos kyi grags pa'o// bde mchog dril bu lugs/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ dril bu pa/ dza len+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ til+li pa/ nā ro pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal rgwa lo chen po/ rje phag mo gru pa/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje/ slob dpon dbang phyug bsod nams/ mkhas grub grags pa shes rab/ kun mkhyen tshul rgyal ba/ mtshungs med grags pa rdo rje/ gtsang pa blo bzang pa/ mkhan chen rin chen bzang po/ rje bsod nams mtshan can/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs/ de sras chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rje chos kyi grags pa'o// dus 'khor sbyor drug ma byung ba slar btsal/ de dag gi byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi brgyud pa la/ bde mchog ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dga' rab rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen gong ma lnga/ lung phu ba/ sems che ra ba/ grub chen bud+dha na pa/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bkra shis dpal grub/ grags pa legs grub/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dpal 'bri gung pa chen po chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul/ lho dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan/

don grub chos kyi rgyal po/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ mgar chos kyi nyi ma/ sprul sku chos nyid nor bu/ rje dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ don grub chos kyi rgyal po nas/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi nyi ma/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de las so// ༈ /sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi gsang 'dus dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bzang po'i lugs kyi dus 'khor ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rā hu la shrī/ bi khyā ta de ba/ bud+dha shrī/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ sbyang lung pa/ red mda' ba chen po/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ byang sems shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog rje lung rig rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' snying po man gong bde mchog ltar ro// ༈ /shān+ti pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje ni gong gi bde mchog dang 'dra'o// zhes byung ste dbang khrid kyi brgyud pa so sor bzhugs na 'di ltar yin rung zhing*/ brgyud khungs legs par dpyad par 'os so// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur gnyis zhes yongs su grags pa'i ya rgyal 'khon lugs yang dag zla gam gcig ma'i byin rlabs legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang*/ longs sku dpal he ru ka rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ ro langs bde ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ hūm̐ ka ra/ pad+ma thod phreng*/ bi ma mi tra/ shī la mañdzu/ rdo rje bdud 'joms/ dzña na ku mā ra/ 'khon klu dbang srung ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ gtsug tor shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong*/ bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje btsun gong ma lnga/ gnam kha'u pa/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/

lo mchog pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ chos sgo ba shes rab rdo rje/ chos dpal shes rab/ yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ klu pa bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo rin rgyal/ sa lo kun bsod/ sgo rum pa kun legs/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbang phyug rab brtan/ a mes zhabs/ bsod nams dbang phyug bsod nams mchog grub/ gong dkar phrin las rnam rgyal/ sgyi chu mkhan po blo gros dbang phyug rnam grong pa chos dbang rgya mtsho/ grub rgyal gling pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rnam grong ye shes rnam rgyal/ gong dkar mkhan chen bstan 'dzin tshul khrims/ de las so// lung la/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra'i rgya gzhung yang dag par grub pa'i brgyud pa btsal/ zla gam gcig ma la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa de nyid las so// ༈ /'khon lugs dpal rdo rje phur pa'i gtor dbang dbang chen gyi rjes 'brel du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu dbang srung ba nas/ bla ma dam pa'i bar yang dag dang 'dra/ de nas/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rgya gar ba/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ bsod nams dbang po/ grags pa blo gros/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis/ bsod nams rin chen/ kun dga' blo gros/ dbang sdud snying po/ ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// phur pa rtsa dum rgyud sa paṇa 'gyur rgyud 'bum ltar dang*/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub skor rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa/ mchod gtor bsdus pa/ bzlas pa/ srung ba/ gdon 'dul/ rgyan gyi gdams ngag sangs rgyas lag bcangs rdzogs rim bcas yig rnying rnams bka' 'bum ltar ro// sa lo'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can kun blos mchan dkyus bsdebs nag 'gros gnang ba/

sgrub thabs nges don thig le kun blos mdzad pa las/ sa lo'i gsung de nyid nas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams/ yab rje kun dga' bkra shis man stod las dbang brgyud dang 'dra/ kun blo'i gsung nyid nas 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ kun dga' rin chen/ de las so// rgyun gyi nyams len thugs kyi thig le/ brgyud 'debs bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng mdzes/ gtor dbang byin rlabs bcud thigs rnams 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi mdzad pa rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /yang phur thun mong gi man ngag a ti'i khrid yig thar pa'i sgo gcig bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma las so// ༈ /tshar chen yig steng nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni gzhung du gsal ba ltar la brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan/ tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas/ gro lung pa bsod nams chos 'phel/ brag rtsa ba blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ yab rje kun dga' blo gros/ kun mkhyen ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// lung la/ gsang sgrub kyi gzhung rtsa ba le tshan drug tshar chen gyi mngon rtogs dang*/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga ngag dbang chos grags kyi sgrub rjes/ lnga pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs/ pad phrin gyi rgyun khyer/ bsnyen yig sbyin sreg bcas kyi yig cha gzhan dag gi lung byin rlabs rjes gnang gi brgyud pa gzhung du gsal ba dang 'dra'am snyam la/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gsung de nyid nas/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ rje ngag dbang blo gros/ gnyos ston blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang snyan grags rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin chos rdo rje/ bla ma dge legs yon tan/ chos rje mkhyen rab phrin las/

ngag dbang chos 'byor/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// pad phrin bsnyen yig dang*/ rgyun khyer gnyis de nyid nas/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba man rjes gnang dang 'dra/ sbyin sreg mdzad pa po nas dge slong pad+ma mdo sde/ khams lung pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ grub dbang kun bzang bsam 'grub/ kun bzang snyan grags rgya mtsho man 'dra'o// ༈ /gter ston sum tshogs kyi gter byon rta mgrin yang gsang khros pas grub thob 'dar 'phyar ba la bka' babs pa'i gtor dbang 'dar ston blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma las thob pa'i brgyud pa gtor dbang du gsal ba ltar la ring brgyud slob dpon rin po che nas/ gter ston rkyang po grags dbang*/ sum pa dbang tshul/ 'bre shes rab bla ma/ 'brug tshang zhang ston gzi brjid 'bar/ dha na'i bla ma rgya/ de nas grub thob 'dar 'phyar la'o// yang na/ 'khrul zhig dkon mchog bzang po nas/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ kun mkhyen rdo rje thogs med/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ kun dga' blo gros/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen bkra shis rin chen/ de las so// lung la/ yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer/ phyag rgya rkyang sgrub kyi rnal 'byor/ byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur rnams tshar chen rin po che dang*/ rje bla ma'i gsung ste gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ /gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter byon bla sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i zlum po bzhi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang mtha'/ longs sku thugs chen/ sprul sku pad 'byung*/ mtsho rgyal/ chos dbang*/

sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje/ dwags ston dbang phyug rdo rje/ gnyen ston ye shes rdo rje/ se sdings pa/ sangs rgyas dpal/ de sras yon tan bzang po/ gu ru chos sku 'od zer/ mtshungs med dpal 'byor dbang phyug sprul sku chos kyi dbang po/ rig 'dzin karma gu ru/ grub chen kun bzang dpal 'byor/ rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ o rgyan gter bdag gling pa/ rgyal sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ khri chen pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ 'gyur med phrin las rnam rgyal/ de las rje btsun rin po che 'gyur med phrin las chos sgron dang*/ mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal gnyis/ gnyis ka las khri chen 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'/ de las so// lung la/ bla ma gsang 'dus kyi gzhung rtsa ba'i yig cha/ las byang snying po rab gsal 'gyur med rdo rje'i chog bsgrigs/ bsnyen yig ma bu gter chen yab sras kyis mdzad pa rnams te mkhas grub bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas las gsan nam dpyod// ༈ /tshar chen rin po che'i nye brgyud o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa ni/ mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen bi dza ya/ grub dbang bstan pa rab rgyas/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang*/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ rig 'dzin kun dga' rnam grol/ nam mkha' legs pa/ mkhyen rab bde chen/ bstan pa rab rgyas/ phrin las yon tan/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// gzim 'og mchog sprul gong ma dang*/ yongs 'dzin phrin las yon tan gyi gsung o rgyan bla ma mchod chog skor/ brgyud 'debs/ smon tshig bla mchod 'dod 'jo'i bsam 'phel/ gsol 'debs rnams mdzad pa po gzim 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las dang*/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/

de las mchog sprul bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub btsal// ༈ /mnga' bdag gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter byon thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi dbang mes ston 'gro don rab 'phel gyi yig cha'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ ḍā ki gar gyi dbang phyug o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal sras pad+ma dbang chen/ drin can sangs rgyas kun grol/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol/ bla ma sangs rgyas lhun dbang*/ sbas ston rdo rje gzhon nu/ sbas ston dkon mchog dpal bzang*/ gnubs rin chen dpal bzang*/ gnubs chen rgyal sras pad+ma/ bla ma bkra shis dpal dbang*/ nub dgon sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ sprul sku mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bla ma rin chen rdo rje/ skyi ston tshe ring dbang po/ sprul sku shākya rgyal mtshan/ bla ma nor bu rin bzang*/ grub dbang sangs rgyas mchog grub/ grub mchog o rgyan yongs grags/ mes ston 'gro don rab 'phel/ 'gro mgon bsod nams dpal ldan/ 'khrul zhig bstan 'dzin chos rgyan/ grub dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ grub mchog sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mus chen bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang*/ 'dar grong chen slob dpon kun dga' 'jam dpal/ de las so// yang na/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang nas/ khyab bdag ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang*/ dong sprugs dbang gnyis/ lung rdzogs par nos pa/ khra tshang pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs legs bshad rgya mtsho/ kha mo ba spang ston dbang phyug grags pa/ 'bras ljongs spang ston gsang bdag rdo rje/ de sras kun bzang pad+ma tshe dbang*/ khyab bdag phyag na pad+mo 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/

de las so// yang lung skor/ gsang bdag rdo rje/ ye shes lhun grub/ 'dar pad+ma bdud 'dul/ 'dar blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de las so// ༈ /gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi tshe sgrub bu ston gong khug ma kun mkhyen rin chen grub kyi rnam 'phrul zhwa lu mchog sprul rin po che las gsan pa'i brgyud pa gzhung de nyid du gsal ba ltar dang*/ bo dong lugs kyi dbang bskur rdo rje phag mo las gsan nam snyam ste slar brtag/ ༈ /'phags yul grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyi lugs 'brug chen chos kyi snang ba'i yig cha rje gu ṇa'i zhabs kyi lhan thabs sbyar ba'i steng nas legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ mkha' 'gro ma ko ki lī dang*/ dharma na wā mched gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpa' bo 'od gsal/ bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la/ grub thob dza ba ri ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta a bha ya dā na shrī/ rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ mi nyag smon grub shes rab/ bla ma rat+na gu ru/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ rgan mo lhas pa byang chub dpal/ stag ston gzhon nu dar/ ngag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bra 'or mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma bde legs pa/ 'phags mchog bsod nams dar/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ tre bo chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog lha dbang grags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po/ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho/ blo gros rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang mo/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ 'brug pa bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ bka' brgyud phrin las yar 'phel/ 'brug pa kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang yon tan rgya mtsho/ de las so// yang na/ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho nas/ rje btsun phrin las dbang mo/

bla ma snying po mtha' yas/ rje ye shes rgya mtsho/ bla ma kun dga' bzang po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu nas 'dra'o// yang na bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims nas/ gzhon nu mgon po/ grags pa tshul khrims/ rgyal ba yon tan 'od/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ye shes rdo rje/ gnyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa nas 'dra'o// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo nang kun dga' grol mchog yan gong ltar la de nas/ bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ gling stod pa kun dga' byang chub/ rmor pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor gnas kun gsum/ kun dga' blo ldan/ dpal ldan phrin las/ thar rtse nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de las so// 'di nyid gnyug la paṇa chen nas/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen bar brgyud cing des yig cha mdzad kyang phyis rgyun chad nas jo nang brgyud par gsan te yig cha rang lugs sor gnas byas pa yin no// zhe'o// lung la/ grub brgya'i lo rgyus/ rtogs brjod rtsa 'grel/ 'brug pa'i dbang chog 'jam mgon bla ma'i lhan thabs/ zhar byung rje bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bcas pa las/ jo lugs skor gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ /grub chen thang rgyal lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ grub chen rin po che/ rdo rings kun spangs pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ ngag dbang nyi ma/ lcags zam pa kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug lcags zam phyogs kyi gsan thor 'di ltar snang yang bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod med dpyad/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ ra ba smad pa mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/

bstan 'dzin bdun pa ye shes lhun grub/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang bstan 'phel/ bstan 'dzin brgyad pa mkhyen rab mthu stobs/ de las so// ༈ /gong chos dbang rin po che nas brgyud pa'i skor du ma song ba/ phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga chos dbang lugs mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs yig steng nas rjes gnang lung bcas mkhan chen rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po las kyang gsan mod de brgyud pa de nyid du gsal// ༈ /ras chung lugs kyi gtum po lha lnga'i dbang rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs dang*/ mchog sprul karma nges don las gsan te brgyud pa btsal// ༈ /karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bka' 'bum las thugs dam lnga tshan lnga sogs thob pa'i brgyud pa gong ma rnams tshol/ de nas rje chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bdud 'dul rdo rje/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ nges don bstan pa rab rgyas/ mchog sprul rin po che karma nges don dbang po/ des bdag la'o// zhes gsungs pas jo lugs rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi brgyud pa 'di bzhin la/ rjes gnang gi rgyun rin 'byung la bsnyegs dgos zhes snang bde'i brgyud pa drang bar bya ste 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho las gsan to// ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che'i cha lag rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen gong ma rnam lnga/ skyo ston dri med/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ sangs rgyas dpal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan no// yang na/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan nas/ bdag chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor gnas kun gsum/ kun blos kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po dang*/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med gnyis/ gnyis kas thar rtse byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// gzhung rtsa ba dang yan lag gi yig cha rnams kyi lung yang mkhan chen 'di nyid las so// ༈ /grub pa'i slob dpon zhi ba sbas pa'i bka' srol las byon pa'i dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rig gtad 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma ār+yā tā rā/ grub chen til+li pradzñā bha dra/ nā ro dzñā na sid+dhi/ dpal mchog ḍom+bhi pa/ ku sā li chung ba/ an+tar+gha na/ slob dpon ye shes pa bshes gnyen/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa/ sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha/ rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtsho/ grub chen kun bzang dbang po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ 'brug pa rin po che bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta/ si tu rin po che 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta tshe dbang kun khyab/ mchog sprul rin po che karma nges don bstan 'dzin phrin las rab rgyas/ karma 'od gsal 'gyur med/ 'jam mgon bla ma nges par thams cad mkhyen pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la'o// zhes so// yang na ti lo pa nas/ lī lā badz+ra/ rā hu la gup+ta/ jo bo rje/ ma dh+ya ma siṃ ha/ ta twā shrī mi tra/ saṅgha shrī/ rat+na dh+wa dza/ nā ya ka shrī/ dharma shrī/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ su dza ga bud+dha shrī mi tra/ dzñā na rat+na/ dzñā na se na/ rā ti gup+ta/ zhi ba sbas pa man 'dra/ yang na/ 'brug pa rin po che las/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang po dang*/ nges don bstan 'dzin gnyis/ de gnyis ka las tshe dbang kun khyab kyis gsan pa man 'dra'o/

lung la/ rgyun khyer dang*/ rig gtad rje nyid kyis mdzad pa gong dang 'dra// ༈ /jo nang rje btsun rin po che'i gsar 'gyur grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i bka' srol sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi rjes gnang rig gtad dang*/ thub dbang nye sras brgyad kyi sgom lung gnyis car 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho'i yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor/ grub chen shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bud+dha swā mī/ su dza ta/ sā dhu dzñā na/ saṃ pra kīrti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be dā ban+dhū/ bī ra mi tra/ pūr+ṇa badz+ra/ rje tā ra nā tha/ rje rin chen rgya mtsho sogs rin 'byung spyi'i brgyud pa ltar dang*/ thub dbang bka' gdams lha bzhi ltar ro// lung la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sgrub thabs cho ga rig gtad bcas pa/ thub dbang nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi sgom bzlas dang lung 'bogs tshul/ mchod chog bstod chen rgya mtsho rnam brgyad bcas rje de nyid las/ mtshan brgya rgyud 'bum ltar ro// shākya rak+ṣi ta'i lugs kyi rnam rgyal ma gtso rkyang yang gong dang 'dra'o// ༈ /zhi byed lugs kyi khros nag gsang sgrub byin rlabs brgyud pa ni/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ grog chung dkon seng*/ shangs pa lu ldems/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i bla ma bzhi las brgyud de/ lab sgron/ khyi rdzi ma/ gcer bu ma/ 'ber mo ro zan/ de nas rgyal ba te ne nas rim par brgyud pa spyi dang 'dra bas/ rje btsun rin po che 'gyur med phrin las chos sgron/ de las so// ༈ /rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi yig steng nas khros nag lha lnga'i dbang bskur lung bcas/ stag lung pa ngag dbang chos kyi nyi ma/ lha btsun rin po che ye shes don grub kyi zhal snga nas so// ༈ /gong du ma song ba slar rnyed pa/ sa lugs grub rgyal ma'i brgyud pa/ kun blo nas/ dbang sdud snying po/ kun dga' rin chen/ rdo rje rin chen/ blo gsal bstan skyong*/

de las gsan par byas snang*/ ngor lugs thar paṇa gyi yig steng nas ni/ mus chen sangs rin yan sa lugs dang 'dra/ de nas lha mchog seng ge/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ hor nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// ༈ /grub chen pad+mā ka ra dang*/ ras chung lugs zung 'brel gyi khyung dmar rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ pad+ma ka ra/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan nas rim par brgyud de/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ sras 'gro ba'i mgon po/ bla ma chos kyi dbang phyug sprul sku shākya 'bum/ shākya seng ge/ byang chub rdo rje/ chos rje rtag pa ba/ chos bzang bla ma/ bde legs rgyal mtshan/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ lha dbang blo gros/ sangs rgyas seng ge/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ dpal ldan don grub/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ lhun grub dpal ldan/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka las so// yig cha'i lung yang de dang 'dra'am sems/ ras chung lugs ltar na de nyid yan khyung nag me'i spu gri ltar la de nas nyang nyi ma 'od zer man gong ltar ro// ༈ /stag lung lugs kyi tshe dpag med longs sku dang sprul sku'i dbang bskur ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma las gsan pa'i brgyud pa gzhung gsal ltar dang*/ lho brag grub chen phyag rdor snyan brgyud las byung ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe dbang gi brgyud pa ni re zhig ma rnyed la/ thang lugs tshe dbang phyag len rgyas pa'i brgyud pa gong du song bas lcags zam pa'i dbang chog gi brgyud pa des 'thus so// ༈ /yig cha rnams kyi lung skor gzim 'og mchog sprul rin po che las gsan pa ni/

thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang gi yig cha'i lung*/ kun blo nas/ 'gyur med mchog grub/ phrin las yon tan/ bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /sman bla'i rjes gnang paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lung*/ thar rtse paṇa chen/ mchog legs rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ kun blo/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bstan 'dzin phrin las/ phrin las yon tan/ bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /sa lo kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang gi yig cha'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa lo/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dpal mchog dpal ldan/ kun dga' bsod nams/ bsod nams lhun grub/ 'khon bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ bsod nams rin chen/ kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bstan 'dzin phrin las man 'dra/ yang na/ rin chen rgyal mtshan nas/ kun dga' bkra shis/ smon lam grags pa/ de las so// ༈ /kun blos mdzad pa'i gnyen sgrol gyi rjes gnang gi lung*/ kun blo/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab dge 'phel/ bstan 'dzin phrin las man 'dra// ༈ /rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs kyi rjes gnang gi lung ni/ kun blo nas/ bstan 'dzin phrin las man 'dra// ༈ /grub thob tshe dbang 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud mdzad pa po/ kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mus chen bsod nams dpal bzang*/ gnas gsar ba/ kun blo/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ kun dga' ye shes/ bla ma phrin las rab rgyas/ de las so// ༈ /rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i khyung nag gi rjes gnang lung bcas/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ bod 'brug pa/ khri chen ngag dbang kun mkhyen/ rje bstan 'dzin phrin las/ phrin las yon tan/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /kun blos mdzad pa'i gnyen sgrol rjes gnang gi lung*/ kun blo/ bstan 'dzin phrin las/

phrin las yon tan/ rje bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /thar rtses mdzad pa'i sme brtsegs ljang nag gi rjes gnang lung bcas/ rje dharma bar+dha/ phrin las yon tan/ bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /rmor chen nas mdzad pa'i sme brtsegs dud ka'i rjes lung*/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar ba/ kun blo/ gzim 'og gong ma/ gu ṇa/ rje bla ma/ de las so// ༈ /gtsug 'bar dang 'jam dbyangs dmar ser kyang de dang 'dra// ༈ /phur pa'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le kun blos mdzad pa/ kun blo nas/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun bkras/ dngos dpal/ gu ṇa/ rje bla ma/ de las so// ༈ /rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i khyung khra'i sgrub rjes/ rmor chen/ gnas gsar/ bod 'brug pa/ khri chen/ gu ṇa man 'dra// ༈ /seng gdong sngon mo thar paṇa rjes lung*/ paṇa chen nas/ mchog legs sogs/ gnas gsar ba nas/ bod 'brug pa/ ngag dbang kun mkhyen/ mkhyen rab 'gyur med mchog grub/ gu ṇa man 'dra'o// ༈ /kun blo'i 'byung 'dul me dbang*/ kun blo/ gong ma/ gu ṇa man 'dra// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa/ gnas gsar/ sa skya pa kun dga' phan bde rgya mtsho/ bco brgyad khri chen/ gzim gong*// gu ṇa'o// ༈ /rmor chen gyi rta gsang sbyin sreg rmor chen/ gnas gsar/ gzim gong*/ gu ṇa'o// ༈ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i be'u bum rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos bsgrigs pa'i nang nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi spyi chings lung brgyud ni/ rin chen chos dpal bzang po yan rjes gnang dang 'dra/ de nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ yab rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ lha dbang rgya mtsho/ dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rgyal dbang lnga pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mang thos rgya mtsho/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ don grub bstan 'dzin/ blo bzang dge legs bstan 'dzin/ dam tshig rdo rje/ grags pa blo bzang*/

ka chen blo bzang dge legs kun khyab/ de las so// ༈ /rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gtor chog nag 'gros su bsgrigs pa/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i mchod gtor 'bul tshul/ thug gsol/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gser skyems bcas kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ dben sa ba blo bzang don grub/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ blo bzang ye shes/ blo bzang chos rgyan/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang ye shes/ blo bzang bzod pa/ dpal ldan ye shes/ blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor/ dpal ldan grags pa/ ka chen blo bzang dge legs/ de las so// ༈ /dngos kyi gsan yul tsam las brgyud pa ma 'khod pa tshe dpag med lha dgu'i man ngag dpal sa skya pa kun dga' bkra shis las gsan cing*/ des mtshon te/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng dang*/ mang mkhar ba blo gros bzang po'i sgrol dkar be'u bum lung dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ tshe rta zung 'brel dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser rjes lung dpal ldan phrin las/ zhu chen smyung chog byams pa bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo dang*/ gtsug 'bar rjes lung ngag gi dbang po/ mgon dkar rjes gnang dang*/ yig cha skor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bsgrigs pa las tshar chen dang*/ dpal gling pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yig cha ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma'i lung zhabs drung nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chags med smra seng sgrub thabs kyi lung karma pa theg mchog rdo rje/ lo chen rin chen rnam rgyal gyi dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bo dong paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i las sbyor tshigs bcad ma/ bstod pa bcas kyi lung*/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdzad pa'i srad rgyud lugs kyi ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ so so'i las sbyor dang bcas pa'i lung rnams dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ khyung po'i mgur brgyad/ sgrol dkar/

'jam dbyangs smra seng*/ 'jam dpal nag po/ seng gdong sngon mo gong dkar lugs/ dbyangs can dmar mo rnams las sngar ma thob pa'i yig cha ci rigs pa'i lung rnams lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ sor 'brang dkar mo/ khyung khra nag kun blo'i yig cha/ 'jam dpal nag po/ rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs rmor chen yig cha nas rjes gnang lung bcas/ kun blo'i phur pa'i rgyun khyer nges don thig le'i lung*/ gur drag nyang lugs rjes gnang bcas dpal sa skya pa kun dga' rin chen/ tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma/ spyan ras gzigs don yod zhags pa'i rjes gnang*/ bcu gcig zhal rigs bzhis bskor ba dang*/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang khrid lung bcas/ mgon dkar rjes gnang pod lung*/ kun blos mdzad pa'i dzam dkar rjes gnang lung*/ khro mo sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang lung bcas/ sme brtsegs sa lugs grib mdos kyi lung bcas 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sbyin sreg nam mkha' 'chi med/ kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ las tshogs ngag shes/ rin chen grags pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan las gsan pa'i tshul rnams phyag tho las bshus pa de tsam dang*/ gong du ma 'byor ba/ 'bri gung bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim spyi brgyud/ rdo rje 'chang*/ te lo/ nā ro/ mi la/ dwags po/ phag gru/ 'bri gung skyob pa/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ gcung rdo rje grags pa/ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ mtshams bcad pa grags bsod/ bcu gnyis pa rdor rin/ nyer brgyad pa rdor rgyal/ nyer gnyis pa chos rgyal/ don grub rgyal po/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang grags pa/ rin chen chos rgyal/ kun dga' rin chen/ rin chen phun tshogs/ dpal gyi rgya mtsho/ chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ chos kyi grags pa/ dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ don grub chos rgyal/

bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de las so// de lta bu'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi khungs rgyud kyi dum bu rnams ni bka' 'gyur ltar te/ smin grol gling pa'i rdor 'dzin 'gyur med phun tshogs las gsan cing*/ dmigs bsal bde gsang dus gsum kye rdor sogs 'ga' zhig dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas las gsan/ phur pa rtsa dum lta bu rnying rgyud las byung ba ni gong gsal ltar dang*/ 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho las kyang gsan/ rgya gzhung gi skor/ thub bstod sems brtse ma/ 'jam dbyangs gang blo ma/ bhū ri pa'i rgyun bshags/ zla grags smre bshags sogs bstan 'gyur skor thor bu dang zhwa lu'i chos spyod las 'byung ba rnams dang*/ mdo sde 'don pa'i gdams ngag sogs jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa las byung ba rnams dang*/ gnas bcu'i cho ga sogs snar thang brgya rtsa las byung ba rnams dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ khyung bo'i mgur brgyad dang bka' rgya ma bzhi sogs shangs chos las byung ba rnams 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho las gsan par snang la/ sgrub thabs kyi khungs gtso bo ba ri brgya rtsa'i brgyud pa ni/ de'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs las gsal ba ltar dang*/ de'i rjes gnang lung bcas kun dga' blo gros nas/ nam mkha' 'chi med/ dpal ldan phrin las zhabs las kyang gsan/ de nyid yang na/ dpal ldan chos skyong*/ rin chen mchog grub/ bzhi sde bla ma rin chen chos 'phel/ ye na bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bstan 'dzin chos gsal/ bla ma dpal ldan phrin las/ de las so// snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung bcas kyang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang gsan khungs ma chod la/ lung ka chen nor bu don grub las gsan pa dang*/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung rjes gnang lung bcas 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas las gsan te spyi'i brgyud pa phyag rdor gos sngon can dang grub brgya'i skabs ltar la/

de'i nang gses gsar 'gyur skor sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma dang 'dra/ kar lugs gcig shes kun grol dbon karma nges don 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i zhabs gnyis car las gsan te spyi brgyud dkar lugs sgrol dkar dang 'dra/ sgrub thabs 'dod bum las byung ba re zung de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar te gzhan du shes/ de 'brel kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i dbyangs can ma'i skor sogs mkhan pad+ma rdo rje las gsan nam brtag khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i lung brgyud ni/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan nas rim par brgyud/ lho brag bla ma dpal ldan grags pa/ lha btsun rin po che don grub rgyal mtshan/ de las so// yang na/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan nas/ brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog man 'dra/ 'di ni khro lo'i 'gyur dang gsung skor 'dir gang bzhugs kyi brgyud par snang ngo*// gzhan 'dir bzhugs pa'i yig cha bla ma so so'i gsung rab las byung ba gsan khungs tsam smros na/ gtso bor yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i bka' 'bum tshang ma rdo rje slob dpon chen po ngag dbang legs grub kyi mdun nas gsan cing*/ nyer mkho 'ga' zhig slob dpon dge 'dun rab rgyas/ dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags gsum las kyang gsan no// rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal gyi gsung 'bum dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung 'bum/ mkhan chen dkon mchog lhun grub gsung 'bum/ zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gsung 'bum rnams tshang ma rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dang*/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/

mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub gsum gyi bka' 'bum/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bka' 'bum glegs bam dang po rnams mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung rab dang*/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi bka' 'bum las gsan pa rnams dbang rjes gnang so so'i skabs su gsal zhes snang ba/ rjes gnang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra bar shes la/ de las sangs phun pa'i gsung ngag dbang legs grub las gsan pa'i tshul dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar ro// 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang legs grub kyi gsung rab rnams ni sku dngos las gsan par snang ngo*// de las gzhan phyis byon gyi sa skya gong ma rnams dang*/ tshar pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi gsung gong so so'i skabs su ma song ba rnams ma nges kyang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar gsan yig las sgrub rjes man ngag gi yig cha skor gsan tho rim 'khod ltar rjes 'brel gang mchis gsan par gor ma chag la/ phyogs gzhan pa'i yig cha cher mi snang yang*/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi chos spyod zla sprul nges don bstan pa rab rgyas/ gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi rta mgrin las tshogs brgya rtsa rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas las gsan pa tsam las/ man ngag gi skor sogs 'ga' zhig gsan tho ma rnyed pas rtsad gcod dgos par snang*/ be'u bum skor nas byung ba rnams kyi gtso bo sa skya'i gser pod du grags pa ni/ klu dbang rgyal po/ dzaṃ dkar/ smra seng*/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ sgrol dkar/ rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs/ sa lugs sme brtsegs dud ka jo lugs sme brtsegs ljang nag dzaṃ dkar 'brug zhon/ gser chos seng gdong ma/ 'jam dpal nag po/ seng ge sgra/ rdo rje khyung khra bcas/ dus 'khor khyung khra/ khyung nag 'byung po 'ur 'ded/ dbyu gu mched gsum/ gser chos dzaṃ dmar/ skyer sgang rta mgrin gsang sgrub bcas kyi yig cha'i lung rmor chen yan so so'i brgyud pa ltar la/

de nas gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ de las so// yang na/ nam mkha' 'chi med nas/ mkhas dbang kun dga' don grub/ bla ma dam pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin no/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub skor kun dga' don grub/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de las kyang gsan no// mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi be'u bum lung brgyud nā ro mkha' spyod skor brgyud tshul mang du byung ba thams cad 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros la 'dus shing*/ de nas rje btsun ma 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'khon ston ngag gi dbang po theg chen bkra shis rin chen/ de las so// byams pa phrin las yon tan gyi gcod mdzad pa po nas/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las/ de las so// in+d+ra mkha' spyod dang mai tri mkha' spyod gnyis 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan yan byin rlabs dang 'dra/ de nas khri chen bkra shis rin chen/ de las so// dmar po skor gsum gyi be'u bum lung brgyud/ ku ru kul+le'i skor 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros yan tshar lugs byin rlabs dang 'dra la/ de nas paṇa chen kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// yang na/ kun bkras nas/ 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen bkra shis rin chen/ de las so// de 'brel dmar chung skor gsum gyi lung brgyud/ sa chen kun blo yan byin rlabs dang 'dra/ de nas paṇa chen kun dga' bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen/ de las so// zhar byung du dzam+bha la/ tshogs bdag a pa rā tsi ta gsum la brten pa'i zas nor snyan grags sgrub pa'i man ngag gnyen lo'i gser chos dzaṃbha la sum bsgril gyi gdams pa las sbyor kho na lag tu len pa'i man ngag zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

dbang rab yan dmar chung skor gsum rjes gnang dang 'dra/ de nas rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun blo man gong dmar chung skor gsung dang 'dra/ tshogs bdag skor gyi lung*/ mkhyen brtse yan tshar lugs rjes gnang dang 'dra la/ de nas dbang rab/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen man gong dzam la dang 'dra ba las rdo rje rin chen dang*/ dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas gnyis ka las so// 'dod rgyal yig lung*/ 'phags pa yan rjes gnang dang 'dra/ de nas mkhas grub do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po nas tshar chen/ mkhyen brtse/ gnyis ka las dbang rab/ de man tshar lugs tshogs bdag dang 'dra/ chos srung nor lha'i skor gyi yig lung gong dkyus su song la/ de las gur mgon skor ngag dbang legs grub dang*/ rnam sras skor rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs blo gsal mdun nas gsan to/ mtha' rten mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud pa gong du song zhing*/ rnam sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi rjes gnang gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags yig steng nas lung bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen nas/ mkhyen brtse/ dbang rab/ ngag chos/ sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams/ lha khang mkhan chen don grub legs bzang*/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ ngag dbang blo gsal phun tshogs/ mkhyen rab 'gyur med mchog grub/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ de las so// ༈ /ras chung lugs tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa rin 'byung nas byung ba'i rjes gnang ni de nyid kyi brgyud pa ltar// ༈ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje'i yig steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med/

mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma/ grub chen pad+mā ka ra/ rje btsun mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung skyob pa/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ gcung rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma a rtse/ spyan sngar rdo rje rgyal po/ 'bri gung lo tsā nor dpal ye shes/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ dga' gdong ba chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ dbu legs grub chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ bco brgyad pa mkhyen rab mchog legs rdo rje la'o// yang na rje btsun mi la nas/ ngan rdzong ras pa byang chub rgyal po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dge bshes rgya pho lung pa/ lha rin chen rgyal po/ rin chen bzang po/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po/ byang chub seng ge gzhon nu kun dga'/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ ngag gi dbang po/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ stag lung rnam rgyal bkra shis/ de dbon kun dga' bkra shis/ de dbon ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ de gsum kas bco brgyad pa mchog legs rdo rje la'o// de nas bstan 'dzin bzang po/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs 'byung*/ sa chen ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ zhal dkar pa ngag dbang shes rab/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang dam chos/ ngag dbang bzang po/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med dam/ yang na sa chen kun dga' blo gros nas/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ de gnyis ka las so// yang na stag lung ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma las kyang gsan/ yang ras chung lugs ltar na/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po/ gling ras pad+ma rdo rje/ rgya ras ye shes rdo rje/ rgod tshang ras pa mgon po rdo rje/

yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ spyan snga ba rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ grub chen blo ldan bzang po/ 'khrul zhig kun dga' bsam gtan/ gtsang smyon he ru ka chos kyi grags pa/ rgod tshang sna tshogs rang grol/ nges gnas pa byams pa phun tshogs/ rje karma bkra shis/ sman sgom sangs rgyas te rab 'byams rnam pa gsum/ gsum kas kun mkhyen grub mchog dbang po/ rje phrin las rgya mtsho/ ras chung sprul sku bka' brgyud sgron me/ byang chub gling pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba 'dzam gling rdo rje/ ras chung sprul sku rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ rgyal ba ye shes skal bzang*/ ras chung sprul sku dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ dge'u ba nges don bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho/ ras chung sprul sku grub mchog mthu stobs rgya mtsho/ kha rag pa rin chen 'od zer/ ras chung sprul sku dge'u mchog sprul tu grags pa bka' brgyud phrin las dbang phyug de las so// lung la/ bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs rje btsun ma'i gsung rtsa ba sngags bcas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag dang sgrub thabs/ ngan rdzong snyan brgyud las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs/ mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub rjes dngos grub char 'bebs bcas te/ rtsa ba'i yi ge le tshan karma nges don dbang po las gsan cing brgyud pa btsal/ phyi ma rjes gnang dang 'dra'o// tshe ring ma'i g.yang skyabs cho ga mdzad pa po 'jam mgon bla ma nyid las so// 'di yan chod ni rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyis gsan pa'i tshul lo// de ltar rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyis bsgrigs zin pa'i kha skong rigs 'jam mgon thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas gsar bsgrigs gnang ba/ thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod mjug 'od dpag med kyi sngags chog

jo lugs mi 'khrugs pa'i las tshogs/ don yod zhags pa'i smyung gnas cho ga bde mchog lhan skyes sgrub thabs/ ras chung lugs kyi phyag rdor gtum khyung bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi mjug mar lugs rdor sems gtso rkyang gi sgrub rjes man ngag bcas pa'i mjug dam tshig rdo rje'i man ngag sbyin sreg ltung ba sbyong ba'i sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lag len/ sdom pa gsum gyi bshags tshig srung ba lha lnga'i byad 'grol bcas chos tshan bcu gcig gi rjes gnang gsum ni rje bla mas stsal grub la/ yig cha rnams kyi lung 'jam mgon bla ma blo gros mtha' yas/ mkhan bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ de las bdag nyid kyis nos pa yin no// de 'phros kyi kha skong bdag nyid kyis gsar bsgrigs bgyis pa'i rigs so sor sbyar byang gis gsal ba ltar nas/ rjes gnang byin rlabs skor rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi zhal snga nas thob pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso rkyang*/ 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug rnam 'joms bir lugs/ rnam rgyal ma dkar mo phyag gnyis ma gtso rkyang*/ 'brug lugs khrus lha lnga/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan rnams dang*/ grub thob brgyad cu'i byin rlabs 'brug lugs lung bcas 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ sa lugs 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas nos pas mtshon gzhan las thob pa'i brgyud pa las rtogs par byas la/ yig cha'i lung skor nas/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs skor 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i zhabs/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rgya gzhung sa skya'i gsung rab bod gzhung skor/ ngag dbang legs grub gnas brtan mchod chog dang*/ rten khrus ri khrus/ mgon dkar g.yang chog zhwa lu'i sman chog rjes 'brel bcas/ rnam sras rtog pa sogs rgya gzhung*/ las tshogs skor yig rnying*/ bu ston rin po che'i mngon rtogs bcas/ skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbang bshad/ rmor chen rab gnas yon bsgo'i rnam bshad/

dkon mchog 'bangs kyi chos spyod/ mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang cho ga 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i tshe ring ma'i g.yang chog rdor sems dang*/ gtum khyung gi yig cha/ gung thang ba'i shra ba ṇa'i sgrub skor/ rje bla ma'i sgrol dkar/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi bstod pa'i skor bcas thob pa dang*/ ma thob pa'i brgyud pa lung bcas slar zhib tu btsal dgos yod cing*/ rje bla ma nyid kyi gsung sgrol dkar sgrub thabs ril sgrub bcas/ 'od zer can ma'i man ngag nyer mkho/ nyer mkho'i chos spyod mdzes rgyan bcas ma thob cing lung rgyun btsal khungs dben pas lung spel gyi gnang ba zhu ba las thabs ma byung zhing*/ de ma gtogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs/ de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yig cha rigs ma lus pa rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga dngos nas snga phyi lan gnyis kyi skabs su yid ches par bka' drin tu thob pa yin no// de lta bu'i chos sde 'dir bka' drin gyis khyab kyang gnas skabs bsgrig tu ma byung ba/ 'khon lugs phur pa'i gtor dbang gi rjes 'brel smad las drag po sgrol dbang gi dod zur lugs mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa'i byin rlabs/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i thugs dam bzhi'i ya gyal bde mchog dkar po tshe sgrub bcas/ yang dag me gcig gi gdams pa rnams kyang zab chos la chog shes mi bya ba rnams kyis btsal zhing don du gnyer bas gdams ngag gi rabs mi bcad par 'os shing*/ sgrol dkar sogs khrid kyi skor dkyus su bzhugs pa rnams las gzhan grub rgyal tshe khrid/ tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid rigs lnga/ lhan skyes rnams dang 'brel ba'i bde kye gsang gsum gyi dmar khrid sogs sgrub thabs rin po che 'di nyid kyi grol byed lam gyi rim par 'jog rgyu yin tshul rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung dpal ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag thor thebs pa ltar 'chad nyan mdzad pa rnams kyis yal bar mi 'dor bar zhu zhing*/

de las thugs rje chen po'i khrid bsdus rje bla mas brgyud 'debs bcas mdzad pa 'dir bzhugs pa ltar dang*/ gzhan gyi dpe rgyun btsal zhing skabs su bab par 'doms pa yang zhar byung du gsol ba lags/ smras pa/ bstan 'gro'i lha lam mthon por mngon 'phags pa'i// rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba'i mdzod// gsung gi bdud rtsis skal ldan tshim mdzad rnams// bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o// shin tu snyigs ma'i dus mtha'i me chen gyis// lung rtogs chu bo 'bri bar phyogs kyang slar// mgon rnams thugs bskyed rdzogs ldan sprin chen las// sngags bcud bdud rtsi'i gru char ci yang phab// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs// tshang la ma nor brgyud pa rnam dag las// legs par byon pa'i gdams ngag don gnyer blos// mang thos dpyod ldan rnams kyi rjes zhugs te// rigs dang bka' babs nyams len byin rlabs kyi// khyad par la dgongs gcig gis ma tshim par// gdams pa sna re'ang yongs 'dzin mang po las// 'bad pas gsan pa rje 'di'i khyad chos yin// thugs bskyed phyag gis rgyud gzhung rgya mtsho las// man ngag dbyig gi snying po yongs btus nas// lag len gser gyi skud par bstar ba'i phreng*// mgrin rgya ci dgar 'phyang 'di bla ma'i drin// sgrub rjes me tog ldum rwa cher mang yang*// man ngag u dum+bā ra bkra ba dkon// don gnyis sgrub gnas sngon med dga' tshal 'di// skal bzang rig pa 'dzin rnams rol pa'i gzhi// gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi g.yar dam dang*// gcig tu 'grogs pa'i rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyis// mchog thun grub pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur nas// bstan dang 'gro ba'i 'dod pa kun sgrubs shig /dka' brgyas zab mo'i bka' kun btus pa 'di// ji snyed yid kyi 'dod 'jo'i ljon lags kyi// thos bsam sgom pa'i bsam sbyor rnam dag gis// srid pa ji srid nyams pa med par srungs// lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba'i bsil zer dang*// mi phyed dge ba'i zla ba gang gi mkhar// mos pas drangs pa'i skye bor rtsa ba dang*// brgyud pa'i bla mas dge legs sim stsol cig

/bstan pa spyi dang khyad par 'di yi chos// yid can spyi dang khyad par skal ldan dpal// dus gsum spyi dang khyad par snyigs dus 'dir// gsal dang brtan dang lhag par khyab gyur cig /bkra shis nyi ma nub med byin rlabs 'od zer brgya ru bzhad// bkra shis zla ba 'grib bral dngos grub bdud rtsi'i phreng ba 'bebs// bkra shis rgyu skar g.yo med phrin las thig le mkha' mnyam bkra// bkra shis snang ba mtha' yas bla ma lhar bcas bden pas shog /ces mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gang ci yang rung ba sgrub pa la ma tshang med pa'i 'dod rgu'i gling chen po 'di nyid brgyud pa rnam par dag pa las ji ltar byon pa'i yi ge dge legs gaṅgā'i klung chen zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba rje btsun bla ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyi sku drin gyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas la dbugs dbyung thob pa 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang pos dad cing gus pas bris pa lam zab mo 'di nyid srid mthar 'phel ba dang*/ de 'dzin skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi thugs bzhed tshul bzhin du 'gengs nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
